༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo so gsum yan gyi 'a

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI005_ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi 'phrin yig dang gdams pa'i skor sogs 175-nas 247bar/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo so gsum yan gyi 'phrin yig dang gdams pa'i skor sogs thor bu 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bzhugs// mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags la phul ba'i zhu yig175 rgya gar skad du/ tri dha tu dharmā rā dza shrī wan gu ru bhaṭ+ṭa rā ka dharmā swa mi ye na maḥ bod skad du/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i byang chub brnyes pa'i lam/ /bzo gso sgra dang tshad ma nang don sogs/ /shes bya ma lus gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /gang la mnga' ba de yi zhabs drung du/ /'khon gyi rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang ā nan+das/ /gus pas sor bcu sbyar te 'di skad zhus/ /khyod sku lhun chags mig gi bdud rtsi de/ /gzhan ngor nyer 'tshe med par bzhugs lags sam/ /khyod gsung mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i chu gter de/ nam yang rgyas shing gang bar mi bzhugs sam/ khyod thugs zab gsal ting 'dzin ri dbang de/ /mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i dpal la rol lags sam/ /bdag kyang 'byung bzhi'i sgyu lus cha snyoms shing / /phyi ltar bstan pa'i bya bar ming btags pa'i/ /rnam g.yengs za za'i srad bus dam bcings nas/ /sde dang bstan pa'i khur gyis yid mnar ba'i/ /lus sems dub cing snyoms las ngang du lags/ /'on kyang thams cad mkhyen pa khyod gsung las/ /khyod kyi 'phral gyi spyod lam phra mo tshun/ /kun kyang dpal ldan sa skya'i sde bstan pa'i/ /zhabs tog nyid las gzhan du ma 'das phyir/ /'di phyi gnyis ka don dang ldan no zhes/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod pa'i/ /gsung de yang yang sems kyi ngal gsor thob/ /da lam bdag dang nye gnas slob bu 'di/ /zab rgyas chos yon mtshon byed 'bul ba dang /

/slar yang chos kyi gsol 'debs phyir bzhud pa/ /de ltar legs pa'i thugs kyi mi shes shing / /sngar bzhin yid re'i 'bras bu stsal du gsol/ /bla ma yi dam rang sems 'khor 'das kyi/ /gnas lugs ro gcig rang rig ye shes che/ /dran 'dun ngang nas rtse gcig gsol 'debs kyis/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs khyod/ /bstan 'gro'i don phyir lo brgyar zhabs brtan zhing / /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /byang chub bar du thugs rjes bskyangs du gsol/ /ces yos lo zla ba dgu pa'i dmar cha'i dus tshes bzang po'i nyin 'bul tshan rnams yi ge zur gsal bzhin/ tshan pa re re bzhin bkra shis kyi rtags kyis mdzes par byas te yan lag brgyad ldan gyi khrus kyi rdzing bu nas phul pa'i zhu yig mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags la phul ba'i zhu yig176 oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig mkhan chen chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du/ zhu ba/ deng sang gi dus na'ang gzhan ngor snang ba'i sku'i 'tshe ba rab tu dwangs shing / bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi nyams len bzang po'i rgyun mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yo lang la dges bzhin du spyod par bzhugs lags sam/ 'dir yang lnga phung bro nad kyi nyer 'tshe med ngos/ yan lag brgyad ldan khrus kyi rdzing bur bde bar rgyu zhing gnas par mchis lags/ de lta'i skabs nas nyams dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa'i mchod sprin cung zad 'bul ba la thugs kyi mi bes shing sa dgongs su gsol/ ma nā ha ran+tu/ bdag 'khon rigs sngags 'chang a nan+da/ /sngon las 'phro bzang po'i 'phen pa yis/ /rigs gtsang ma'i rigs skyes blo gros gsal/ /lo gzhon nu nyid nas dam chos la/ /yid don gnyer 'dun pa mi dman tsam/ /bka' mdo rgyud gsung rab bstan bcos don/ /phal che ba thos bsam bya 'dod kyang / /sngar bsam pa bzhin du ma 'grub mod/

/'on kyang rung mtshan ldan bla ma yis/ /gsung bdud rtsis bdag blo grol ba'i mthus/ /gnad zab mo kun la dogs pa'i blo/ /phyogs gcig min kun la zhugs pa tsam/ /don de 'dra'i bka' drin legs stsol ba'i/ /mi bdag gi bla ma 'di ltar ste/ /rje grub thob rgyal po dbang po'i mtshan/ /'gro yongs la brtse ba grags pa'i zhabs/ /thugs lhag bsam dag pa'i spyan snga ba/ /rje grub pa'i gtsug rgyan nags dgon che/ /nyams rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag shwa ra'i mtshan/ /kun spro bsdu'i byed po mus pa rje/ /rje mtshungs bral rnams kyi thugs rje'i rgyun/ /rgyun bzang po dbyer med ro gcig de/ /de rgyud la zhugs pa'i blo mig mchog /mchog de 'dra bdag gi skal bas thob/ /drin de 'dra stsal ba'i bla ma rnams/ /thugs chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig par/ /rang rig pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ dus da lo me mo yos lo la/ /rje thams cad mkhyen pa khyed dang mjal/ /gsung zab dbyangs chos kyi char pa phab/ /'di bka' drin che'o rje yi rang / /mgon khyod kyi rnam thar 'di ltar mthong / /bka' mdo rgyud gsung rab rab 'byams dang / /chos thun mong de min rigs gnas la/ thugs sbyangs pa rab kyi mthar son te/ sngon mkhas dbang kun la 'gran bzod kyang / /thugs 'kheng pa'i nga rgyal rtsad nas spangs/ sngon rgyal sras kun gyi lam po che/ chos chags sdang spangs pa'i byang sems de/ /dus ding sang rgyud ldan khyod min su/ /rje mkhas grub du ma'i thugs sras khyed/ /thugs chos khyad dang bral btsun tshugs bzang / /tshe 'dir snang grags bde kun dor nas/ /dus rgyun du rtse gcig bsgrub la gzhol/ /de'i thun mtshams rnams su skal ldan la/ /ljongs gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po mchog /dpal sa skya'i yab chos 'dres med rgyun/ /phyogs kun du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad/ /tshul 'di dag mtshon pa tsam zhig ste/ /mdor bsdu na sngon byon gong ma yi/

/ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bzang po rnams/ /mgon khyod la tshang ba kho bos mthong / /'di bsam gyin mi phyed dad pa 'phel/ /rje khyed kyi thugs dang rang gi sems/ /khong dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs gnyis sumed pa'i ye shes rnams/ /don gdod ma'i gnas lugs ro gcig par/ /'di rang ngo shes pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /dus 'du 'bral med par gsol 'debs kyis/ /don de ltar dgongs la brtse bas skyong / /'di gzigs pa'i rten du dam tshig gi /rdzas ril bu phur ma'i thum bu dang / /gzhan zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa la/ /rgya bkra shis rtags kyis mdzes te phul/ /tshig de skad nyams dbyangs thol byung 'di/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag rnal 'byor ming gzhan gdod nas rang grol/ ngag dbang kun bsod kyi/ /yid tsham tshom med par smras 'di dag /ces me yos zla ba gsum pa'i dmar cha'i tshes la mang mkhar khrus kyi rdzing bu nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //skyes bu blo ldan rnams la springs yig bzhugs/177 oṃ bde legs su gyur cig skyes bu blo ldan rnams la springs pa/ spyir sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las/ dge 'dun gyi sde bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin sbyin bdag chos rgyal la rag las par gda' ste/ ding sang gi dus 'di na de rnams mar ngo'i zla ba ltar gyur cing / de las ldog pa rnams rgyas pa 'di yid skyo ba'i gnas su mchis/ sngon byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag gi gsan yig dang / chos 'chad lugs sogs bstan pa spel tshul rnams bsam nas/ deng sang gi bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba dag la bltas tsa na mtshan btags tsam du gda' ste/ sngon byon pa'i gong ma de dag gis ni bstan 'gro'i phyir sku srog kyang gtong ba la thugs thag bcad nas mdzad rgyu bstan pa'i bya ba las med pa zhig mdzad 'dug pa la brten zab yangs bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun bzang chad la thug pa rnams rang rang gi smon lam gyi dbang gis lugs srol so so dag skyes bu dam pa re res ches cher rgyas par mdzad pas/

deng sang gi bar du'ang bstan pa'i rgyun cung zad tsam lus pa 'dir gda'/ tshul 'di bsam pa'i tshe kho bo dad pa dang spro ba dang skyo ba gsum 'dres ma'i ngang nas mig nas mchi ma du ma dbang med du 'chor gyin 'dug khyed blo ldan rnams kyang tshul 'di som dang / rje gong ma rnams la dad pa chen po dbang med du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kye ma deng sang gi bstan 'dzin du zhal gyi bzhes pa phal cher zang zing gi don du gnyer ba kho na las chos 'chad nyan sogs bstan pa'i bya bar 'gyur nges pa rnams lag tu long yang mi len zhing / len lo rnams kyang chos 'chad pa sogs la long byung mang zhes 'jig rten gyi bya ba la rkang tshugs dang / chos zhor las byed pa zhig gda' ba/ 'di 'dra rang gi 'khrul tshab la gzigs dang / skyes bu rnams dpyod kyi blo gros rab tu gsal ba dag bstan pa'i bya ba 'ba' zhig bgyid par 'dod pa lags/ deng sang mi drag zhan kun de'i mthun rkyen mi bsgrub pa'i khar gnod pa ci 'khyol byed pa 'di ni/ spre'u dag gi mi rnams la mjug ma med pa 'di 'dra zhes khrel ba dang mtshungs par mi gda'am/ de bzhin du sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i rgyud phyug pa'i bstan pa gsal nus nges pa'i bshes gnyen rnams las blun po sgo phugs kyi 'phrin tsam yang mi 'khyol ba dag gces par 'dzin pa 'di 'dra skyo ba la ang / bstan pa la 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i rgyu gda'am/ khyed blo ldan rnams kyi dpyod par zhu/ deng sang dge 'dun gyi sder gnas pa'i gang zag phal cher yang / gong ma'i rnam thar skyong 'dod lta zhog chos mthun tsam yang bgyid 'dod med pa 'di las kha drag pa zhig dang nor phyug pa zhig thabs ji ltar byas na 'ong ngam snyam pa kho na sems zhing / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su bstan pa bshig pa dang 'dzin pa'i gang zag so sor 'byed pa'i dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams la phal cher mi dga' zhing /

de dag khyad med du 'jog pa'i yul de la byang chub sems dpa' yin zhes dad pa ltar byed pa 'di ni ma dag pa'i dad par 'gyur ram snyam mo/ /'di yang blo ldan rnams kyi dpyad par zhu/ mdor na sngon byon gong ma rnams kyi bstan pa spel lugs dang / slob ma rnams kyi don gnyer byed lugs dang / de dag gi skabs rnams su mthun rkyen 'grig lugs sogs/ bstan pa rin po che'i me ro gso lugs rnams mthong ba'i tshe 'di 'dra rang gi ngo mtshar ba snyam pa kho nar 'dug cing / deng sang bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa mi bsam lugs dang / slob ma rnams kyis don gnyer med lugs dang / gal te bla mas bstan pa bsam/ slob mas don gnyer byas kyang mthun rkyen mi 'grig pa sogs gang nas bsam kyang bstan pa rin po che 'di rgyas par dka' ba 'dug snyam skyo shas drag po bza' btung mi dran pa lta bu kho bo la yong gi 'dug pa/ khyed blo ldan rnams kyang legs par brtags na de lta bu mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mi gda' bas legs par brtag par zhu/ legs par brtags nas bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la rtse gcig du bgyis nas spyi sgos kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyud bzang po phal cher chad la thug pa 'di rnams thog la yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas pa zhig ci la thug kyang bya/ de ltar du 'gyur ba bla ma mkhyen snyam du bsam la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / gang snang bden med du shes pa gal che bas de ltar thugs la zhugs pa zhu lags/ skyes bu blo gros ldan pa thams cad la/ 'di lta'i springs yig bskur ba'i bsod nams kyi/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /rab tu 'phel zhing yun du gnas gyur cigaces pa 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis shin tu myur bar smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa che/

/rgyas byed legs bshad 'di ni dge178 rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra shwa ra na ya ka wa ra gu ru tri ṇi ye na ma: bod skad du/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'dren mchog bla ma gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal sa skya'i bstan pa rin chen rgyun/ /rgyun bzang po chad la thug pa'i dus/ /dus ngan pa 'di la thar pa'i lam/ /lam de 'dra ston mdzad bka' drin can/ /pha 'jam dbyangs mched dang mus pa rje/ /khong gsum las lhag pa'i 'dren pa zhig /dus gsum du lo grangs brgya brgya ru/ /blo zhib mos btsal kyang brnyed re kan/ /don des na byang chub bar du 'dud/ /de ltar 'dren mchog rnam gsum la/ /gus pas btud de sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /rgyas phyir 'dus pa rgya mtsho la/ /legs par bshad pa'i gtam 'di spel/ /dka' ba'i phun tshogs lus rten thob dus 'dir/ kha zas btung ba'i phyir du ma gtong bar/ gang byung chog shes rten la dam chos bsgrub/ /nga rgyal rang gnod yin pas de dor zhig /ca col mi nyan gleng gzhi nag chang gi /cha shas tsam yang gos par mi bya zhing / /ja chang bag med la spyod nyin mtshan kun/ /nyams dga' yin zhes 'khrig gtam ma smra zhig /tab tob gsung rab don la ma spyod par/ /the tshom sna tshogs zhib tu legs brtag na/ /da gzod mdo rgyud bstan bcos dgongs don la/ /nongs pa med pa'i gdeng 'ga' thob par 'gyur/ /dpa' bos ngan spyod rtag tu spangs byas la/ /pha bzang bu ltar shes ldan slob ma khyongs/ /ba glang lta bu'ang blo sna chos la khrid/ /ma ru ma gyur rigs drug med par bsam/ /rtsub pa'i gtam gyis chos la bskul ba la/ /tsha grang che zhes dam pa ma bkur ba/ /dzar ba'i gos la'ang dngos gzhan med na yang / /wa yis sha la sred ltar chos la mdzod/ /zha ltar 'khur 'os mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /zas nor phyir du 'dren pa ma 'tshol ba/ /'od rgyal nyi ltar bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /ya rab kun gyis bsngags de bsten bya'i 'os/

/rang nyid thos pa rgya mtsho'i gnad kyi don/ /lus sems ngal dub spangs te spyad byas la/ /sha chang sgo nas blo ldan ma bslad pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dag pa'i sems kyis sbyor/ /hi bzhad sgra 'di 'dra'i tshul lugs la/ /e ma mkhas pa rnams kyis sgrogs pa'i gnas/ /lugs 'di kho bo'ang kun mkhyen ma thob bar/ /dad cing bsgrub pa'i yid la 'gyur ba med/ /kye ma 'jig rten pa dag dran tsam nas/ /snang ba ma nub bar du sdig la spyod/ /gtan du 'dod pa bsgrub kyang mi 'dod pa/ /kho na myong zhing byas tshad dam chos dang / /'gal bas 'di phyi kun du ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'di la blo ldan su zhig smon par byed/ /kye hud gzhon dus bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / /lus stobs rgyas nas bdud mo'i grogs dang 'brel/ /'brel yang bshes gnyen kun dad mnyam nyid du/ dad rdzas za la nong med ham chen rnams/ /phyi ma'i 'dug gnas dmyal ba las gzhan gang / /deng sang rab byung la la btsos myos kyi/ /chang la bag med spyod cing gzhan la'ang ster/ /srung sdom tshul bzhin byed la blo chung zer/ /smras po de la phyi ma me 'bar ba'i/ /khro chu 'thung dgos 'gyur zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /des na tshe 'dir skom pas rab gdung yang / /sel byed chang ma yin pa'i thabs mang phyir/ /phyi ma'i khro chu som dang spongs bar rigs/ /kye ma dus ngan snyigs ma'i thos pa 'ga'/ /bstan 'gro bsam pa'i mthar phyin mi byed par/ /rang la rab 'byams pa zhes gzhan dag gis/ /sgrog pa'i tshig la zhen pa 'di nyid kyang / /bdud kyi byin rlabs yin snyam bdag dogs so/ /kyi hud deng sang dus kyi sngags 'chang 'ga'/ /la la dbang ma thob pa grol byed bsgom/ /'ga' zhig dbang bskur thob kyang sdom pa yis/ /dbye ba thob 'tshams rtsa ltung sbyangs gzhi dang / /sbyongs byed don rnams cung zad mi shes na'ang / /chog bsgrigs tsam re smra rgyu yod pa la/ /nged cag rdo rje 'dzin pa yin no zhes/

/kun la sgrog cing tshe gang dkor rdzas las/ /gzhan pa'i sdig med bza' btung dang bral ba'i/ /gang zag 'di ni chos mdzad dor bya'i yul/ /gzhon nu rab byung tshul khrims rnam dag ldan/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /dam pa'i drung las man ngag mdzod bzung nas/ /don gnyis bsgrub la ngal ba lhur len de/ /gang na bzhugs kyang kho bos mchod pa'i gnas/ /des na blo ldan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /zhu don snying po bsdus na 'di ltar ste/ /thog mar thos pa'i sgro 'dogs mthar phyin chod/ /bar du dam pa'i gdam ngag yongs rdzogs nos/ /tha mar don gnyis bsgrub la sems khur bskyed/ /rgyun du sangs rgyas bstan pa snying khong 'chongs/ /chos bzhin byed na de las bya rgyu med/ /de las ldog na chos pa min par go /de bzhin thugs la zhog mdzod dge 'dun rnams/ /phyag tu bzhes shig thub bstan lha chen pa/ /de skad 'di ni spyi dang bye brag gis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin srog ltar gces 'dzin pa'i/ /'khon rigs shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang lhas/ /rje bzung kun dga'i bsod nams mdzod 'dzin zhing / /grags pas yongs khyab sangs rgyas bstan pa yis/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin 'dod dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs/ /mang po'i byin rlabs bzang po shes rgyud la/ /zhugs pa de yi dag pa'i sems kyis bris/ /bdag 'dra dam pa'i rigs su skyes mod kyang / /blo gros sbyangs pa chung pas khyed rnams la/ /'di ltar zhu ba'i 'os su ma gyur mod/ /'on kyang bstan pa bsam nas spel ba la/ /nongs pa mchis na 'dus pa'i tshogs la bshags/ /dge bas bstan pa rab tu rgyas gyur cig /yang smras pa/ rdul 'dres lcags phye khab len rdo yi len par nus kyi rdo phal gzhan gyis de ltar min/ chos kun blang dor mkhas pa dag gis bya bar nus kyi blun po rnams kyis spyod yul min/ de 'dra'i mkhas pa mdo rgyud pha rol phyin la 'byung gi rang dgar gnas la ci nas 'byung /

/de bas na blo ldan rnams ni legs par gson dang thos la nan tan mi rigs sam/ /gling bzhi'i mun pa nyi zla nyid kyis gsal bar nus kyi rgyu skar gzhan gyis de ltar min/ /khams gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren pa sa skya pa ste 'dren pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/ /des na yongs 'dzin 'di 'dra'i bstan pa'i rjes su 'jug pa grangs med bsod nams mthu las byung / /e ma 'di 'dra'i ngo mtshar tshul la spro ba bskyed las dam chos bsgrub dang thar 'dod rnams/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //thub bstan lha chen gyis cho 'phrul zla ba'i smon lam chen mo'i skabs su smras pa'i legs bshad bzhugs/179 shau dhau dā niḥ bud+dha dh+wa dza ya na mo/ 'dir smras pa/ rab tu 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen du/ /rab mang dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /rab bzang dus ldan cho 'phrul zla ba la/ /rab 'byams chos spyod 'brug sgra ldir ba yis/ /sngon bsags dge ba'i 'bras 'di e ma mtshar/ /'on kyang 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun phal che bas/ /sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar ma mthong zhing / /mthong yang yongs 'dzin mkhas dang ma 'phrad pas/ /bstan la phan zhing rang gzhan dus kun du/ /bde ba bsgrub 'dod 'di ni srid pa tsam/ /de phyir kho bos bstan dang rang gzhan la/ /phan phyir snying gtam mdor bsdus bshad kyi nyon/ /thog mar shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la/ /brtson 'grus drag pos sbyangs pa mthar phyin bya/ /der rjes yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen mang bsten nas/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod dang ldan par bya/ /der rjes rang nyid 'bad pas nyams len zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo phyogs med rab bskor te/ /brgyud 'dzin bshes gnyen skar phran ltar mang bas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di yongs su khyab par bya/ /de ltar bdag gi legs bshad 'di lta'i don/ /lag tu blang na dal 'byor don yod lags/ /de phyir zang zing kho na don gnyer sogs/ /blun po'i spyod yul rnams las ldog mdzod la/

/kho bo'i legs bshad don dag blang bar rigs/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun bsod ces/ /yongs grags blo gros gsal ba gang de'o/ /'dis kyang chos grwa chen po 'dir bshes gnyen dam pa mang du 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gling dga' bde ba can gyi chos grwa chen po'i bca' yig bzhugs/180 bhaṭ+ṭa rā ka dharmā swa mi bud+dha dh+wa dza ye na ma: dge legs kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bar gcod kun sel chos skyong srung ma yis/ /gnas 'dir 'phral dang yun du bde legs mdzod/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir gling dga' bde ba can gyi chos grwa chen po'i bca' yig mdor bsdus bri bar bya'o/ /de la spyir sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las/ dge 'dun gyi sde bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la rag las par bshad cing / /de lta bu'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rtsod pa dang bral ba sngon byon pa dag gis legs par btab pa'i dgon gnas chos grwa 'di rnams deng sang gi bstan pa stobs kyi 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mchog dag gis gces spras su bgyis na 'gro ba thams cad kyi srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa'i gzhir 'gyur bar bshad pa 'di ni nges pa'i don dang ldan pa yin pas deng sang gi dus kyi bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba dag de lta bu'i bstan pa'i bya ba la gus pa dang brtag pa'i sbyor bas 'phral dang yun du 'bad par rigs te/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ ci'i phyir zhe na rgyal ba yis/ /rin chen chos kyang dkon la ni/ /rtag tu 'tshe ba mang zhes gsungs/ /'di la soms la mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtag tu bstan pa'i byi dor bya/

/nyi ma gcig gi bza' btung la'ang / /bzang ngan rtog dpyod sna tshogs ltos/ /gos dang mkhar las la sogs pa/ /bya ba gang la'ang legs nyes dang / /bzang ngan mkhas dang mi mkhas zhes/ /blang dor rtog dpyod sna tshogs byed/ /rta dang bong bu la sogs pa/ /cung zad tsam gyi nyo tshong la'ang / /kun la 'dri zhing rtag nas spyod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad la'ang / /de 'dra'i 'bad pa byed pa mthong / /skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni/ /dam pa'i chos la rag las kyang / /chos 'di khyi yi zas bzhin du/ /bzang ngan gang du'ang mi spyod par/ /gang 'phrad de la gus pa 'dzin/ /nyin gcig gi ni skyel ma'am/ /tshe gcig gi ni nye 'brel la'ang / /'bad de brtags nas len pa mthong / /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas ma thob par gyi don/ /zhes pa nas/ kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar/ /'bad mi dgos pa 'bad pa byed/ /'bad dgos chos dang bla ma ni/ /ci yang rung bas tshim par snang / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na da res skabs su babs pa rang re rnams kyi dgon gnas bde ba can gyi chos grwa chen po 'di nyid rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' bzhin rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis thugs dgongs rnam par dag pas spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang / /lhag par byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir gnas pa'i/ bya ri dwags nya sgo nga sogs sems can mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon dang / skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs dam par dmigs te 'debs par mdzad pa nas bzung / bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'dren pa dam pa mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i bar du byon pa'i mkhan brgyud mtshungs pa med pa de dag gi sku ring la dgon gnas chen po 'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis kyang /

bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la rtse gcig du bgyis pa la brten nas/ spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gyur te byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di rdzogs ldan ltar bde ba'i khyab pa de yin/ deng sang gi dus 'dir bstan pa 'grib la thug pas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon gnas che phra phal cher gyi bca' khrims rnams lo re bzhin lhod par 'gyur ba zhig 'dug pa na/ 'dir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun la yang 'khrul zad gong ma rnams kyi bcas pa'i bka' khrims kyi rgyun bzang po mtha' dag mi nyams pa'i phyir/ gsal 'debs kyi tshul gyi cung zad brjod na/ 'dir bzhugs kyi 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams 'phral dang yun du gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas pa'i steng / thos bsam gyi rgyud phyug par byas nas zab mo'i don nyams su len pa la rtse gcig tu mdzad 'tshal te/ de ltar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las mang du gsungs pas/ /bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa'i phyir 'dul ba las gsungs pa ltar gyi chos gos rnam gsum/ min na'ang 'dul ba yul chos dang bstun gsungs pa ltar/ ring 'gag rngul gzan/ thang sham/ zhwa ser/ gding ba/ zla gam rnams tshang 'grig 'byor pa byas tshogs la 'du dgos yin zhing zhwa gding tsam med na brgya phyag dang / thang sham sogs med cing / /stod brjen/ rdo bem/ 'bob zon/ 'bar zhwa/ thul gzan tsam gyon byung na tshogs la rtsa ba nas 'dur mi 'jug rtsis med kyi 'dus pa byung na/ las tshan rnams kyis mgrin gcig dang ngo lkog med par mar zho re blangs nas dkar mer 'bul/ de lta bu'i phyi'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa las ma g.yos pa'i ngos/ nang gi bslab pa 'dul ba sum brgya par/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang /

/mi tshangs spyod rdzun bcos ma'i chang la sogs/ /gar sogs phreng sogs mal chen mtho ba dang / /phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul len pa spangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dge tshul/ dge slong gi bslab bya'i gtso bo rags sdom bcur 'dus/ de yang rtsa ba bzhi la bskyar nas yan lag rnams tshang na sdom pa rtsa ba nas gtong bas/ 'chab sems kyis gos par byas la bskyar nas len/ lhag ma drug la yan lag rnams tshang tshe bshags bya'i nyes byas su 'gyur bar bshad pas/ rang sems dpang por bzhag pa'i bshags sdom gyi rtsis zin par byed/ lhag par bslab pa thams cad bag med par byed pa'i gzhi nyes pa ma lus pa bskyed par byed pa'i rtsa ba ni chang yin te/ mdo las/ chang ni rtswa'i mchog mas kyang mi blud mi 'thung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas chos byed rnams kyi dug can gyi zas ltar spangs bya'i gtso bor bshad kyang / deng sang bstan pa nyams su 'dod pas dkor gyi myos shing nag phyogs kyis rgyud bslad pa'i ngan pa dag lhan cig du 'dus nas chang la bag med du spyod cing / rang re nang gtsang yin pas 'di tsam gyis ci skyon gzhan la zab gyis zer ba 'di 'dra'i rigs can shin tu mang bar gda' ste/ sdom ldan rnams kyis myos 'gyur bag med 'thung ba lta ci smos/ cung zad tsam gyis kyang dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes nas khro chu khol ma dbang med du 'thung dgos pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing / sangs rgyas la rdzun ga la mnga' ste/ 'bras med phyir na rdzun mi gsungs/ /zhes bshad pa ltar yin la/ des na dmyal bar 'gro ba'i nang gtsang la dgos pa e 'dug sems yod rnams legs par som dang / des na da phyin chad nag chang bag med 'grims pa lta ci smos/ dgon pa'i tho khong su sgrub mchod skongs dus ma gtogs chang gtan nas mi 'grims/ de las 'gal ba byung na las tshan mgrin gcig pas chad pa char re la mar zho do res 'gel/ gzhan chang mang nyung la spags 'gel lugs byas 'jam tshul la 'debs/

nag mo'i cha ma bu yin nges kyi bu nad drag pos bzung ba lta bu'i mi sdod kha med shar na ma gtogs dgon par zhag tu mi bsdod/ 'gal ba byung na las tshan mgrin gcig par bkod pas khyab pa byas/ thab ka ba rnams kyi khrims shing la nyin re sgrog rje gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa de dag gi dus dran gyi mchod par lo re bzhin dgos pa'i kyai rdor/ bde mchog nag po pa/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ bde mchog lū hi pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ /rdo rje phur pa/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ gsang 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog bde kye gnyis kyi bla mchod/ rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog kye rdor rtsa rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ tshe dpag med lha dgu/ kun rig bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang / yang kun rig gzhan phan mtha' yas te/ rgyud 'don sgrub mchod rnams dang / brgyud 'debs so so rnams dang / mtshan brjod sogs chos spyod che phra thams cad dbu mdzad chen mo/ byang 'dren/ chos khrims gsum dang / bla brang nas sku tshab re dang bcas pas grwa pa zhal grangs bdun las mi mang ba gzhung so so rgyugs gnon ngo lkog med par byed dgos yin/ gso ma'i lo gzhung rnams tshang 'grig med kyang kha ltas khyab pa tsam byed/ gzhan ma bkra shis yan tshangs 'grig med tshe tshogs la 'ur 'don mi ster/ sgrub mchod rang rang la dgos pa'i dbu brgyan/ rdor dril/ dpa' bo'i thod bcings/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ dar dpyangs sogs gang dgos bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan nges pa so so nas blo khur bskyed la tshang 'grig gal che/ tshang 'grig ma byung tshe gdan non skal ba phyed las mi ster gzhan ma ma tshang ba mang nyung la spags pa'i 'gel lugs byed/ rgyun pa'i mang ja 'jam tshugs sogs la sbyin bdag gi rim gro gsal kha byung na ma gtogs/ chos spyod rnams sngar 'khyud gang yod rnams bsre lhad med par smin rgyas rang byang 'dren pas sems khur bskyed de nan tan gyis bsgrub pa dang /

de la 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis kyang le lo dang sgyid lug med par lus sems rtse gcig pas/ bstan pa dang sems can snying khongs su bcangs pa'i dad 'dun drags pos mgrin gcig tu mdzad 'tshal te/ dgon gnas gang du yang rgyun pa'i chos spyod 'di la rel shor byung tshe sa phyogs der 'khrug long dang rim nad sogs mi mthun pa'i rkyen sna tshogs 'byung ba myong bas grub legs pas khe nyen thugs la bzhag pa'i spangs bzhes 'dzol med cis kyang mdzod/ gzhan yang grwa tshangs du ba glang bong bu ra lug rnams rgyun du mi bsten/ dgon pa'i tho khongs su mda' rdo mchong gsum rgyang 'bod kyi ku co sogs dgon pa'i mig ltos la gnod pa'i bya ba nam yang mi byed cing / byas pa byung na lo bcu gsum man chad la bang chen sogs rkang 'gro'i chad pa tshab che chung la spags nas 'gel/ lo sum cu man rkang 'gro mi lcogs pa rnams la mar nyag bdun re gong bkod ltar 'gel/ tshe mtshams pa dang bsnyen mtshams pa sogs gtan bzhugs kyi grwa pa rnams gong du phud pa'i/ gzhan ma grwa pa bying rnams ston zla gsum dang dpyid zla gsum ma gtogs/ rgyun par gtan bzhugs mdzad dgos yin/ grwa khang rnams rang rang gi bdag tu bzung ba rnams so so nas thun tshags bdag rkyen yang dag byed pa dang / bdag med byung na las tshan ngos ma dang bcas pa gros su bstun nas grwa pa 'jug lugs byed/ ri rgya klung rgya'i cha chos gzhis nang khul nas byas pa byung na sha tshangs su khyi khrid kyi dpes nag chen du 'dug pas dran 'dzin phyi lam khegs pa gtong dgos yin zhing / dpon go mi cig pa nas 'gal ba byung na lugs gnyis thad nas sngar 'khyud las mi g.yel ba'i srung rgya le lor ma shor ba byed/ ci ste ma thub pa byung na khrims sar thug pa las/ 'os med/ mdor na 'dir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun bgres pa rnams kyi gzhon pa rnams la blang dor gyi gnas rnams mi shes pa gong phud/

shes pa dwangs len gyi bstan pa dgon gnas dang bcas pa snying khongs su bcangs pa'i legs slob nyes bcos tshul bzhin du bgyid pa da nga / gzhon pa rnams kyis kyang dwangs len yang dag bgyis ngos mig ltos la phan pa'i bkur skyong go ma log pa'i spangs blang 'jol med/ mgo 'og tu lus tshud pa zhig so so nas nges pa gal che/ de ltar gong bkod kyi bca' khrims de rnams la yi ge 'di nang las ma g.yos pa'i blang dor gyi do dam yang dag ngos ma sbrel po las tshan rnams dang bcas pas ngo lkog med par bstan pa dgos gnas bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa snying khongs su bcug pa byed dgos yin/ dge 'dun bying gyi yang bstan pa ma bsam/ ngos ma sbrel po dang las tshan so so'i yang ngo dga' sogs la bltas sems khur ma bskyed/ nged rang gis kyang bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa snying nas ma bsam pa'i bag med kyi spyod pas gnas nas/ sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis thugs kyi khrel bar 'gyur zhing / de ltar gyur na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la ring du byed pas/ de ltar nges pa'i spang blang 'dzol med cis kyang gal che/ rgyu mtshan des na dge 'dun gyi dpang por las tshan rnams yod/ las tshan rnams kyi dpang por nged rang yod/ nged rang gi dpang por dkon mchog rnams yod pa yin pas de bzhin nges 'tshal te/ spyod 'jug las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /kun du thogs med gzigs par ldan/ /de dag rnams kyi spyan sngar ni/ /bdag ni mngon par gnas so zhes/ /de ltar shes nas ngo tsha dang / /gus dang 'jigs ldan de ltar gnas/ /zhes gsungs shing / mgon po byams pas kyang / 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas so/ /zhes gling dga' bde ba can gyi chos grwa chen po'i bca' yig mdor bsdus 'di ni sa bcu'i byang sems bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul pa rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs 'dzin dam pa 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa de nyid gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa du mas thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba'i blo gros can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

rje sems dpa' chen po dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa me mo sbrul gyi lo gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon gnas chen po 'di btab nas bzung mi lo brgya dang brgyad cu gya gcig 'das pa'i gya gnyis pa sa pho rta'i lo/ nag pa zla ba'i dmar cha rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la gling dga' bde ba can gyi sa'i cha/ yang dben bsam gtan phug gi rje sems dpa' chen po nas bzung mkhan brgyud rim par byon pa rnams dang / sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs skyes chen dam pa du ma'i gzim phug chos kyi pho brang chen por legs par sbyar ba 'dis bstan pa dang sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig 'dir smras pa/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /dri med gsung rab gling la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa bzang po'i zhabs/ /gang gi sras kyi thu bos 'gro 'di srungs/ /mgon khyod dang por kun mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bar du sa bcu'i byang sems kun dga'i mtshan/ /dus 'dir dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /kun gyis 'gran zla bral la kun nas dad/ /lhag bsam rnam dag chu gter las 'ongs pa'i/ /tshar du dngar ba'i legs bshad chu skyes 'dis/ /blo gsal 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi bung ba rnams/ /tshim nas legs bshad dar dir sgrog gyur cig /kho bo sngon bsags las kyi 'phro bzang bas/ /gtsang ma'i rigs skyes gzhon dus rab tu byung / /skyes chen dam pa du mas rjes bzung zhing / /lhag par dus gsum mkhyen pa bud+dha'i mtshan/ /gang gi ngo mtshar rnam thar cha shas 'ga'/ /thos pa tsam gyis mjal 'dod bcos min skyes/ /de ltar dad dang 'dun pa'i cang shes rta/ /yongs 'dzin thugs rje'i lcags gis nyer bskul te/ /ring por ma lon chu brag g.yang gsum gyi/ /bgrod dka'i lam la zhum pa med pa'i blos/ /'brel tshad don ldan bla ma'i drung du 'ong / /e ma legs byas gom pa mi dman pas/

/mjal ma thag nas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /zab yangs gsung gi bdud rtsi ngom par 'thung / /sngon sbyangs blo yis shes bya'i gnas kun rig /skye ngan drag po'i gnod pas mi rdzi ba'i/ /zab mo'i nyams len bsgom pa'i skal bar ldan/ /'di ni 'phral dang yun du legs pa'i gzhi/ /ngo mtshar tshul 'di mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin/ /bka' drin 'khor mtha' med pa'i mus pa rje/ /mgon po khyod kyi dad ldan slob bu bdag /byang chub bar du brtse bas legs bskyangs te/ /dus 'dir bstan pa rin chen bya ba kun/ /'phral dang yun du 'bad med mthar phyin nas/ /brgyud 'dzin bshes gnyen nyi zla lta bu yis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di yongs su khyab gyur cig /legs par smra ba 'di ma mā puṇ+ya dzñā na shrī bhu ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ sarba maṅgalaṃ/ nyams dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa mi dbang chos rgyal chen po mnyes par byed pa'i mchod rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/181 na mo gu ru/ rje 'khrul zhig pu ṇ+ya in+d+ra dang / /'gro yongs la brtse ba'i sngags 'chang rje/ /thugs brtse ba'i mnga' bdag mthu stobs mtshan/ /skyabs kun 'dus rang rig bla ma mkhyen/ /don skye med myur du rtogs par shog /khyed chos rgyal chen po snyan gson dang / /dus da lo'i 'gyur ba 'di 'dra la/ /yid bsam mno zhib tu btang tsa na/ /don chos bzhin byed pa'i gang zag gis/ /las byas tshad mtha' ru mi 'khyol bar/ /don sdig pa'i las kyis dus 'da' zhing / /las byas tshad chos dang 'gal ba yis/ /dus phyi ma rgyab skyur gang zag gis/ /don bsam tshad 'bad med 'grub pa 'di/ /rgyu dus ngan snyigs ma'i rtags su go /mi bdag gi zhang po khyed nyid kyi/ /dus deng sang skabs kyi gnas tshul la/ /kho 'jig rten pa yi ltar snang du/ /tshul 'di la ngal ba ci zhig 'tshal/ /chos snying nas go ba'i gang zag gis/ /don snang tshad lam du 'khyer nus na/ /rang dben par mnyam rjes bsgom sla bas/

/don mngon sum lag tu long bar gda'/ /spyir 'jig rten 'di 'dra 'gyur sla bas/ /thugs ngal ba cung zad mi bgyid 'tshal/ /sgos dkon mchog thugs rje'i mi bslu bas/ /dus rgyun du gsol 'debs brtson pa zhu/ /thugs bsam don 'grub pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /de 'grub phyir srung ma 'bad de mchod/ /lar sdig spyod rgyal po'i dar rgyas la/ /thugs bsam mno thong la gzigs mdzod dang / /khong 'di phyi gnyis ka mi blta bas/ /tshul de na snying rje'i yul du gda'/ /spyir bslu med dkon mchog thugs rje dang / /sgos sa skya'i bka' srung mthu myur bas/ /khyed sngar bzhin rgyal srid rab rgyas na/ /dpal sa skya'i bstan pa thugs khongs su/ /rab 'chong la sngar bzhin g.yel med mdzod/ don myur du 'grub par dkon mchog mkhyen/ /bdag dal 'byor lus thob chos sgor zhugs/ /sngon sbyangs pa'i skyes thob shes rab che/ /da mdo rgyud thos bsam byed pa 'di/ /chos drang don ltar na nyams re dga'/ /don nges don gtan la phab tsa na/ /nang gsal rig ngo la tshur bltas pas/ /gdod brjod bral skye med nyid du mthong / /phyi yi snang kun de'i shugs kyi zhig /rgyu des na thar pa'i bde ba dang / /lan ngan pa dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la/ /mi kho bos blang dor ngo ma shes/ /he a kyang ku re zhus pa lags/ /mi bdag la de 'dra'i re med mod/ /don go na de ltar yin par gda'/ /skyabs mchog gyur dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /bdag mdo rgyud thos bsam mthar phyin te/ /spyir bstan dang khyad par sa skya pa'i/ /bstan mun khung sgron me sbar ba bzhin/ /mi bdag gis gsal bar nus pa dang / /don mtha' ru 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ mi dbang chos rgyal chen po nam mkha' tshe dbang phun tshogs dbang gi dbang po zhes yongs la grags pa gang de'i/ spyir bstan pa yongs dang khyad par sa skya pa'i bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i skabs su/

dus ngan snyigs pas nag phyogs cung zad rgyal ba'i shugs kyis bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gis zhabs 'dren tshab ches la brten/ dpal sa skyar re zhig bzhugs pa'i bar la/ 'khon rigs shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lha khang chen mo'i steng nor rgyas su myur bar bris te nyi thung du phul ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni sa skya gzim chung pa bsod nams tshe ring gis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //mi dbang bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po'i sde'i phyag tu phul ba'i yi ge yod/182 phyag bris zhib bkod 'byor pas gnas tshul nges par byung legs shing / gong ma'i legs bshad la brten nas thugs 'byung drag po byung ba ngo mtshar che/ rgyal sras par ma zad de 'dra ba yang yod lags/ cis kyang dge bsnyen la thugs bzhed 'dug pa/ spyir dge bsnyen la skyabs su 'dzin pa/ sna gcig spyod pa/ sna 'ga' spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen/ tshangs spyod/ go mi dge bsnyen rnams su yod la/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi bslab bya ni/ sdom brgyad las/ ji srid 'tsho bar gsod dang rku/ /log par g.yem dang rdzun dang ni/ /chang gi btung ba rnams las ldog /ces pa ltar las sna gcig spyod pa sogs ni de dag gcig tsam spongs ba sogs la 'jog pa lags/ tshangs spyod la de'i steng du mi tshangs spyod spongs dgos la/ go ma'i dge bsnyen ni bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung ba la bshad cing / gang ltar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa logs su bdag rang gis ma thob kyang dge tshul bsgrub dus kyi des go chod par snang bas dgongs sbyar zhu lags/ bsnyen gyi sdom pa dgos gsungs ba/ spyir gso sbyong dang bsnyen gnas don gcig la/ de len pa'i cho ga chos mngon pa nas bshad pa dang / theg chen don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa nas bshad pa gnyis yod cing / de'i bslab bya ni rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga/

khri stan che mtho dus min gyi zas/ glu gar rol mo rgyan byug pa sogs spongs dgos par bshad cing / sdom pa de rang gis len pa dang / gzhan las len pa'i lugs gnyis las gzhan las lon na/ bye brag tu smra ba ltar na dge slong dang / mdo sde pa ltar na dge bsnyen sogs las len par bshad la/ rgyu mtshan des na bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa khyim pa las blangs yang btub par 'dug gsungs 'dug kyang / bslab bya sogs gang nas bsam yang mi rung ba 'dra lags/ 'di'i sdom pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bzhes na ni go mi'i dge bsnyen du 'gro bar 'dug cing / de 'dra'i rgyun ni bod du ma dar ba 'dra lags nyin zhag re ka bzhes par dgongs na rang gi len tshul gyi cho ga bzhin mdzad pas chog par snang lags/ 'di dag mdo'i lung sogs dang sbyar nas mtha' chod zhib rgyas zhig 'bul 'dod kyang yi ges 'jigs nas 'dir ma spros lags/ mi 'gyur ba dgos zhus pa dge ba la nan bskul tsam ma gtogs/ 'gyur dogs zhus pa min lags ha hā/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //mi dbang mthu stobs dbang po la phul ba'i yi ge183 chos rgyal mthu stobs dbang po'i bdes/ /phyag rtags brgya khres bdun dang bcas/ /'byor pas rab dga'i gnas la bkod/ /'dir yang nad med bde bar gnas/ /de bzhin der yang gnas zhes pa/ /thos pas rab dkar dung 'dra'i so/ /skye bo kun la snang bar gyur/ /rang sde nor la brnag pa'i 'bras/ /nyes med thog tu lci ba'i khur/ /bslu med rgya mtshos gsal zhes pa'i/ /gtam de thos pas dga' bde rgyas/ /da dung thabs mkhas du ma yi/ /phugs kyi 'dun ma legs pa'i gnad/ /dka' yang sran gyi blang bar mdzod/ /da res rten du rgya yi dar/ /spar ma rdo rje'i mdud pa can/ /'bul lo dges pas bzhes su gsol/ /zhes 'di shrī sa skya pa/ ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /bsam gtan khang bur bris nas phul/ /dpal yang dag gi sgrub mchod kyi phyag len gyi rim pa'i tho yig mi dbang sa skyong dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/184

oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa'i sgrub mchod gnang ba'i phyag len la/ dpal chen po'i gtor ma rdo rje phur pa dang mthun pa sogs bshom gyi bya ba rnams sngags 'chang chen po'i mdzad pa'i rdul tshon dang ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog dang sgrub thabs sogs nas gsal bar 'byung ba bzhin ma 'khrul bar byas la/ cho ga dngos la/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma dpon slob kun gyis bsgrigs nas mdzad/ gnas yo byin rlabs phur pa bzhin gyi rjes su/ rnga byin dbab tshan pa drug pa gang rigs mdzad rjes/ skyabs 'gro nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad zhes pa'i bar phur pa bzhin mdzad la/ de nas gdug cing sdang sems sogs dang sngags rnams bzla bar rol mo mdzad pa phur ba bzhin/ de nas hūm̐ khro bo rnams sogs dang / hūm̐ nga'i dkyil 'khor sogs la spro na steng yang ma 'jug srung 'khor rdzogs pa yan bsgrigs la/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs rjes rnga brdungs mi mdzad/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs tshig gnyis la bh+yoḥdang hūm̐ 'dren rjes la dang po phud mchod kyi dbyangs bcug na yong bar sems/ de nas 'phags mchog ma'i mgor rol mo bcam la/ nyis rdeg lan bcas blang la/ dbyangs dang mjug gi rol mo chem rdung sogs phur pa bzhin/ de nas sman raka gtor gsum gyi byin rlabs mdzad par mchod g.yog pas bskul ba dang / dpon slob rnams kyis bsgrigs nas mdzad pa sogs phur pa bzhin/ sngags gsum la'ang gdangs phur pa bzhin mdzad/ de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa nas/ bsgrigs te gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i bar phur pa bzhin/ de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i bskyed dbyangs phur pa bzhin du bya ba nas ru lu brjod pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad de nas rol mo chem rdung dang nyis rdeg lan can blangs la/ /gtso bo bskyed pa'i tshig bzhi la dbyangs khor gnyis rol mo dang bcas pa phur pa bzhin/

rdo rje kha ṭ+waṃ zhes pa nas/ ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs/ zhes pa'i bar la sgeg cing ma thung ba'i dbyangs dang / mjug tu rol mo gsum rdeg lan can/ de nas oṃ badz+ra kro ti shwa ra hūm̐/ zhes rnga rdung dang bcas bsgrigs la yum chen khro mo sogs tshigs bcad gcig la phur pa bzhin gyi dbyangs rol/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga nas 'khyud par bzhugs kyi bar sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang rol mo byed/ shar du gaṃ las zhes pa nas tshig drug la dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol/ byang du baṃ las zhes pa nas/ dbus na bzhugs kyi bar la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang rol mo mdzad/ de nas rnga rdung bzhag la/ rang lus rten dang brten par zhes pa nas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas rol mo brtsams la gsum rdeg lan bcas blangs la/ sems nyid ye shes sogs tshigs bcad gcig la gser skyems kyi dbyangs dang mjug tu rol mo gsum rdeg dang chem rdung gi bar la sngags 'don/ de nas gsum rdeg lan bcas/ de nas gsal ba'i mi 'gyur sogs tshigs bcad gcig la yang dag don du'i dbyangs dang rol mo/ rtog med spros bral sogs la'ang dbyangs rol yang dag don du bzhin byas la/ de nas rnga rol bzhag ste/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las zhes pa nas rigs lnga yab yum gyi dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar dang / shwa ri a zhes pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas bcom ldan dpal chen sogs la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs ring ba dang rol mo gsum rdeg lan bcas kyi mjug tu chem rdung dang che ba nyis rdeg de nas sgeg phreng glu gar sogs phur pa bzhin/ rang byung gdod nas dbyangs bcas phur pa bzhin bsgrigs la/ byang chub 'khril ba'i mchod chen ma'i dbyangs/ mchog tu sogs dang / rtog med spros bral sogs nas/ kha hi khā hi zhes pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas rnga rdung dang bcas rmad du byung ba'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig la gur drag gi bla med mchod pa'i dbyangs 'jug

mjug tu rol mo gsum rdeg chem rdung gi bar la sngags 'don/ de nas che ba nyis rdeg rak+ta dmar gyi sogs la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang rol mo gsum rdeg gi rjes la chem rdung / de'i rjes su dad ring gi mgo'i rol mo brgyad rdung che chung 'bab 'dzeg sogs phyag len bzhin byas la/ bde gshegs mnyam nyid sogs tshig bzhi la dad ring dbyangs 'khor gnyis rol mo dang bcas mdzad rnam dag sku la sogs bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs rol/ mjug me long mnyam nyid las/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar la dpal gyi pho nya thung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mo mdzad/ dpal chen 'khor bcas zhes pa nas/ thob par shog gi bar la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung dang / mjug tu rol mo gsum rdeg lan bcas/ chem rdung gi rjes su che ba nyis rdeg de nas rol mo rnams bzhag snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin zhes pa nas rang la thim zhes pa'i bar bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas dpal chen thugs kyi zhes pa nas/ ma tshogs sprin dang skar ltar 'phro zhes pa'i bar gur drag gi thugs kha'i phyag rdor sogs kyi gdangs ring tsam byas 'jug de nas hūm̐ chen nyi zla sogs nas bskul mtshams gcig byas la/ de nas tshad med bzhi zhes pa'i bar la gdangs de ka 'jug yang bh+yo:ni gnas 'gyur zhes pa la bskul mtshams gcig byas la/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo:hūm̐/ zhes pa yan la gdangs de ka cung thung ba zhig bcug la/ de nas ru lu sum brgya dang / kro ti shwa ri brgya rtsa/ 'khor rnams nyer gcig re bzla/ de nas bzlas pa bsdus rjes yig brgya lan gsum/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ de gtso bo yab yum la thim zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ de na sa lha phur pa bzhin la/ rol mo bsgrigs 'don gdangs sogs phur pa bzhin mdzad la/ lha sta gon la a mṛ tas bsang nas brtsams/ rten dang brten par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/

ye shes pa bstim pa/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs rigs lnga re res dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar yan rnga rol sogs med pa bsgrigs 'don gang 'grig phur pa'i lha sta gon dang dbyibs 'dra bar mdzad la/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs/ phyi mchod nang mchod de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams bsgrigs 'don mdzad la/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ bde gshegs mnyam nyed zhes pa nas/ lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi bstod la/ de nas dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pa snyan gsan dbab pa kyai rdor bzhin dang / dpal ldan bla ma nas/ stsal du gsol gyi dril bu rgyun dkrol sa lha bzhin mdzad der rjes bum bskyed bsgrig lugs phur pa sgra ji bzhin dang / de nas gtor bsngo bskang gso sogs nas gtor 'bul grub pa yan chad spyi dang 'dra ba mdzad la/ mjug chog gi bsgrig lugs gzhan phur ba bzhin la bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i sogs dang dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang dge ba bsngo ba rnams bsgrigs nas bya'o/ /de yan gyi sta gon gyi cho ga'i bsgrig rim mdo tsam bstan zin to// ༈ //da ni sgrub mchod dngos gzhi'i phyag len bshad par bya ste/ de'ang bshom gyi tshogs ni ras bris rdul tshon gang la brten na'ang de dang 'brel ba'i yig cha nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ de nas sgrub pa po rnams gral la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung bzlas pa bsdus de dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i bar gzhan sta gon bzhin la gdan bskyed pa'i rjes su rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gdan steng du 'bab lugs la tshig zur cung zad bsgyur ba sogs/ mdor na bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i tshul gyis sgrub tshul dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ brgyud 'debs mdzad na skabs 'dir mdzad/ de nas rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis ka'i skur bsgyur te/ phyi rol gtor ma gtong ba'i bsgrigs 'don rnga rdung dbyangs rol sogs phur pa sgra ji bzhin dang /

/nang du log te rol mo'i bar bskor ba mdzad pa'am phur pa bzhin/ de rjes cho ga nyin re la tshar gnyis re mdzad na snga chog dang / tshar re mdzad na dngos gzhi'i dang po'i nyin ma gtogs pa'i phyi ma rnams la sta gon gyi skabs bzhin gyi bum bskyed mdzad/ de nas bdag 'jug la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas bzung / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul yan chad la tshig rigs rnams sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i sgrub mchod byed tshul gyi tho nas 'byung ba'i nang bzhin dang / bsgrigs 'don mdzad lugs rol mo dril gsil sogs thams cad kyai rdor dang phur pa'i bdag 'jug gi skabs su ji ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len bzhin mdzad pas chog par snang zhing / sngags 'chang chen po'i tho yig der ye shes dbab pa kyai rdor bzhin 'dug kyang / nged rang zhal ngo rnams kyi phyag len la phur pa bzhin mdzad pas de bde ba yong bas dgongs zhugs zhu zhing / mi bskyod pas dbang gi sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang la che ba'i yon tan ma'i gdangs bcug pas khyab par mchis/ bdag 'jug grub nas gtor bsngo bskang gso mjug chog sogs spyi dang mthun par mdzad/ sta gon dngos gzhi sogs gang la yang tshogs 'khor mdzad na phur pa bzhin gtor 'bul gyi gong / rdo glu bkra shis sogs dril sil grub rjes/ oṃ dra byam bi shwa dha na sogs dang / der rjes rol mo brtsams nas spyan 'dren mchod pa bshags pa rnams la rol mo gdangs sogs gur drag gi tshogs 'khor lugs bzhin mdzad/ 'di'i mchod pa'i skabs su a la la ho bzhes su gsol/ zhes pa'i rjes su rol mo len tshogs zhu ba ni gur drag bzhin/ mjug chog gi bkra shis kyi rol mo grub rjes mchod g.yog pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsol tshogs khyer la/ ho bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon dang sogs gdangs dang bcas pa gur drag bzhin dpon slob kun gyis mdzad la tshogs la longs spyod/

lhag ma nyin re bzhin bsdud pa phur pa bzhin sgrub mchod nyi ma snga ma rnams la bshags pa'i rol mo grub rjes thun gtor 'bul ba mdzad/ nub tha ma'i tshe gur drag bzhin tshogs grub 'phral liṅga gur drag ltar bcos pa la dgug gzhug sgrub thabs bzhin lan gsum mdzad rjes/ rol mo chem rdung de ka'i ngang nas slob dpon gyi phur pa blangs la rol mo dgu rdung gcig bya zhing / slar yang chem rdung ngos phur pa 'debs pa sgrol gris ling ga gtub pa gur drag bzhin mdzad la rol mo bzhi rdung blang ste/ bla ma la sogs tshigs bcad gcig la phyi nang gsang ba ma'i dbyangs rol dang / mjug tu chem rdung dang che ba nyis rdeg de nas dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ma ltar na skabs 'dir sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gyi tshogs bkye bsdu dang lhag ma btang la/ de nas steng du gtor 'bul bstan skyong sogs mdzad la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol mdzad tshul tho yig nas 'byung ba ltar dang / ras bris ltar na ling ga sgral mchod kyi rjes su mjug chog btang / tshogs la longs spyod cing lhag ma byas la/ de nas steng du gtor 'bul bstan skyong rgyas par byas na legs par sems so/ /bstan skyong la ho bod khams sogs nas bsgrig lugs sogs phur pa bzhin la mgo'i rol mo bcom pa dang / tshig bcad phyed dang gnyis nam rdzogs la dbyangs phur pa bzhin gyi rjes su rol mo thog mar bzhi rdung dgu rdung / yang bzhi rdung sogs thams cad phur pa bzhin gyi rjes su chem rdung sogs kyang phur pa dang 'dra bar mdzad do/ /'di nyid kyi slob dpon du 'os pa'i gang zag ni/ rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin zhing / 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa zhig gi bya rung ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung las 'byung ba bzhin shin tu 'thad par sems te/ dper na gsang sngags gsar 'gyur gyi ma rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bde kye sogs mchog bsgrub pa'i lha gang yang rung ba zhig gi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas/

gsang 'dus sogs pha rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon byar rung ba dang tshul mtshungs par sems shing / spyir yang dag 'di nyid sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la brten pa'i man ngag zab mo khyad par can yin par snang ste/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsang sngags rnying ma ba 'ga' zhig dang 'brel gtam mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gi zegs ma rnams chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyis bkod pa'i yi ge las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsung gis/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i zhus lan gnang byung ba la/ nged kyi chos rje sa bzang 'phags par zhes kyang rgyud gsang rnying sogs dang / khro bo dam pa rgyan/ zhi ba rin chen dra ba la sogs gzhung du ma nyan/ zhi ba 'di gsang rnying dang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud la brten par 'dug khro bo 'di gsang rnying dang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la brten par 'dug cing / gzhung 'di gnyis grub chen sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad nges par snang / zhi ba rdo rje las rim dang / khro bo rdo rje las rim gnyis kyang gzhung khyad par du 'phags par 'dug snying po bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su khā dzñā na dha tu a zhes pa 'di sngags don bzang po rang cig snang ste/ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ bo dhi tsit+ta byang chub kyi sems/ /mahā su khā bde ba chen po/ dzñā na dha tu dbyings dang ye shes te/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba chen po zhes 'bod cing / /bdag la yang de ltar rtogs pa bskyed cig pa/ a sa bon yin tshod du 'dug ru lu bsgyur rgyu med/ gzungs kyi tshig ces bya ba yin te/ bde mchog pa'i nye snying lta bu'o/ /ru lu 'di mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud nas mang du gsungs/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya rdo rje phur pa zhes 'bod cing bskul/ bos nas ci byed na/ sarba bigh+nān baṃ bgegs thams cad 'ching shig

hūm̐ sa bon/ phaṭ khos cig pa yin/ spyir da ltar gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum nas 'byung ba'i rgyud gsang 'dus sogs/ snga 'gyur gyi dus su 'byung ba'i rgyud rnam dag la/ rnying ma ba'i brda chad la/ sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud rdo rje bdud rtsi/ /'phrin las kyi rgyud karmā ma la/ /kha skong gi rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnams rgyud khyad du 'phags pa 'dug karmā ma la nga yi ma mthong / sngon dus khyad 'phags cig byung bar snang / yang dag 'di yang mnyam sbyor la brten pa'i man ngag khyad par 'phags a tshi ba yin par 'dug me dgu ma mnyam sbyor gyi he ru ka rigs dag kyang lha dgu ma dang gcig tu 'dug dpyal pa 'di pas yang dag dang kye rdor la grangs/ lha'i ming 'dra ba dgu steng zhen pho rus de gnyis la byed/ spyir rnying ma ba gtso chang cig tshos/ yul dro na khru klog grang na rgyud rtsom zer bas lhad che/ de'i nang nas kyang rta mgrin gyi skor 'di lhad che/ gsar ma la phyag na rdo rje'i skor lhad che bar snang / 'on kyang khyod rang sa skya pa dang byas pa'i sngon gsar ma ba chen po'i rjes su 'brangs ba ma yin pa'i deng sang ci yin 'di yin med pa'i gsar ma ba mang po zhig yod/ 'di rnams las rnying ma tsho chad kyi khyad 'phags bstan pa 'jig kha rnams su khong rnams rgyun ring zhing phan pa 'ong gsungs so/ /kun blos bkod do/ /zhes 'byung ba yin la/ 'di lta bu'i yang dag gi sgrub mchod gnang ba'i phyag len gyi rim pa 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can te 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / /rdo rje 'chang ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyal mtshan rnams kyi rjes su bzung ba'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos myur bar bris te bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mi dbang bsod nams dbang po'i sde dang /

bdag po bsod nams phun tshogs sku mched kyi gam pa lhun grub rtag rtser/ yang dag pa'i sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs gnang tshe bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas phul ba'o/ /nged rang sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med yang phur 'di rnams la bshad sgrub gang byed kyang / /thog mar sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun gyi mdzad pa'i tho yig bla ma dam pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dkyil chog dang bcas pa/ de dag gi gsal byed sa lo sngags 'chang yab sras dang bcas pas mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams te rdo rje phur pa'i phyogs la sgrub dkyil gyi gsung rab de rnams dang / dpal yang dag gi phyogs la/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i rgya gzhung gi dgongs 'grel sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha la gan pa rin rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i me dgu dang / me gcig gi sgrub thabs rnams dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang bsdus kyi dkyil chog gi lhan thabs sogs dang / sa lo yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha khyad par can rnams so/ /mdor na yang phur gyi phyogs kyi lag len sgrub dkyil gyi gsung rab de rnams la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par byas nas/ de dag gi rgyab rten du sa paṇa gyis rang 'gyur mdzad pa'i phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud/ slob dpon rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i 'grel chen 'bum nag tu grags pa dang / phur pa lam lhag lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin mi nyag bstan pa dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rtsa dum man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad snying po don gsal zhes bya ba'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can de nyid dang / yang phur pa man ngag lugs kyis rnam bshad mtsho rgyal lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin dge sbyongs rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa'i yig cha dang / yang 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rgyun bkod pa'i phur pa man ngag lugs kyi rnam bshad dang /

yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang sde legs kyi bsgrigs pa'i phur pa'i stod las/ smad las kyi yi ge gsar rnying tshogs du ma bsgrigs pa'i yig cha dang / bdag chen rgya gar bas phur pa lugs srol mang po'i man ngag zab bsdus nye mkho ba rnams bsgrigs par mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi yig cha dang / blo ldan mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i phur pa sgra bzhi'i bshad pa/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim gyi rtsa ba dang / de'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon lam lhag gis mdzad pa'i bstod 'bum du grags pa'i gsung rab dang / yang 'jam dbyangs jo sras mi'i lugs kyi phur pa rtsa ba gsum bsres kyi yig cha khyad par can dang / gzhan yang yang phur gyi bshad sgrub la mkho ba'i yi ge rnying ma du ma zhig kho bos mthong yang thams cad kyi ming 'dir 'bri bar ma nus la/ gang ltar yang phur gyi rgyud kyi don 'grel rnam bshad de rnams kyi nang du 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi lung dang de'i don bshad pa rnams la blo gros kyis zhib tu dpyad de yang phur gyi sgrub dkyil rnams dang sbyar te skal bzang don gnyer gyi dbus su bshad cing bsgom don nyams su blangs na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde lag tu 'grub pa'i nges shes chung zad rnal 'byor pa gdod nas rang grol kho bos brnyed pa legs so/ /'di bris dge bas rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /yab chos lhad med dpal ldan yang dag gi /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bdag sogs phyi ma bde ba can bgrod shog /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i gsung shog/185 sarba su kha bha wan+tu/ gang gi sngon bsags las byas shugs kyis sa gsum ma lus dbang du bsdus/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung mdzad pa'i cha shas gang la bsam yang yid rab 'phrog /dus ngan skye bo 'dul dka' btul nas ljongs 'di rdzogs ldan ltar skyong ba'i/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig sa skyong chen po phyogs dus kun du rgyal gyur cig

/de lta'i phun tshogs yon tan kun gyi gter/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mi dbang khyod/ /mang du thos pa'i dge slong sa skya pa/ /nan+da'i ming can bdag la brtse bas dgongs/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ /rang gi ngan pa'i spyod pa ma byas na/ /brgya byin gyis kyang smad par mi nus te/ /dper na chu mig rang nyid ma skam na/ /sa yi mnan kyang thub par mi 'gyur zhing / /ji skad gsungs pa ji bzhin lhur blangs te/ /bdag gi sngar byas las la nongs med pas/ /sa skyong khyed kyi drung du legs par 'ong / /de tshe zhib tu brtags pa rgyal po'i lugs/ /yin phyir dpyod ldan gnas su skye bo la/ /dri ba la sogs thabs tshul sna tshogs kyis/ /yun ring bar du legs par brtag mdzad nas/ /zab yangs thugs kyi mkhyen brtse dpung bskyed de/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir kho bo yis/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i dge legs stsol/ /'di la bsam gyin dga' spro yang yang 'phel/ /lhag par bka' drin che 'o rjes yi rang / /kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa 'di/ /gnas tshad mdo las bshad tshul mang mod kyang / /mi lo lnga stong gnas pa nges don du/ /tshad ldan mkhas pas bshad cing grags pa las/ /nga ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam dag lhag /mi lo brgya phrag bdun dang bcu phrag bzhi/ /de nas rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya par/ /sleb par nye ba sngon byon mkhas pa yis/ /gsung rab mthong ba'i mod la bdag gis rtogs/ /de phyir spyi dang bye brag bstan pa la/ /phan 'dod bdag dang bdag 'dra'i nyam chung rnams/ /stobs ldan sa skyong khyed kyi byams brtse yis/ /thugs kyis 'phral dang yun du skyangs du gsol/ /lhag bsam dkar po'i zhu 'phrin nyung ngu 'di/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba'i sdebs legs dang bral yang / /zol med rtse gcig 'dun pas phul ba la/ /mkhyen yangs khyod kyi thugs ni mi 'khrel 'tshal/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/

/rigs sngags 'chang ba shākya'i bha dan+ta/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i ming can blo gros gsal de'o/ /rang lo nyer gcig lon pa me mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes la bsam rtse brang chen du myur bar bris nas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bsam rtser gnang ba'i gsung shog yin/186 shrī rā da bud+dha ya na maḥ dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /su phan bde'i 'phrin las ches cher gsal mdzad nor 'dzin dbang po rtag tu rgyal/ khaṃ hā ta ma haṃ mahā pra ka ṣa shau bha kar+m+ma ni t+yeṃ k+ṣ+maṃ shaṃ gang gi sngon bsags las byas shugs kyi sa gsum ma lus dbang du bsdus/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar mdzad pa'i cha shas gang la bsam kyang yid rab 'phrog /dus ngan skye bo 'dul dka' btul nas ljongs 'di rdzogs ldan ltar skyong ba'i/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig sa skyong chen po phyogs dus kun du rgyal gyur cig /de lta'i phun tshogs yon tan kun gyi gter/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mi dbang khyod/ /legs byas ral pa 'thug pos gnya' kheb can/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i spyan mig rnam par g.yo/ /gzhan sde grags pa zil gnon mche sder gyis/ /phas rgol wa skyes mthar mdzad gang de nyid/ /dpa' mdzangs blon po'i rigs dang nags na rtsen/ /zhes pa'i snyan pa thos pas bdag yid tshim/ /dam pa'i drin las blo yi me long la/ /gdams pa'i ri mo 'ga' zhig gsal gyur kyang / /dus ngan dbang gis gzhan phan mthu bral ba'i/ /dman pa bdag kyang 'byung bzhi cha snyoms shing / /skyon med gsung rab mchog gi thos sgom la/ /gus dang rtag pa'i sbyor bas brtson myur gnas/ /da lam lo gsar bkra shis 'bul ba'i rten/ /mtshon byed 'di la thugs kyis mi khrel zhing / /lhag bsam mchog la dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /mi dbang mchog khyod sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /mnga' 'bangs lugs gnyis dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams/

/slar yang yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig /sa skyong dpag bsam che la nyer brten pa'i/ /ngur smṛg 'dzin pa'i 'khril shing kho bo la/ /dus ngan skye bos bsam ngan gdug rtsub kyi/ /rtag tu bzod pa'i khur chen gyis ngal ba/ /'di la mi dbang khyod kyi brtse bas skyobs/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang ba'i tshul/ a nan+da yi ming can gang de'o/ /zhes pa kā la du ta'i lo/ hai man+ta zhes pa'i dus kyi tshim byed kyi zla ba rgyal ba'i tshes la/ gu na rat+na ka ra:shrī bhu mi paṇ+ḍu ka'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha nas phul/ /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dpon sa bkra shis tshe ring bsod nams rgyal mo la springs yig bzhugs/187 dpon sa bkra shis tshe ring bsod nams rgyal mo la springs pa/ sngar phyag bris zhwa mo dang bcas pa 'byor pas sems lhag par spro zhing rjes su yi rang bar gyur/ deng sang skabs de phyogs khams snyoms ldan ngos lugs gnyis kyi bya ba bzang po gong 'phel na gnas la che/ 'dir nged kyang khams bzang ngos thos bsam sgom gsum spel mar gong 'phel gyi ngang nas snod ldan mtha' dag smin grol la 'god pa'i mur gnas/ lar bstan pa'i dus dma' mor sleb 'dug pas nged kyi bsam pa bzhin 'grub par dka' ba gda' ste/ spyir bstan pa 'di'i gnas tshad mdo so so nas mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs kyang / lo lnga stong du gnas pa 'di nyid nges don yin par mkhas pa dag bzhed la/ de la yang lnga brgya pa phrag gsum pa gsum du phye ba'i/ dang po la 'bras dus dang / gnyis pa la bsgrub dus dang / gsum pa la lung dus zhes 'jog pa las/ deng sang lung dus yin zhing / de la rdzogs pa dang rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya pa phrag gcig 'byung ba der sleb par bshad la/ des na da lo'i me 'brug 'di sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas mi lo gsum stong bdun brgya zhe brgyad 'das nas zhe dgu pa de yin pas/

da rnam dag bstan pa'i lhag bdun brgya dang nga gcig yod la/ de nas rtags tsam 'dzin par sleb pa 'dug pas na dus dma' mor ma sleb pa'i rgyu mi gda'/ 'on kyang nged rang gi cha nas blo bla ma dkon mchog la kha zhe med par gtad nas bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'bad rtsol bgyis pa'i sgo nas spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa 'di nyid ches cher rgyas par gyur te/ brgyud par 'dzin pa'i slob ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyi zla las grags che zhing skar phran las grangs mang ba dag gis rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di khyab par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dod 'dun drag po rgyun chad med par yod pa nges 'tshal/ slar yang khams kyi 'tsho bzhes la mi g.yel ba'i ngang nas bsrings 'os kyang rim par bgyis/ da lam rten sngags btab rdo rje'i mdud pa la rtags 'byar dang bcas bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bu nas bris/ dbyangs can bsod nams rgyal mo sku tshe ring du 'tsho phyir gyi gsol 'debs sgrub sde nam mkha' mdzod du btsugs pa bzhugs/188 na mo bud+dha dha dza ye/ gang gi mkhyen pa lha lam ltar yangs shing / /thugs rje'i zla zer 'gro ba'i gtsug na mdzes/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa sel ba'i stobs mnga' ba/ /skyobs pa mtshungs med shākya seng ger 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab gcig bsdus pa/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i mdangs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ljongs 'dir bstan 'dzin mchog gi skur bstan pa/ /sa skya'i rje btsun brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /gang gi bstan dang bstan 'dzin srog bzhin du/ /gces par 'dzin la ngal ba lhur len pa'i/ /sngon bsags bsod nams bye ba'i dpal yon can/ /sa skyong dbang mo bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /de ltar yid la re ba'i bsam don 'di/

/ji bzhin 'grub par bslu med dkon mchog la/ /rgyun chad med par gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'bad pa med par yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo dbyangs can bsod nams rgyal mo sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan yun ring du brtan pa'i phyir/ gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad zhig gyis zhes jo brtan pa byams pa chos dbang gis bskul ba la brten nas/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang ba byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yud tsam zhig la dpal rab dbang ldan du sbyar ba 'dis dge legs mchog tu gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //yar rgyab dpon chen la gnang ba'i bka' shog bzhugs/189 rigs gsum rnam 'phrul rje btsun sa skya pa/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la gus btud nas/ /stobs ldan sa gsum skyong ba'i mi dbang che/ /dbang gi rgyal por bdag gi rab dwangs ba'i/ /'phrin 'di 'bul lo thugs dgongs dges par mdzod/ /mgon khyod yangs pa'i sa la dbang bsgyur tshe/ /kho bo cag dang mjal ba'i skabs srid na/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /ches cher 'phel bar nus pa gdengs thob mod/ /'on kyang ngan pa'i dus kyi shugs drag pos/ /mi srid srid pa'i 'gyur ba 'di shar bas/ /chos dang mthun pa'i bsam pas don phal cher/ /re ba 'bras bur med pa'i gnas su mchis/ /'on kyang sa skyong khyed kyis sngon bsags kyi/ /las 'bras bzang bas bstan la rab dad cing / /bdag kyang bstan pa'i khur chen 'di dman pas/ /mjal ma thag tu thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /mi dbang khyod kyi lhag bsam rab dkar gyi/ /mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i mthun rkyen mtsho skyes tshogs/ /rnam pa mang pos blo ldan kho bo la/ /yang yang phan mdzad bsam gyin spro ba 'phel/ /da dung yang ni rtag tu skyongs su gsol/

/rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor kho bos kyang / /phyogs dus kun du bslu med dkon mchog la/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab nas rang gzhan kun/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud las rgyal bar smon/ /da lam yi ge mi stong tshon slad du/ /rgya dar spar ma rdo rje'i mdud pas spras/ /sngags btab mdzes pa'i rtags dang bcas te phul/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge slong mai tri wa gin+t+ra/ /a nan+da yi ming can gang de 'o/ /gdong dga' ba'i dris lan dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i me tog bzhugs/190 oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ chos kyi chos mchog gsang sngags snga 'gyur snga 'gyur rdo rje phur pa yis/ /zab mo'i zab chos sa skya'i bka' srol bka' srol dri med ngo mtshar gyis/ /brjod don brjod bya rling zhing rab rling nges don nges don snying po rnams/ /kun mkhyen kun rig rjes zhugs zhugs pa blo mchog mchog des 'dir bshad bya/ /skyabs bslu med thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i/ /ljongs gangs can 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /pha 'jam dpal dbang po sku mched dang / /rje dus gsum mkhyen pa bud+dha'i zhabs/ /dus 'bral med spyi bor legs bkod pa'i/ /rigs sngags 'chang dge slong a nan+das/ /khyed mi dbang sa skyong gdong dga' par/ /yid brtse ba'i dris lan 'di 'bul lo/ /de la dri ba dang po ni/ bdag phur chung gi sgrub thabs chag med byed kyis yod legs pa/ phur chen phur 'bring sogs la zhal 'dod gnang zhing / bris sku la yang yongs kyis 'dug na'ang / phur chung bskyed chog na mi gsal ba bsgom don la rdo rje'i khyung gshog bsam dgos mi dgos/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gnyis la yang gtso bo bskyed dus khyung gshog tshig ris dngos bstan la med cing / khro bcu sgo ma dang bcas pa bskyed pa rdzogs mtshams kyi tshig gi thon pa ltar bskyed rim bsgom tshe rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum gang nyams su len kyang /

cis kyang bsgom dgos te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis ru tra btul dus/ gang la gang 'dul gyi skur bzhengs pa bshad pa'i phyir te/ sngon byung ston pa'i rnam 'phrul de/ /rjes 'jug bsgrub pa'i nyams len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dri ba gnyis pa ni/ srung 'khor 'di bsdu ba'i gsal kha mi 'dug pa bsdu'am 'jog zhes pa'i lan ni/ nyams len rgyun par phur chung las mi byed na bsdu mi dgos te/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba srung 'khor gyi nang du bsdu bar bsam pa gsang sngags phal cher mthun zhing / de'i rjes su nyams len gzhan gyi bar chad na dmigs pa 'gyur 'gro bas/ rgyun par phur pa'i srung 'khor bsgom ga la dgos/ dri ba gsum pa/ sman raka gtor gsum dngos su 'joms ma thub na/ yid kyis sprul nas cho ga dkyus bzhin byas na ji ltar btub/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ sman raka gtor gsum dngos su bshom ma thub kyang / de'i cho ga bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed rang las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pa ni bla ma kun gyi phyag len du 'dug cing / sman raka gtor gsum bsham ma bsham gang ltar kyang / der skabs kyi bsgom don ni/ rang gi shes rgyud kyi steng gi skye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i dug gsum gyi bag chags thams cad lha'i ngo bo rnam pa sman raka gtor gsum du byin gyis rlobs pa yin lags shing / zhib rgyas 'bum nag sogs su gsal lo/ /dri ba bzhi pa/ lam dus thun bzhi len na gnas yo byin rlabs dgong mi dgos rnams dogs dpyod bka' stsal pa mkhyen zhes pa'i lan ni/ lam dus thun grangs mang nyung gang byed kyang / sngon 'gro thun mong ba gsum gyi rjes su phyi dkyil bsgom mi bsgom gang ltar yang / /lam dus dbang dngos la 'jug pa yin zhing phyi dkyil yan lag drug pa bsgom tshe/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gsum yang bsgom pa yin la/ gang ltar lam dus nyams bzhes thun grangs gang mdzad kyang gnas yo byin rlabs mi dgos legs/

sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sogs ras bris rdul tshon sogs mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i cho ga'i cha lag tu yig cha tshad ldan rnams las kyang bshad cing / 'khrul zad bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la'ang mdzad pa yin lags mod/ da lam mdor bsdus kyi dris lan 'di 'bul zhing / slar nged rang sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med rdo rje phur pa 'di yi dam gzhan las byin rlabs che zhing 'phrin las myur ba nged rang la yang yid ches khyad par can yang dang yang du yod pa nas/ lugs 'di'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog gnyis ka la rnam bshad chen mo re cis kyang rtsoms snyam pa yod pa/ de lta bu'i yig cha rnams grub bstun phyag tu 'bul bas gzigs rtog dang skal bzang gzhan la yang spel ba zhu/ dri ba lnga pa rig pa'i gnas chen bco brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin gang yin gsungs ba/ rig pa'i gnas chen bco brgyad ni/ dus rigs dus snga phyi shes pa/ pa dang / bcud rig pa sems can thams cad kyi mtshan nyid shes pa/ sgra rig bhe ka ra la sogs pa/ pa dang / bzo lo ka'i shes pa la ma rmongs pa/ rig pa/ lam rig dge sdig gi rgyu 'bras shes pa/ pa/ gso ba sman dang zas kyi mtshan nyid shes pa/ rig pa/ tshe rig pa/ gzhan gyi sngon gyi tshe rabs dran pa/ skye gnas rig pa dang / rang gzhan gyi lus ngag gang du len skye gnas gang du skye bde sdug ci 'byung shes/ gzhan gyi sems rig pa/ 'dod chags la sogs pa/ bdag don rigs pa dang / chos kyi rgyu ji lta ba bzhin rtags pa/ sems can gyi khams rigs pa dang / de spyod pa shes pa/ dbang po rig pa dang / rab 'bring shes pa/ yul rig pa dang / yul drug gi gnas lugs shes pa/ sman rig pa dang / skyes tshad mthong tshad sman gyi bye brag tu shes pa/ skye ba rig pa/ chos thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu shes pa/

spyod pa rig pa dang bco brgyad do/ ci byas dge bar shes pa/ de dag gi sdom ni/ dus bcud sgra bzo lam gso tshe/ /skyes dang gzhan sems chos bdag rig /sems khams dbang po yul sman bskyed/ /'chi dang spyod pa rig pa'o/ /zhes sngon byon pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab las 'byung ba'i rig pa'i gnas chen bco brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin 'di rnams yin la/ 'dir rags rim tsam bkod pa yin zhing / rgyas par rang re ngos kyi mjal bstun gsung gleng mdzad pas de bzhin dgongs par zhugs pa zhu zhing / /zhar byung gi dri ba sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi zhes pa 'di gang la ngos 'dzin gsungs pa/ sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi gang zhe na/ /byug pa rta chen po las gsungs pa bzhi 'di ltar/ bzo las sogs pa gtogs pa sum cu/ /rol mo dang cha byad du gtogs pa bco brgyad/ /glu dbyangs su gtogs pa bdun/ /gar du gtogs pa dgu'o/ /dang po ni/ yi ge lag rtsis/ grangs rtsis ches/ 'dzin stangs/ thar tshugs/ goms stabs/ lcags kyus/ bsgyur thabs ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdab pa/ mda' bo che 'phen thabs/ mdun du bsnur ba/ phyir bsnun pa/ bcad pa/ bral ba/ dbug pa/ rgyang nas phog pa/ sgra grag par phog pa/ mi 'chor bar phog pa/ gnad du phog pa/ tshab che ba/ mchong pa/ gyad kyi 'dzin stangs/ bang / rgyal/ brgal ba/ glang po che la bzhon pa/ rta la bzhon pa/ shing rta'i thabs/ mda' gzhu'i bzo thabs/ 'gyed pa'i stabs so/ gnyis pa bco brgyad ni/ bro/ rnga bo che/ rdza rnga/ rnga phran/ rdza rnga chen mo/ pi waṃ rgyud gcig pa/ lcags kyi sil khrol/ 'khar dkrol pi wang rgyud gsum/ rnga mu kuṇ+ḍa/ sil snyan/ glu dbyangs dang bstun pa'i rol mo/ pheg rdo pa/ rol mo chen mo'i sgra/ pi waṃ gling bu'o/ /gsungs pa bdun ni/ bar ma ba/ drang srong ba/ sa 'dzin pa drug ldan pa/ lnga ldan pa/ blo gsal/ 'khor nyan pa'o/ /bzhi pa dgu ni/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ drag shul/

bzhad gad/ 'jigs su rung ba/ snying rje/ ngam pa/ zhi ba'o/ /spyir yongs la grags pa'i skyu stsal drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/ slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis lung phran tshegs kyi 'grel pa las gsungs pa/ rol mo'i mtshan nyid sgyu ma dang / 'gyed stobs dang ni me tog las/ /dmag rnams dang ni bdag nyid che/ /g.yos su bya ba rnams par nges/ /tshong dang nor ni bsgyur ba dang / /rgyan dang lhan rtsis bcud kyi len/ /'khrul 'khor sbyor dang dri ba dang / /longs spyod dang ni che sbyor sgra/ /yi ge dang ni kha skad las/ /rang rang bzo dang mtsho rnams brtag /gcod thabs dang ni sog le dang / /phug rnams brko bar byed pa dang / /song dang 'ong ba shes pa dang / /gzhi yi mtshan nyid shes pa dang / /mdung dang rdo rje brtag pa dang / /'thang gyi 'tsher ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /zug rngu 'byin dang mig 'phrul dang / /ba ra ta yi bstan bcos shes/ /bcings dang kheng pa brtsegs ma dang / /de bzhin gos ni 'phang ba dang / /yan lag mnye dang me 'debs dang / /de bzhin chu ni kun nas dang / /dung gi sgra dang sdebs sbyor dang / /grong brdal dang ni gleg 'dra dang / /mtshan mo chom rkun shes pa dang / /byis pa rnams ni gso ba dang / /mi rnams gnyid kyi log bya dang / /sgo lcags dbye bar bya ba dang / /rma dang pa rtog byed pa dang / /skyes pa bud med rta dang ni/ /glang po'i mtshan nyid gar slob dang / /'byung po dag ni gso ba dang / /zangs ma 'khar ba gser dag dang / /shing dang dung ni shes pa dang / /ri mo tshon dang so dag gi /las rnams de dag go rim bzhin/ /skar ma'i bstan rtsis shes pa dang / /mtshan ma shes pa dag dang yang / /nges pa'i tshig gi gzhung rnams kyis/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhir dran/ /zhes gsungs pas 'di rnams legs pas zhib tu gzigs pas slar yang dogs dpyod dri ba gnang dgos byung na rim par gnang 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ /'dir snang phun tshogs 'byor pas 'byor pa'ang 'byor ldan dbang phyug legs mod kyi/

/'byor pa'i gtso bo thugs rgyud gtso bo yon tan gtso bos 'byor bgyid pa/ /rgan po rnams las rgan rab mdzangs tshig tshig dpe yan chad bzhes par 'tshal/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos lugs bzhin 'dzin nas gzigs pa'i don mchog phyag bzhes 'tshal/ /sgyu rtsal gnas dang rig gnas dag la mkhas pa brten nas mkhas par 'tshal/ /gang zhig yig tshang tshang bar gzigs pa'i gzigs pa sgrib med shes rab can/ /rnam par dag pa rnam par brnyed dus dus drug 'gro la gzigs mdzad ste/ /phra rags gnas la phrag rags blang dor gnas dang gnas min ma 'chol bar/ /nyin mtshan kun tu kun nas brtags dpyad dpyad pas dag pa mdzad du gsol/ /dman pa'i skye bo ha cang mi bkur mdzes pa'i lha lam bzhin rang gnas bskyangs/ /dam pa'i skye bo dmad par mi bgyid me lce rang gnas 'bar du gzhug /tshe yi dpal dang nor gyi dpal bskyed 'tsho byed sman dang rig gnas la/ /mkhas pa'i mig 'bras las kyang gces pas sku srog bzhin du gces par 'tshal/ /ces pa 'di ni rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i gsung las skyes pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsam rtse brang chen du myur bar bris nas sku zhang tshe ring la bkur ba 'dis dge legs su gyur cig /dge'o// ༈ //be re rgyal po la gnang ba'i bka' shog191 shrī na ren+t+ra mahā rā dza s+ya ā yurdīr+gha dza yan+tu swasti/ dpal mi'i dbang po rgyal po chen po tshe ring zhing rgyal ba bde legs su gyur cig don gnyis lhun grub spangs rtogs mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de gsung dri med lung rtog bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho ste/ /mchog gsum rnams kyis bdag gzhan kun du bkra shis mdzod/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma dang /

/dngos grub kun stsol yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs/ /bar chad kun sel rdo rje'i chos skyong mthu rtsal can/ /bla ma yi dam bstan srung dbang pos dge legs stsol/ /khams gsum 'gugs mdzad byu ru'i mdangs 'dzin lha mchog gsum/ gser ri ltar brjid ngal gsos dbang po 'khor dang bcas/ smugs 'dzin dbang po nor rgyun lha mo la sogs kyis/ /bdag gzhan don 'grub phun tshogs dpal 'bar nyid du mdzod/ /ces bde legs kyi tshigs sngon du btang nas/ /bod chen po'i yul ljongs dang nye bar gnas pa'i sa la spyod pa'i brgya byin be re mahā rā dza la bzlo ba/ deng sang gi dus kyang khyed rnams khams snyoms mu nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi zhabs tog la brtson pa'i ngang nas 'phral sel du gnas la che/ sngon de nas yi ge brten bcas bsrings ba 'byor pas sems lhag par spro zhing rjes su yi rang bar gyur/ 'dir nged rnams kyang khams bzang zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs bzang po'i rgyun 'di la/ bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod gsum sogs dang / gzhan yang 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum 'khos zab par bgyis te/ nyi ma dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'di na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar gyur pa'i dar rgyas kyi skabs na yod cing / da lam ched du bsrings don/ khams phyogs kyi nged rang sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dab 'dob sa dkar char gtogs dang bcas pa'i dgon mchod gzhis sogs bstan pa'i rgyun rnams nyams med du skyong ba la/ sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun ma chad pa byon pa zhig dgos byung ba nas/ sngon 'dab 'dob nas bdag chen rin po che de nyid dang / 'di ka nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bde bar gshegs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched rnams bzhugs skabs nas/

gong bzhugs zhabs drung sgar chen rin po che nyid khams phyogs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por rdzong thar phebs bzhugs sogs kyi sgo shar ba de yin yang / bar skabs su 'di phyogs phebs pa la brten/ sde srid gtsang pa dang nged rang mchod yon rtse gcig pa'i slar khams phyogs kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i ched du phebs dgos tshul gsol ba btab pa yin rung / da la tsho zhabs cung zad ma bde ba nas phebs sgo dod pa zhig ma byung bar brten/ nged rang gi cha nas bdag chen rin po che bde gshegs de nyid gyi thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i rgyun dang / bstan pa dang sems can la bsam na de phyogs su yongs spro ba las kyang ches spro ba kha zhe med par yod kyang / dpal ldan sa skya'i lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong gnang dpang che ba 'di sngar rgyun ma nyams pa zhig bod khams spyi'i bde thabs su mi dgos kha med yin pa sems yod kun gyi blo la gsal ba ltar/ 'di bzhag nas de phyogs yongs thabs ma byung pa nas/ de nas slar 'di phyogs gdung brgyud zhig 'phral rdzong byed rtsis dang / de bar la 'dab 'dob sa dkar dang bcas pa'i dgon chos gzhis rnams kyi 'dzin skyong la/ nged rang gi drung du lo grangs du ma'i bar du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig gi cho ga phyag len rnams la sbyangs pa mthar phyin zhing / /yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub zab mo du ma zhig gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chos rgya mtsho dpon slob 'di rnams rdzong thar byas pa yin pas/ sa dkar 'dab 'dob kyi phyogs na yod pa'i grwa rigs sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyis spangs blangs dgos rgyu la/ 'di nas nged rang gi gdung brgyud zhig khams phyogs su ma byon gyi bar la/ sa dkar 'dab 'dob char gtogs dang bcas pa'i yongs bsdud thams cad sngar 'khyud bzhin sbas bskungs med par dpon slob 'di pa'i lag tu byin pa zhig dgos rgyu dang /
