dpon slob 'di pas kyang kho rang tsho'i dgos byed gang dgos spyad pa'i/ gzhan ma rnams log 'tshor ma song ba'i gdan sa chen po'i dus ja dkar me'i rgyun la phan pa'i 'bul bskyel gang thub re byas na/ bla ma gong ma'i zhabs tog tu de che ba 'dug pas/ 'di skor la 'dab 'dob sogs kyi snga mo'i drag btsan 'dra'i don ma go'i 'then khyer byas pa byung na/ de ka nas rgyal po'i kha bltas khyab pa zhig cis kyang gal che zhing / gang ltar nged rang gi sa nas khams phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i sde dgon pa sogs bstan pa rin po che blos ni ma thong / nged rang ngos kyis yong stabs ni ma bde/ des na re zhig bar bla ma dpon slob 'di rnams 'tsho 'dzin la btang ba'i/ slar yang gdung brgyud zhig rdzong thar byas ngos khams phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i bstan pa bdag chen rin po che de nyid bzhugs pa'i skabs lta bu zhig ji srid bstan pa la gnas kyi bar du rgyun ma chad pa byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam 'di kho na snying khongs su bcangs pa yin pas/ de rgyal po khyed kyi sems yul du nges pa byas nas dpon slob 'di rnams la dbu 'don zhabs 'degs sogs sha tshar sbyar ba zhig cis kyang gal che che/ mdor na nged kyi bla ma dpon slob 'di rnams bstan pa dang sems can kho na la bsam nas/ 'dab 'dob sa dkar phyogs su brdzangs pa'i bsam pa 'di thog tu 'khyol mi 'khyol khyod be re rgyal po la rag las pa yin pas/ nged sa skya pa'i bla ma dpon slob 'di rnams skyid sdug legs nyes rgyal po khyed shes pa yin pas/ dpon slob 'di rnams la mgo 'don du spyan byams pa zhig gis/ ma mthong ba ston pa dang / mi shes pa slob pa'i dpes khams phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshugs pa zhig rgyal po chen po khyed kyis bgyi bar 'os pa'i mchog yin pas lag len la theb pa zhig cis kyang 'tshal/ de ltar byas na nged rang gis kyang bsngo ba smon lam srung 'khor sogs ci yong bgyid pa gzhir bcas shing /

lhag par rje btsun gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi thugs rje'i gzigs pa la the tshom mi dgos pas khyed rang rnams 'di phyi gnyis ka bde ba yin pa de'i tshul rgyas pa gleng ci la dgos/ yang 'dab 'dob sa dkar sogs na gnas pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig dang / de las gzhan pa dag gis/ nged kyi 'di nas brdzangs pa'i bla ma dpon slob 'di rnams la gnod 'gal log par 'gro ba bgyis pa'i/ nged kyi bstan don 'di la bar chad du 'gro ba sus byas pa byung yang / stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po khyed kyi zhi drag gang la gang 'tshams kyi sgo nas log bsgrub mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar 'gyur ba'i thabs tshul la 'bad pa gal che zhing / nged rang gis kyang spyir lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas nus thon pa zhig cis kyang byed rtsis dang / lhag par dpal sa skya'i sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i zhal gdong gi drung du mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gyi las la rtag 'grus su bgyid pa las ma 'das pa de yin/ mdor na nged kyi khams phyogs kyi bstan pa bsam pa'i don rtsa 'di thad la/ khyod be re rgyal po dang / nged sa skya pa gnyis 'dod 'dun rtse gcig tu bsgril pa'i da res brdzangs pa'i dpon slob 'di rnams la mgo 'don lung bzang gi bsam pa mthar phyin pa zhig khyed be ro rgyal po la re rgyu yin pas/ de bzhin go ba'i sems 'khur bskyed pa rang ci nar gal che che/ zhes pa'i yi ge stong min tsam du yi ge zur gsal ltar gyi tshan grangs so sor rtags 'byar dang bcas/ rab byung zhes pa me mo yos lo zla ba bcu pa'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas kyi lha khang chen mo'i bla brang rigs 'dzin pho brang nas dge bar bris/ khams phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i dgon chen sa dkar 'dab 'dob sogs la bla ma gnang dus kyi yi ge192 shrī wan gu ru dharmā swa mi badz+ra dha ra ya nā puṇ+ya in+d+ra kirti ma ti bud+dha dh+wa dza ye na maḥrgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen brtse'i ye shes gdod nas rnyog bral mchog gi gzugs/

/'gro 'di'i legs byas kun gsal mgron du sgyu 'phrul rta ljang rol pa'i gar/ /skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa zhes phan bde'i 'od stong rab 'phro ba/ /gangs can mkha' la dge legs snang bas sa gsum skyong mdzad bsngags par 'os/ /'gro drug 'dren mdzad snying po'i mtshan 'chang bla chen dang / /de sras thu bo bsod nams rtser gson 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs khrod rdor 'dzin kun gyi dbang po grags pa'i mtshan/ /de lta'i yab sras mtshungs med rnams la phyag bgyi'o/ thub dbang gnyis pa gnas lnga rig pa'i chos rje dang / /sa gsum mnga' bdag mthu stobs bsam yas 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /de sogs mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /rim byon brgyud pa'i bla ma kun la bdag cag dad/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen zhes bya ba'i/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /kun gyi 'gran bral sprul pa'i skyes mchog gang der 'dud/ /gang gi thugs sras dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can dang / /'dzam gling rgyan mchog sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros te/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spro bsdu'i byed po gang / /kho bos yongs 'dzin 'gran gyi do med mus pa rje/ /gang thugs gnyis med ye shes ngang du ro gcig pa'i/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lhar bcas kun rgyal/ /phun tshogs dngos grub ma lus ster ba'i rig byed ma/ /khams gsum skye dgu mtha' dag 'gugs pa'i 'dod rgyal dang / /dpal chen tshogs kyi bdag po rnam thos sras la sogs pa dang / /dbang bsdud nor lha'i tshogs kyi don gnyis lhun grub mdzod/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po dngos dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i lung /

rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa dpal ma hā ka la lcam dral/ zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa/ pu tra chen po bran g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'phrin/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen mang du thos pa can sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i yi ge chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas brtsams te/ gtsang dbus khams gsum gyis lam na yod pa'i bla ma/ slob dpon/ sde pa so so/ dpon skya che chung / lam 'phrang srung mi/ rdzong gzhis tha dad kyi gnyer pa/ gru 'phrang zam pa las sgrol 'don byed mi/ sne mor bkos pa'i mi sna drag zhan/ skya ser bod 'brog mi dmangs dang bcas pa rnams la springs pa/ sngon gyi dus su nged kyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras dang / chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po khu dbon gyis rgya nag dang / bod kyi skye dgu thams cad smin grol la 'god par mdzad cing / chos dang 'jig rten gyi bka' drin chen po bla na med pas bskyangs pa drag zhan thams cad kyi blo la gsal ba de yin/ 'khon sa skya pa'i rigs dang chos kyi lam srol 'dzin par khas 'che ba nged kyis kyang / dpal sa skya pa'i chos khri chen por mnga' gsol gyi me tog gtor ba'i rjes nas brtsams/ gdan sa chen po 'di'i 'khur khyer/ gnas mchog 'di nyid kyi rten dang gtsug lag khang khyad par can rnams dang / mdo sngags kyi chos sde chen po'i zhabs tog rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rnams kyi lo dang zla ba'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul bar/ gsang sngags zab mo'i sgrub mchod ngo mtshar la grangs mang ba sngar yod rnams yar ldan dang / gsar 'dzugs rnams mang du bgyis shing / de bzhin dus ja dkar me'i rgyun gtong dgos blo'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig yod pa rnams kyang gong 'phel kho nar yod cing /

gzhan yang bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs/ mdor na 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum 'khos zab par bgyis te/ nyi ma dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'di na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar dar rgyas su gyur pa'i skabs na yod cing / de bzhin du khams phyogs kyi nged rang sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dab 'dob sa dkar char gtogs dang bcas pa'i dgon chos gzhis sogs bstan pa'i rgyun rnams nyams med du skyong ba la/ sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun ma chad pa byon pa zhig dngos byung ba nas/ sngar 'dab 'dob nas bdag chen rin po che de nyid dang / 'di ka nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bde bar gshegs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched rnams bzhugs skabs nas/ gong bzhugs zhabs drung sgar chen rin po che nyid khams phyogs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por rdzong thar phebs bzhugs sogs kyi sgo shar ba de yin yang / bar skabs su 'di phyogs phebs pa la brten/ sde srid gtsang pa dang nged rang mchod yon rtse gcig pa'i slar khams phyogs kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i ched du phebs dgos tshul gsol ba btab pa yin rung / da lo tsho zhabs cung zad ma bde ba nas phebs sgo dod pa zhig ma byung bar brten/ nged rang gi cha nas bdag chen rin po che bde gshegs de nyid kyi thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i rgyun dang / bstan pa dang sems can la bsam na de phyogs la yongs spro ba las kyang ches spro ba kha zhe med par yod kyang / dpal ldan sa skya'i lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong gnang dpang che ba 'di sngar rgyun ma nyams pa zhig bod khams spyi'i bde thabs su mi dgos kha med yin pa sems yod kun gyi blo la gsal ba ltar/ 'di bzhag nas de phyogs yongs stabs ma byung ba nas/ des na slar 'di phyogs nas gdung brgyud zhig 'phral rdzong byed rtsis dang de bar la 'dab 'dob sa dkar dang bcas pa'i dgon chos gzhis rnams kyi 'dzin skyong la/

nged rang gi drung du lo grangs du ma'i bar du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam mtha' yas pa zhig gi cho ga phyag len rnams la sbyangs pa mthar phyin zhing / yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub zab mo du ma zhig gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chos rgya mtsho dpon slob 'di rnams rdzong ltar byas pa yin zhing / gang ltar nged rang gi sa nas khams phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i sde dgon pa sogs bstan pa rin po che blos ni ma thong / nged rang ngos kyi yong stabs ni ma bde/ des na re zhig bar bla ma dpon slob 'di rnams 'tsho 'dzin la btang ba'i slar gdung brgyud zhig rdzong ltar byas ngos khams phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i bstan pa bdag chen rin po che de nyid bzhugs pa'i skabs lta bu zhig ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar rgyun ma chad pa byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam 'di kho na snying khongs su bcang pa yin pas khyod so so nas go ba'i bla ma dpon slob 'di rnams la dbu 'don zhabs 'degs sogs phan cha rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa'i nged rang gi bsam pa 'di thog tu 'khyol ba zhig byas byung na/ nged rang gis kyang bsngo ba smon lam srung 'khor sogs ci yongs bgyid pa gzhir bcas shing / lhag par rje btsun gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis thugs rje'i gzigs pa la the tshom mi dgos pas khyed rang rnams 'di phyi gnyis ka bde ba yin/ de las 'das pa'i 'di pa dpon slob la dbang che/ gshed mongs/ dgra jag rkun gsum/ mi 'os pa'i lam la sgor bsgyil sogs gnod 'gal log par 'gro ba sus byas te/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po dang / 'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo nam gru ma/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi yum chen sring mo bzhi/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ dam can gnod sbyin pho mo/ bka' stod pu tra ming sring / bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral/

phur srung dam can bcu gnyis/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkor bdag rgyal po sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis gnod byed thams cad rten zhing skyobs pa'i lha dang khrol/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i brten phur phyung / ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thong / snying khrag thang la 'pho/ 'bar ba'i hwaṃ khung du bcug nas rdo rje'i thun gyi brab te/ rnam smin gyi sha rus dum bur btang la rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyol cig ji ltar bka' bsgos pa bzhin du chos skyong srung ma las byed kyi pho nya dang bcas pas sdong grogs mgon skyabs 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzod/ rnam 'dren 'khon rigs lha babs brgyud par bcas/ /gang gi 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mtha' khyab ste/ /gangs can 'gro 'di'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i dge legs stsol/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /chos srung dam can nor gyi bdag por bcas/ /de dag kun gyi sa skya'i 'phrin las pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob 'di rnams la/ /tshe ring nad med re ba'i don 'grub cing / /lam gyi bar chad thams cad rab zhi nas/ /ci 'dod 'byor pa'i dpal dang lhan cig tu/ /gegs med gnas 'dir phyin pa'i bkra shis shog /rab byung zhes pa me mo yos lo bla ma bcu pa'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dpal ldan sa skya yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas kyi lha khang chen mo'i bla brang rigs 'dzin pho brang nas dge bar bris/ zha lu ri phug spyi sar gnang ba'i bka' shog193 zha lu ri sbug spyi sa nas/ yi ge rten bcas 'byor pa bzhin/ /mang ja rdor bcas 'di bsrings so/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho dgyes par mdzod/ /kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i/

/gsung rab glegs bam mang mchis mod/ /de kun mthong bar ma gyur kyang / /'ga' zhig gi mig gi lam du gsal/ de phyir kho bo lhag par dad/ /des na 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /dngos cag rtag tu brtse lags pas/ /yang yang phan pa bsgrub par bgyid/ /de skad 'di ni sa skya pa/ /dge slong nan+da'i ming can gyis/ /bsam rtse brang chen gnas nas bris/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bkra shis rab brtan par gnang ba'i bka' shog194 bkra shis rab brtan pas/ yi ge brten bcas 'byor/ de nang bsrings don bzhin/ nged kyi lham sgrogs 'di/ yun ring ma bcings pas/ /ha cang ma rnying yang / /blo kha rdzogs phyir bskur/ /ri mo mthong 'phral bris/ thams cad bkra shis/ bdag chen shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas la gdams pa'i yi ge195 rje dus gsum bde gshegs bcud 'dus dngos/ /pha bud+dha'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /chos nges don rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas mchog /dpal e waṃ chos grwar 'phrin 'di bsrings/ /khyed slob dpon chen po'i gsung bris dang / /rten ngo ma dang bcas 'byor lags pas/ /yid dga' bde'i 'dzum mdangs gsal bar gyur/ /nged rigs sngags 'chang ba dpon slob rnams/ /rkyen gsar bu'i nyer 'tshe med tsam gnas/ /khyed yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes bzung zhing / /sngon sbyangs pa'i skyes stobs blo gsal bas/ /spyi bye brag bstan pa'i bya ba la/ /thugs zhum med khur dang ldan no zhes/ /tshig snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rgyang nas thos/ /rgyu des na kho bo rjes yi rang / /lar lung dus bstan pa'i mjug 'di la/ /bstan bsam pa'i skye bo gser bas dkon/ /'ga' yod kyang de yi mthun grogs nyung / /rgyu des na bde ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /gang ltar yang blo gros ldan pa khyed/ /dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /thugs bla ma dkon mchog rnams la gtod/ /las bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam dang / /gzhan mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum la/ /dus rtag tu g.yel med brtson par zhu/

/kun dri med lta ba rgyas 'debs gces/ /gnad 'di tsho snying gtam mdor bsdus lags/ /slar mi ring myur du mjal ba dang / /thugs yid gnyis gcig tu 'dre bar smon/ /dus da res yi ge mi stong phyir/ /rten dam rdzas ril bu brgya ldan 'bul/ /tshul 'di skad smra ba sa skya pa/ /ming ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar skyong 'dod pa'i/ /blo rab gsal mang thos gang de'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //thub bstan gdan sa pa chos rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i bka' shog bzhugs/196 mkhas pa'i dbang po chos kyi rje/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gang de yi/ /blo gros mtshungs med phyag zung der/ mchod rdzas me tog phreng 'di bsrings/ na ma shrī dpal mgon 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mañdzu go ṣa na tha ya/ dharmā chos kyi rje chos rnam rgyal phyogs thams cad du dge bar gyur cig swā mi dharmā bi dza ya s+ya sarba pak+ṣe ṣu shu bhon+tu/ karma 'phrin las rgyas par gyur cig bsta ra bha wa tu/ sar+b+ba shrī sarba dzñā ma ho pā dh+ya ya rat+na dharmā bī dza ba ta/ dpal thams cad mkhyen pa mkhan chen rin po che chos rnam rgyal nyid/ k+ṣe kun khams bzang ba dang dge bas 'tsho/ ma ku sa la dhi ya/ nā+e yā pā yan+ti/ zhing gzhes pa nas/ dharmā ka rash+tsit+ta pra ba na ba ha ra tisma te shu te nā ma na prarda ba prap+ta/ chos kyi bya ba la gzhol bar bzhugs lags zhes thos pa yid kyi spro ba thob/ a ha ngos kyang bde bas 'tsho zhing zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin lhag par 'phel bar mchis/ me li ya tha su kha dzi ba gam+bhi ra yo gā dhi bar+dhasti/ pun slar yang sku dang thugs bde bas 'tsho zhing zhabs brtan par/ ñtsa kā ya ma na sashu bha tra dha ba ru/ mdzod/ ar+ṣa ra dhe ṣa swā dā ra sī gan+dha sa de ya shā khā/ yi ge gzigs pa'i rten dri zhim ro ldan shing lo'i bskyel dang bcas/

mo dkar phyogs dga' ba'i me tog bzhad tshe dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa nas dge bar bris/ dārdza phul+la si ta dharmā ko nīta shrī bhu mi paṇ+ḍu ka sad dhar+m+ma pan+teta shu bhaṃ li khi ti/ swasti bkra shis rgyas par gyur cig dza yan+tu/ de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ mang du thos pa'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi mkhas pa/ ta/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /bhu su ku yi rnal 'byor kho bo la/ /gang blo 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ldan pa yis/ /nye bar bzung bas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la/ /'gran zla med ces rgya mtsho'i ska rags can/ /snyan pas khyab pa'i bshes gnyen gang de yi/ /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog snyan tshig rin chen phreng / zur du gsal ba'i 'dod dgu'i skyel dang bcas/ ched du mngags pa'i pho nya'i lag brgyud de/ nyams med rgya ldan 'byor pas sems spro zhing / tshig gi rin chen phreng bas bdag yid 'phrogs/ /dngos cag gzhon nu'i dus kyi bsam pa la/ /gzhon nu rab byung bsnyen rdzogs khrims nos nas/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis bkral ba'i sde snod kyi/ /gzhung lugs kun dang rgyud sde rab 'byams dang / /sgra dang snyan dngags sdeb sbyor rtsis la sogs/ shes bya kun la blo gros sbyongs 'dod cing / /yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgya mtsho che rnams las/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i chos tshul rnams/ /gus dang rtag pa'i sbyor bas legs nos nas/ /der rjes rang nyid g.yengs ba cher med pa'i/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub pa'i dus 'da' zhing / /skabs 'gar grwa slob bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sogs/ /mthun rkyen gang du 'dzoms par 'chad nyan gyis/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par bgyid snyam pa'i/ /'dod 'dun drag po rgyun chad med mchis kyang / /rang gis sngon bsags las dang smon lam mthus/ /'khrul zad bla ma rnams kyis lung bstan bzhin/ /da ni mi thegs bzhin du dpal sa skya'i/

/sde dang bstan pa'i khur gyis lus sems mnar/ /'di 'dra stobs ldan shugs 'chang glang po'i khur/ /'khos med be'u'i phrag par lhung ba ltar/ /gong ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad 'phrin rgyun/ /bdag 'dra so skyes skyong ba mos blo tsam/ /de ltar na yang rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /rang nyid lung rtogs yon tan kun bral yang / /bslu med bla ma mchog la blo gtad nas/ /phyi ltar 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bstan pa spel/ /nang du zab mo'i lam la gcig dril nas/ /ci byas bstan 'gro'i don du gyur cig snyam/ /lhag bsam tsam la mchog tu 'dzin pa las/ /gzhan pa'i 'di na yon tan 'ga' ma mchis/ /de bas mkhas pa'i phul phyin bshes gnyen khyed/ /phar tshad 'dul mngon zab mo dbu ma sogs/ /sde snod chos tshul rgya mtsho'i mthar son zhing / /dbang lung man ngag rgyud sde'i mdzod dang ldan/ /mkhas pa'i yan lag rig gnas kun mkhyen pa'i/ /da ni mang thos blo gsal rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la rtag 'grus kyis/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan g.yo med 'dzin pa las/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung bya ba gzhan med pa/ /mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho che la smos ci dgos/ /des na yid srub ser gzugs 'dzin pa 'gas/ /log bsgrub 'byung ba bstan 'dzin spyi lugs te/ /de ltar dgongs la kun mkhyen chos kyi rje'i/ /thun mong min pa'i chos grwa chen po der/ /lhas bstan bar du chos 'khor bskor bar mdzod/ /de lta'i bstan pa'i bya ba mthar phyin phyir/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i bza' ba'i dam tshig mchog /'chi med ril bu brgya phrag thum bu dang / /bstan srung gtso bo gur gyi mgon po nyid/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul phyir 'chams mgon zol/ /gaṃ li mahā kā la'i snyan dar la/ /sngags btab rdo rje'i mdud pas spras te bsrings/ /zhes bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yangs rtse sngon med gsar du bskrun pa'i gtsug lag khang ngo mtshar can li ma lha khang rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba dang /

rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lngar grags pa'i bya 'dab dpe khang gsar pa chos mdzod chen mo nas dge bar bris/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i sku skyes la gnang ba'i bka' shog197 sgyu 'phrul sras kyi bstan pa'i mjug 'di la/ /ri bong can ltar 'gro la rab gsal ba'i/ /yongs 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang po klu yi mtshan/ /gang de slar yang sgyu ma'i zol 'dzin pa'i/ /dpyod ldan mang thos gang 'dir 'phrin 'di bsrings/ /zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa lung gi dus/ /mi rung spyod pa'i bdud sdes phyogs kun khyab/ /dge 'dun sde nyams rgyun du 'khrug long 'phel/ /'gro kun yud tsam bde ba'i skabs dang bral/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i mthun rkyen cher dman pa'i/ /dus ldan 'di la blang dor shes pa yis/ /rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i spyan ldan rnams/ /gcig tu bstan pa spel la brtson par rigs/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ /sde snod shes pa'i skye bo med gyur na/ /gsung rab glegs bam mang yang sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa rin chen zhig pa yin no zhes/ /de skad gsungs te deng dus snang tshul 'di/ /ma 'ongs mkhyen pa'i lung bstan yin snyam sems/ /kye ma sngon bsags las kyis dus 'dir skyes/ /'on kyang gzhon nu nyid nas chos la dad/ /lhag par yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes bzung bas/ /tshe rabs gtan du legs pa'i 'dun ma tshugs/ /de phyir kho bo bstan la gcig tu dad/ /dpyod ldan khyed kyang bstan dang mkhas pa yis/ /bya ba drug la g.yel med brtson par zhu/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge slong nan+da'i ming can no/ /ched du bsrings don phyag rtags rten bcas 'byor pas sems lhag par spro zhing / zhang po lags kyi phyag rtags rten bcas 'byor ba'i lan 'di nas ched gtad 'bul mi gtong ba yod pa dgongs zhugs dang bsrings 'os kyang 'tshal dam rdzas ril bu la rtags 'byar dang bcas dpal sa skya'i bde mchog pho brang nas bris/

chos las pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la bkur ba'i yi ge bzhugs/198 na mo rat+na tra ya/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa'i/ /gdams pa zab mo'i rgyud 'dzin pa'i/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshigs bcad mkhas pa dga' byed pa'i/ /legs bshad 'di ni dpal sa skya'i/ /chos grwa mdzes rgyan bshes gnyen che/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan khyed la gtad/ /legs par don la 'dris par mdzod/ /tshig skyon la sogs blo rmongs pas/ /yod tshe mkhas pas bzod par mdzod/ gal te don la'ang skyon yod tshe/ /de dag rnams la'ang 'di don gang / /yin zhes dri ba'i yig rigs 'ga'/ /cis kyang bkur yig bstan pa la/ /phan re yin pas nges 'tshal lo/ /kye ma bstan pa'i mjug 'di la/ /sngon bsags las ngan dbang gi skyes/ /rgyas 'dod bstan pa je nyams 'gro/ /nyams 'dod sdig spyod zla ltar rgyas/ /'di 'dra'i dus la bstan 'dzin par/ /'dod pa bdag ni blo mang bar/ /'gyur ram sems so 'on kyang ni/ /sngon yang bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /'jig la thug kyang rgya bod kyi/ /mkhas grub kun gyi gsal mdzad pas/ /deng sang bar du gnas par go /de phyir bdag kyang zhum med blos/ /bstan pa rgyas par rab brtson pas/ /de yi grogs dan mi mngon gyi/ /dbyings bzhugs dkon mchog rnams kyis mdzod/ /kho bos bstan la de lta bu'i/ /sems khur chen po'i ngang la gnas/ /bshes gnyen khyod kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /byas na don gnyis lhun grub nges/ /zang zing longs spyod mdzod bzung nas/ /chos khyad kho nas mi tshe skyel/ /dmyal ba'i sa bon bzang ldan pas/ /btsun gzugs snying rje yang yang bsgom/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can shākya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa gang des bris nas bkur ba'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i chos las pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin chen rgyal mtshan la smras pa'i yi ge sems kyi zug rngu sel ba'i sman mchog bzhugs/199

oṃ bde legs su gyur cig sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad mus pa rje/ /skal ngan bdag dang bdag 'dras mi mngon pa'i/ /dag pa'i zhing nas bdag la brtse bas skyobs/ /tshur la gson dang bshes gnyen rat+na'i mtshan/ /khyed ni sngon bsags las kyi 'phro bzang bas/ /tshe 'dir skyes stobs blo gros mtshungs pa med/ /de phyir dbu sdom phar tshad 'dul mdzod kyi/ /gzhung lugs kun la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pas/ /blo ldan dbus su legs bshad ston pa dang / /mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'gal 'brel rtsod pa sogs/ /ji ltar byed kyang gsung rab tshig don la/ /thogs med spobs pa thob pa kho bos rtogs/ /de bzhin gzur gnas mkhas pa yongs la grags/ /lhag par ngo mtshar che'o rjes yi rang / /de bzhin grogs mchog rab 'byams smra de yang / /gong du bshad pa'i gzhung lugs de dag la/ /thos dang bsam pa'i sbyangs pa mthar phyin pas/ /'chad dang rtsod pa'i bya ba gang la yang / /mkhas pa'i dbus su mkhas pa mchog tu grags/ /grags pa de bzhin nges pa'i don la gnas/ /de phyir phyogs kyi yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen dag /mang du thos pa'i mkhas pa 'di 'dra ba/ /deng dus phyogs rnams kun na med do zhes/ /dam pa khyod nyid rtag tu bsngags par mdzad/ /de lta na yang dus ngan cher snyigs pas/ /cher rloms stobs ldan dregs pa'i log bsgrub kyi/ /mi srid srid pa'i 'gyur ba 'di shar bas/ /deng sang dus na phyogs 'dir gnas pa yis/ /bsdus ra rtags gsal 'gros 'ded shes tsam la/ /rab 'byams pa zhes ming btags 'ga' re dang / /gzhung lugs phyogs re shes pa'i ngan pa dag /gcig tu bsgrigs nas bshes gnyen khyed dag la/ /gzur gnas blo yi nang gi yon tan la/ /cung zad mi bsam kun slong ngan pa yi/ /la la lo grangs mnyam pas mnyam zhes smra/ /ngan pa 'ga' zhig ngan pa zhes su she/ /kha cig lo grangs rgan pas lhag par 'dod/

/blun po phal cher de yi rjes su 'brangs/ /'di 'dra mthong tshe sems la bzod glags med/ /snying nas mchi ma dku zhing yid 'byung skye/ /'di 'dra mi gtsang bza' ba'i khyi phag gis/ /ri dwags rgyal po smad dang mi mtshungs sam/ /gnas lnga rig pa sa skya paṇa chen gyi/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nang na mdzes mod kyis/ /blun po rnams kyi dbus su de ltar min/ /zhes dang mkhas pa rang gi spyod shes kyis/ /blun po dregs pa'i rjes su 'brang bar gsungs/ /de lta'i legs bshad rnams la nges shes skye/ /lar rang snang tshul 'di 'dra 'byung ba yang / /kye ma dus ngan snyigs ma'i rtags yin te/ /bka' dang bstan bcos tshad ldan du ma las/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i rtags su 'di lta bu'i/ /snang tshul 'byung zhes ji ltar lung bstan pa/ /ji bzhin deng sang lung bstan thog tu babs/ /thos ldan khyed la mang du smos ci dgos/ /de phyir lung bstan tshul rnams 'dir ma bkod/ /mdor na snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs rags/ /ji ltar byas kyang smod tshig kho na smra/ /don gyi skyon yon brtags nas mi spyod par/ /phyogs mthun ngan pa'ang bzang po yin zhes bstod/ /phyogs mi mthun na mkhas pa'ang blun por bsgrub/ /des na don gyi mkhas blun 'byed shes shing / /gzu bor gnas pa dus 'dir nyin skar tsam/ /de ltar dgongs la bshes gnyen dam pa khyed/ /deng dus skye bos bstod smad ji ltar rung / /'dir snang grags bde'i rjes su ma 'brangs bar/ /rang nyid gtan gyi bde ba bsgrub slad du/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin las legs thob pa'i/ /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi bzhed pa'i gzhung / /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal man ngag mchog /rim gnyis zab mo'i ting 'dzin la gnas shing / /rtsa thig rlung gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i thabs/ /myur lam rnams la brtson pas nyams len 'tshal/ /de la brten nas tha mal snang srid 'di/ /nyin mtshan med par dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor/

/der yang snang stong gsal stong bde stong dang / /mdor na tha mal rtog pas ma gos pa'i/ /sems dang 'dres pa'i nyams len tshad ldan de/ /yun ring mi thogs nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /de yi stobs kyis lus sems 'bral ba'i dus/ /phyi dang nang gi 'pho ba zab mo rnams/ /'bad med theb par kho bo nges shes skyes/ /de yi phan yon mi brjed thugs la gsal/ /de ltar bdag gi legs par bshad pa'i don/ /de dag nges par bzung la nyams su long / /zhes pa 'di ni rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi bka' drin las rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab rnams la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor a nan+da'i ming can gyis gdan sa chen po'i chos las pa bshes gnyen rat+na dh+wa dza la smras pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig tshul 'di dge slong sa skya pa/ /nan+da'i ming gis myur bar bris/ /dge bas bshes gnyen dam pa rnams/ /rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin shog /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bshes gnyen grogs mchog dam pa la smras pa'i nyams dbyangs skyo ba'i myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs/200 'dir smras pa/ grogs ma las lhag pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /khyed nged la yud tsam gson pa zhu/ /mdangs nyams len chag med rnams grub nas/ /gnyen 'byung ngam snyam nas nyal ba'i tshe/ /dus deng skabs kyi gnas tshul sogs/ /sems skyo ba'i rgyu mtshan mang dran nas/ /lus gso ba'i gnyen kyi dri mas dben/ /dus de tshe nged kyi bsam pa la/ /sems ngal ba'i nad gyis gdung dus 'dir/ /tshig bzang po'i sman gyi gso mkhas pa'i/ /grogs blo ldan nye 'khor na yod na/ /dus da lta med thabs mi 'dug kyang / /tshul de yang med snyam rab skyo nas/ /dbugs stod du 'tshangs pa'i gzer gyis btab/ /mig gnyis kyang mchi mas mer gyis gang / /dus de dus rang gi rang nyid la/ /sems gso ba'i bsam pa 'di ltar bskyed/ /nga sngon bsags las dkar 'bras bu yis/

/mi kun gyi gtsug rgyan rigs su skyes/ /skyes tsam du ma zad blo gros gsal/ /lo gzhon nu nyid nas chos la dad/ /de bsam pa bzhin du lag tu long / de'i rjes su sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs/ /rje bud+dha dh+wa dza'i rnam thar thos/ /mgon de dang mjal 'dod bcos min skyes/ /don de yang 'bad med myur du 'grub/ /gsung bdud rtsi shes rgyud tshim par 'thung / /sngar sbyangs pa chen po ma grub kyang / /gnad zab mo'i don rnams phal cher go /tshe gtan du legs pa'i 'dun ma tshugs/ /'di shin tu nyams dga'i gnas yin pas/ /sems ngal rgyu cung zad med snyam bsam/ /de'i ngang nas bde ba'i gnyid du song / /lar dus ngan ding sang skabs kyi mi/ /phal che ba'i mdzad pa 'di bzhin gda'/ /rang bza' btung bya ba'ang mi shes kyang / /mi gzhan skyon brjod pa'i dus kun 'da'/ /'ga' tshig rtsub kho nas rang gzhan bsreg /mi la la blo gtad grogs po bslu/ /'ga' ngag 'jam sems ngan blo khog chung / /khong kha cig skyon chen sems med kyang / /'phral gang yang mi shes blun rtags che/ /de kun kyang dam chos don mi gnyer/ /bza' btung ba'i phyir du srog kyang gtong / /rgyu des na deng sang skabs nyid kyis/ /mi drag zhan phal cher 'di rnams dang / /nged sems yid mthun pa'i rgyu mi gda'/ /khyed rab 'byams dge 'dun 'od zer ba/ /chos lugs gnyis phyogs la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /blo gtad pa'i grogs phyir srog kyang gtong / /bstan 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam che/ /rgyud nga rgyal drag pos ma gos sogs/ /sngon dus kyi mi yi mtshan nyid rnams/ /phal che ba khyod la tshang bar go /don des na nged dang grogs mchog khyed/ /tshe 'dir yang 'bral med 'grogs pa dang / /dus phyi ma rje btsun mus pa che/ /gnas gang bzhugs sa der rang re gnyis/ /lhan cig tu skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /don tshul bzhin 'grub pa bla ma mkhyen/ /zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis me pho 'brug gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin bris pa'o/

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //yi ge pa a nan+da la gnang ba'i bka' tho bzhugs/201 rigs gnas mkhas pa a nan+das/ /yi ge rtsom dpe dang bcas pa/ /'byor pas yid rab dga' bar gyur/ /thogs med bag chags rab 'thug pas/ /dal 'byor stong log mi byed par/ /'dod pa deng sang srid pa tsam/ /'dug mod blo gros ldan pa khyed/ /gcig shes kun grol zab lam la/ /brtson par 'dod pa rjes yi rang / /'on kyang dbang khrid rim gnyis gnad/ /la sogs thos rgya ma ldan pas/ /rtse gcig lta bas bskyangs na yang / /gol sa'i g.yang la lhung nyen yod/ /rang sems bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ /gdod nas dbyer med yin pa la/ /yin par shes nas snang srid 'di/ /dag pa rab 'byams kho nar 'char/ /de ltar shes nas chos thams cad/ /'dzin med lta ba rgyas thebs na/ /mdo rgyun bstan bcos ma lus pa'i/ /zab gnad 'di rang yin snyam sems/ /yin min dge slong ral can la/ /dris la 'thad na blang bar mdzod/ /da lam yi ge mi stong phyir/ /sngags btab rdo rje'i mdud pa dang / /rgya dar spar ma mdzes pa la/ /bkra shis rtags kyi mdzes byas te/ /shrī sa skya'i gnas nas bris/ /da lam thung tsam 'di bzhin bris pa yin zhing rgyas par rjes su byed pa nges 'tshal/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //chos las rat+na dh+wa dza dang rab 'byams smra ba kun dga' bsam 'grub gnyis la thun mong du springs yig bzhugs/202 phun tshogs gcig las kun 'byung chos kyi rje/ /rim pa gnyis kyi ngang las g.yel ba med/ /rdo rje gsum ldan bka' drin mtshungs pa med/ /'phrin las bzhi yi 'gro ba skyong mkhas de/ /ye shes lnga yis lus stobs rab rgyas shing / /phar phyin drug gi mche ba rnon po can/ /'phags nor bdun gyi mdzes pa'i rgyan chas spras/ /gnyis 'thung brgyad pa'i sar gnas gang de rgyal/ /de ltar mchod par brjod nas bsrings ba'i don/ /bshes gnyen dpon slob gnyis kyi yi ge dang / /de nang rten bcas 'byor pas sems spro zhing /

/gnas tshul rnams kyang ji bzhin nges par byung / /bod yul dbus kyi dpal ldan sa skya der/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rnam dkar las kho nas/ /zhabs tog ci 'grub bgyid snyam bsam pa de/ /rnam pa kun du yid la dung nge yod/ /gdung spel la sogs sdig dang 'brel ba'i las/ /kho bo gtan nas blo la med bzhin du/ /gal te byed la re ba'i skye bo 'ga'/ /yod na de dag sbyin 'bras med pa yi/ /gang zag zhig gi longs spyod gsog dang mtshungs/ /kho bo cag la sa skya lo tsā ba/ /lta bu re ba yod na rjes yi rang / /kye ma kye hud bstan pa rin po che/ /sum stong bdun brgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad tsam/ /'das pa'i dus 'dir chos bzhin spyod pa yis/ /skye bo nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon/ /de las ldog pa skar phran tshogs las mang / /'di 'dra'i gseb tu sngon bsags las kyi skyes/ /de phyir kho bo'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas 'di dka' ba'i gnas/ /'on kyang bdag ni bstan pa rin chen 'dis/ /phyir du lus sems ngal ba ci byung yang / /ngal ba mi sems dga' ba bsgom gyin bdog /bshes gnyen dpon slob khyed kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /da lam yi ge mi stong mtshon pa'i phyir/ /rgya dar spar ma rdo rje'i mdud pas spras/ /sngags btab mdzes pa'i rtags dang bcas te bsrings/ /zhes 'di 'khon gyi rigs skyes shākya yi/ /btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /tshul khrims dri zhim lus la thul le ba/ /gang des gling dga' bde ba can nas bris// ༈ //chos las pa rat+na dh+wa dza dang rab 'byams smra ba kun dga' bsam 'grub gnyis thun mong du spring yig bzhugs/203 na mo gu ru bud+dha ṭi ṇi ye/ sa skya pa yi bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs dus kun du 'phel zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang por shes nas dwangs bas 'dud/ /gang de'i sras mchog nges don 'jam pa'i dbyangs/

/puṇ+ya in+d+ra mched la kun nas dad/ /bstan 'gro'i phyir du sku srog kyang gtong ba'i/ /bud+dha dh+wa dzas byang chub bar du skyobs/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ bsrings don bshes gnyen rat+na dh+wa dza dang / /rab 'byams smra ba kun dga' bsam 'grub gnyis kyi yi ge rten bcas 'byor pas sems spro zhing rjes su yi rang bar gyur/ spyir gyi 'o skol rnams la khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten du gyur pa'i gsal rig tsam re kun la yod pa 'di skye med du rtogs na 'khor ba las grol ba las/ de ma rtogs pas da dung yang 'khor bar a 'thas kyi 'khyam pa 'di bzhin yin mod/ 'on kyang rang re rnams dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di lta bu thob cing bstan pa rin po che sgor zhugs shing bya rgyud gtso bo chos la byed pa 'di ngo mtshar zhing / lhag par chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang mus pa chen po ste/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa 'di rnams kyi sku mthong zhing gsung thos par ma zad dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin gyis yang yang du skyong ba 'di ni shin tu bsod nams bsags pa yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ drang don gyi puṇ+ya in+d+ra 'di/ nges don du pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /nges don du byang sems zhi ba 'tsho/ /drang don nu grags pa blo gros yin/ /nges don du bud+dha rat+na'i mtshan/ /drang don du sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan yin/ /zhes pa 'di rnams don la gnas pa lags/ lar rang re rnams sngon bsags las kyi dbang gi dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes pa la brten/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal 'di ltar snang ste/ chos bzhin spyod pa'i mi dbang sa skyong phal cher rgyal srid dang bral zhing / la la ni 'byor pa dman la de kun sdig spyod rgyal pos yang yang 'tshe ba la brten/ rtag tu sems zhum par gnas la/ mi dbang sa skyong de dag gi mchod gnas su gyur pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa phal cher yang /

gcig phur bsgom bsgrub la brtson par bzhugs kyang / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgo nas bstan pa spel ba'i thugs 'dun rnams zhi bar gyur cing / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang sngon nas nag chang gi dri mas ma gos pa rnams kyang dri mas gos shing / sngon nas cung zad gos pa rnams bag med du spyod la/ tha na khyim pa rang dga' ba dge ba la dkar mi dkar gnyis kyang / dang po khas kyang zhan cing longs spyod kyang chung zhing / phyi ma ni longs spyod kyang che la khas kyang drag pa sogs mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ches cher nyams pas rtags tsam 'dzin pa la sleb par nye ba 'dug pas shin tu sems zhum par mchis/ 'on kyang sngon chad kyang 'phags yul dang bod gangs can 'dir yang bstan pa rin po che 'di shin tu nyams dma' bar gyur pa'i skabs 'ga' re byung 'dug kyang de'i skabs kyi mkhas grub so so'i thugs khong nas bstan pa 'di nam yang ma dor ba la brten bstan pa deng sang gi bar du gnas pa 'di bzhin du 'dug pas rang re rnams kyang chos sgor zhugs pa'i dgos pa yin pas bstan pa la zhabs tog chen po dus kyi dbang gis 'grub par dka' ba 'dug kyang / blo bla ma dkon mchog la gtad/ las su chos ma gtogs gzhan gang gi yang rtsol gnyer ma byas par bstan pa la phan thogs shig cis kyang rang byed dgos pas blo 'jags rang gal che che/ gang ltar chos thams cad lta bas rgyas theb pa zhig dgos pa yin pas/ de yang snang srid thams cad sems snang dang / de yang skye med du lung rigs du mas bsgrub par nus la/ de ltar stong nyid rjen ne ba ye re ba de yang gsal zhen/ stong zhen dang bral ba'i ngang la 'jog dgos la/ de ltar du 'jog shes na dus rgyun du blo mi bde ba'i skabs mi 'byung ba gda'/ lta ba 'di ni pha rol du phyin pa dang / rdo rje theg pa gnyis ka'i yin la/ rdo rje theg ba la tha mal gyi snang zhen thams cad dag snang 'ba' zhig tu bsgyur te bsgom pas myur du 'gyur ba the tshom mi za ba 'dug pa/

gsang sngags thabs lam zab zer ba yang 'di ka yin par 'dug tshe rabs du mar sbyangs pa'i blo gros tshal/ /yongs 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma kha phye ste/ /thos bsam bsgom pas drod gsher gyis rgyas 'di/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mchod pa'i rdzas/ /rnam mang mdo rgyud rgya mtsho ma sbyangs kyang / /rnam dag mthar thug don rnams phal cher go /rnam dpyod 'di ni sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i/ /rnam 'dren bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin lags/ /da lam yi ge mi stong mtshon pa'i phyir/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i lam la 'khod slad du/ /du mas rgyal ba kun las lhag ces bsngags/ /bsngags 'os dam pa'i na bza'i dum bu la/ /rtags 'byar dang bcas dben pa'i gnas su bris/ /zhes pa 'di ni shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa wa gin+d+ra pu ṇa kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha dras gling dga' ba bde ba can gyi dgon nas shin tu myur bar bris nas dpal ldan sa skyar bskur ba 'dis ka l+yā na wardan+tu// ༈ //thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan la gdams yig yid bde'i dpal ster bzhugs/204 swasti sid+dhi/ skyabs gnas bslu med rnams la gus btud nas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rin chen gyis/ /rgyal mtshan g.yo med 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /mtshan don ldan khyod yud tsam tshur gson dang / /'o skol ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yang / /dngos su skye 'chi spangs kyang 'da' tshul bstan/ /sngon byon rgya bod mkhas grub bgrangs yas kyang / /dus dang dus min glo bur gshegs pa'i tshul/ /chos 'byung lo rgyus rnam thar so so ru/ /gsal ba'i tshul rnams khyed la smra ci dgos/ /des na 'phen rdzogs sna tshogs gsal ba yis/ /las snang can gyi skye bo 'di rnams la/ /bde sdug sna tshogs 'byung ba dngos po'i gshis/ /de ltar dgongs la bshes gnyen dam pa khyed/ /deng dus g.yeng med srod dang tho rang sogs/ /don med rtog 'gyu thol skyes rbad chod la/

/rang re lam sna 'dren pa'i bla ma rnams/ /rang sems spros bral ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /rang yid tshe 'das sems dang gdod ma'i gnas lugs dbyer med yin pa'i phyir/ /'dre ba la the tshom mi dgos par gsungs so/ /bsres byas nas/ /rang gzhan mnyam pa nyid kyi rgyas btab te/ /bzod med byams dang snying rje'i kun blangs nas/ /dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /zab don rten 'brel de yi byin rlabs kyis/ /smon lam gang btab zhing du skye ba sogs/ /phan thogs dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo zhes/ /tshad ldan skyes bu'i gsung rab dag las 'byung / /de bzhin thugs la zhog las nyams len mdzod/ /phyin chad dpon slob 'khor bcas tshe ring zhing / /nad med ngang nas bsam pa ma lus kun/ /'bad med 'grub ste bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /tshe mjug tshe dang bsgrub pa mnyam byas nas/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du skye bar smon/ /de yi thabs su mkha' spyod dbang mo yis/ /man ngag yang zab du ma kho bo la/ /yod pa'ang don du gnyer na 'bul bar bgyid/ /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /za nyal 'chag la brtson pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /chos med gos dkar lcang lo can de'o/ /ka l+yān war+dhan+tu// ༈ //legs bshad skal bzang dpyod ldan yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs/205 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs kyi ye shes dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs kyi ye shes gnyis/ /rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su/ /gnas lugs ro gcig rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyal/ /de ltar gdod ma'i mgon po la btud nas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bshes gnyen che/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan gang der 'di skad smra /'jig rten bya ba sngon las rjes 'brangs phyir/ /'phral tshod kho na'i steng du 'gro dka' bas/

/'di nas 'dir 'gyur zhes bya'i thag gcod pa/ /mngon shes med pas shes par mi nus mod/ /'on kyang las kyi bsags pa ci yod kyang / /de yi sad byed rkyen gyi byed pas na/ /'phral gyi bya ba phra rags thams cad la/ /blang dor brtag dpyad yang dag dgos pa la/ /chos dang 'jig rten bya ba gang byed kyang / /las kyi bskos pa'i dpon dang bla ma la/ /kha zhe med pa'i blo gtad bya ba de/ /rang gzhan 'di phyir legs pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /che phra'i bya ba gang la'ang rang gi 'dod/ /ha cang ches na khye de'i mi tshangs ba'i/ /phugs su rang la gnod pas 'dod nye dang / /phyogs cha nye ring nam yang med par mdzod/ /drag zhan su dang 'grogs kyang theg che zhing / /chad btsan khyon che ngo lkog med pa dang / gzhan brtag gzhung bzang brdzun pa mi smra ba/ /kun gyi yid brtan 'cha' ba'i gnas su mdzod/ /mtho dman kun la 'gyod med bstun na yang / /mgu ba nyung la 'khang pa mang ba dang / /gcig sems zin kyang gcig sems mi zin pas/ /shin tu dka' yang ngang ring bsrings ba gnad/ /bde sdug sems la 'char ba 'gag mi nus/ /de nyid tshig tu bton na mi rung bas/ /yin min bshad pa skyor 'das la sogs pa'i/ /brjod pa shin tu zab par bslab par gces/ /g.yul 'thab ya 'thab la sogs gang la yang / /gnad tshangs sprad pa'i dpa' rkyen ngom shes na/ /g.yul ngor grags pa 'byung mod dus min du/ /'khrug long dgos med byed par ga la rigs/ /rgyun du chang la dga' bas rang gzhan gyis/ /bya ba ma lus 'chal bar 'gyur ba legs/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa kun kyang 'dis bskyed pas/ /blo ldan su zhig dug chu 'thung bar byed/ /sngon chad ma byung bya ba srid legs kyang / /phyis nas mi 'byung bya ba mi 'dug pas/ /gang la'ang blo 'gel rlom pa mi che bar/ /phyi lhod nang grims byed pa gal che snyam/ /dus ngan lta'i mi dang 'grogs pa la/ /gang la gang 'tshams bstun lugs ma shes na/

/'gyod med rtags su bkod pa'i dbu tshugs kyi/ /rang gzhan kun la phan pa dka' mor snang / /'jam pos 'jam po 'dul bar 'gyur ba dang / /rtsub mo'ang 'jam pos 'dul ba'i tshul shes nas/ /'jam pa'i kun spyod bag dang ldan pa yis/ /kun la lhag par 'jam pos bstun pa 'tshal/ /khengs dang nga rgyal rgod bag mi byed par/ /snyan 'jam des pa'i blo yi thams cad la/ /mi mnyes lhod yang shes pas skye bo gzhan/ /ngang gi rang la 'dud par 'gyur ba legs/ /de ltar 'jig rten bya ba yin lugs su/ /nye bar bskyangs pas chos kyang 'byung mod kyis/ /'on kyang thun mong min pa'i zab chos rnams/ /nyams su len tshul spyi dang bye brag kun/ /mang thos dpyod ldan kun la bshad ci dgos/ /de ltar kho bos lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos rnams kyi legs bshad kyi/ /yang snying bsdus nas mdo tsam bshad pa 'di/ /legs par soms la blo gsal gzhan la'ang spel/ /de skad 'di ni dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /bshes gnyen dam par brtse ba'i sems kyis bris/ /dge bas don gnyis lhun grub shog /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog thugs rje dang / /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu rtsal gyis/ /bdag gis bstan pa spel ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /'gal rkyen thams can rang gzhir 'gyur bar shog /sa skya'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rab rgyas shing / /bdag cag dpon slob bsam don mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //mi dbang karma 'jig bral rdo rje la gdams pa'i yi ge206 rje sa bcu yi byang sems bud+dha'i mtshan/ /slar 'gro ba yi don du mi yi gzugs/ /pha 'brel tshad don ldan mus pa rje/ /bdag mos pa yi bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed legs pa ru gson dang 'jig bral ba/ /tshe 'dir snang gi skyid sdug legs nyes kun/

/tshe sngon bsags kyi las kyi 'bras bur bshad/ /rgyu de bas na dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /las dge sdig gi blang dor ma log pa gces/ lho 'dzam gling 'dir skyes pa'i 'gro kun gyis/ /lus gdos bcas 'di sems kyi skyur nges shing / /'di nam skyur gyi nges pa cung zad med/ /de med bzhin du yun ring sdod snyam pa'i/ /sems rlom sems 'di tsho'i 'khrul tshab la ang / 'di legs pa rang soms dang 'jig bral ba/ /nor zang zing sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la/ /yid a 'thas kyis zhen pa skyes pa'i tshe/ /rang 'chi kha yi bsam mno 'di bzhin thong / /mal tha ma ru gtam gyi tha ma smra/ /rang 'chi ba ru shes kyang bzlog thabs med/ /mtha' gnyen bshes kyi bskor nas ngu 'bod byed/ /da ci 'dra rang drag snyam snying rtsa 'dar/ /nad zug rngu yi nyin mtshan mi 'khyol bar/ /tshul de 'dra yi ngang nas bem rig bral/ /rdzas sa rdo ltar lus 'di mal du bzhag /de me phung gi bsregs gam chu yi 'khyer/ /yang gyang ngos la sbyar te skam pa'ang srid/ /sems gsal rig 'di bar do'i 'phrang du 'khyams/ /gnas de nyid nas 'jig pa'i sgra bzhi dang / /nyams nga ba'i g.yang sa rnam gsum tshogs/ /gtam thos pa tsam gyis kyang snying 'dar ba'i/ /yid 'jigs skrag gi 'phrang la thar thabs med/ /sa de nyid du chos byed skyes bu rnams/ /blo 'jigs med kyi g.yul rgyal legs lon nas/ /tshe gtan legs kyi 'dun ma zin par 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir snang la zhen pa'i sdig can rnams/ /gnas bar do yi sdug bsngal kun myong nas/ /sa de las kyang sdug bsngal ches che ba'i/ /gnas dmyal ba yi grong du 'jug par 'gyur/ /rgyu de bas na 'dir snang phun tshogs la/ /yid a 'thas kyis zhen pa ma mdzad par/ /tshe gtan don gyi 'dun ma bsgrub pa mdzod/ /dus snyigs ma yi grogs la yid ma ston/ /blo gtod pa de bla ma dkon mchog bzang / /las mi dge spongs la dge ba bsgrub/

/tshe 'di nyid las phyi ma shugs thag ring / /rang nam 'chi nges pa mi 'dug pas/ /las dge ba la brtson 'grus bskyed pa zhu/ /'bangs 'khor g.yog rnams phyogs med byams pas skyongs/ /don snying gtam kun bsdu na 'di ltar te/ /dus snyigs ma yi skye bo mgu dka' bas/ /blo rang sems kyi rang dbang thub mdzod la/ /rang 'gyod med las la 'bad 'bungs thon/ /skyabs bslu med kyi thugs rjes gzigs par nges/ /zhes pa 'di shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ bsam rtse brang chen pa mi dbang karma 'jigs bral rdo rje la gdams pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //sprul sku rnam rgyal rigs pa la/ legs par smras pa'i nyams dbyangs bzhugs/207 skyabs bslu med thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la btud nas/ /khyed bzo rig mkhas pa rnams kyi rgyan/ /ming rnam rgyal rigs par grags khyod la/ /sprang kho bos tshig 'ga' smra yi nyon/ /bdag sngon bsags las 'phro bzang ba'i phyir/ /lo gzhon nu nyid nas chos la dad/ /tshe 'dir snang grags bde'i ban bun la/ /blo dga'o snyam pa ma byung zhing / /rje gong ma'i rnam thar yang yang bltas/ /tshul 'di 'dra rang zhig bgyid snyam pa'i/ /yid 'dun pa drag po yod na yang / /khong gong bzhugs dgongs pa rgya chung bas/ /dus yun ring bar du 'gyang te thal/ /de'i skabs cig rje btsun sa skya pa/ /khong puṇ+ya in+d+ra'i bka' drin las/ /yid 'dod pa bzhin du rab byung bsgrub/ /de'i rjes su'ang chos dang mthun pa'i don/ /gang byas kyang 'grub par dka' ba byung / /skabs de tshe sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs/ /rje bud+dha dh+wa dza'i rnam thar thos/ /mgon de dang mjal 'dod bcos min skyes/ /sngon bsod nams bsags pas don de 'grub/ /dbang khrid dang man ngag lung rab 'byams/ /pha khong gi shin tu dgyes shing gnang / /rje sangs rgyas dngos su nges shes skyes/

/dus deng sang dbus gtsang khams gsum na/ /nga mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan no zhes/ /kho dregs pa'i sgra skad 'byin mang yang / /don nges don ldan pa 'di kho na/ /rgyu des na 'brel tshad don ldan la/ /nga mi phyed dad pa thob pa'i phyir/ /tshe gtan du legs pa'i mdun ma tshugs/ /gang byas kyang skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /lar deng sang bstan pa rin po che/ /dpe 'bab chu zad pa'i rdzing bzhin du/ /dus nyin re nyin re rim bzhin bri/ /'di bsam pa'i skye bo gser bas dkon/ /'ga' rnam dpyod blo gros mi dman pas/ /yid thos bsam rgya mtsho'i mdzod bzung nas/ /spyi bye brag bstan pa spel 'dod kyang / /dus deng sang skye bo drag zhan kun/ /de'i log phyogs kho nas bsgrub pa 'di/ /legs bsam na snying rlung ldang la khad/ /tshul de ltar bsam na kho bo cag /blo gtad pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa/ /pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan khong la zhu/ /las byed rgyu thos bsam sgom gsum dang / /de'i 'bras bu chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs/ /bstan rin chen bya ba 'ba' zhig bgyid/ /mdor bsdu na shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i/ /lus dal 'byor 'di nyid don yod par/ /blo kha zhe med par 'dod pa'i phyir/ /phugs 'di phyi kun du bde nyams sems/ /'phral chos mthun skye bu thams cad la/ /dus snyigs pas mthun rkyen med dus 'dir/ /bdag sngon bsags las kyi skyes pas na/ /gang byas kyang bde ba'i go skabs dka'/ /gang ltar kyang rang re dpon slob gnyis/ /dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /yid phan tshun gcig tu 'dre bar smon/ /zhes pa 'di lung dus bstan pa'i mjug 'dir bzo rig byed pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa sprul pa'i sku rnam rgyal rig pa zhes yongs la grags pa de nyid la shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos smras pa'o/ /rā dzā ltar dwangs bzhin me long ngos/

/shar bas 'char po'i yid la spro bskyed ltar/ /tshul 'di gzhan la gdams mod smras pos kyang / /phyis 'byung yid bde 'byung phyir ngo mtshar chos/208 /na mo gu ru bā ta ga:bī rat+na badz+ra ḍā kaḥtsakra sam+ba raḥbud+dha dh+wa dza ya/ gsang sngags zab mo'i nyams len mthar phyin te/ /gzhan la spel nas bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal mtshan kun gyi rgyan/ /mtshan tsam dran pas gdung ba sel der 'dud/ /de ltar bdag gi 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan nges mus pa rje/ /gus pas btud de sems la thol byung du/ /shar ba'i nyams snang 'ga' zhig yi ger bris/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtshos rgyud phyug pas/ /dka' ba'i gnas rnams kun la thogs med kyis/ /blo gros rgyas pa thos mthong yid ches phyir/ /rab 'byams ming don ldan khyod tshur la gson/ /sgyu 'phrul sras kyi bstan pa'i mjug 'di ru/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i lus rten thob na yang / /chos med stong log byed la rdul phran tsam/ /snying nas sangs rgyas bsgrub pa lta ci smos/ /chos la dad tsam nyin mo'i skar las dkon/ /'di 'dra'i dus la rang re phun tshogs kyi/ /lus thob bstan la cher dad chos sgor zhugs/ /bya rgyu'i gtso bo thos bsam sgom gsum la/ /byed pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas/ /'on kyang kho bo bag chags ngan pa'i tshogs/ /rab tu 'thug pas ngal ba 'di ltar snang / /don la sangs rgyas ngo bo dbyer med kyang / /rnam pa gdul bya'i snang ngor tha dad pas/ /gcig las gdams pa rgya mtsho'i drin thos pa/ /de las gzhan gyi cung zad mi mnyes tshul/ /kye ma 'di 'dra bsam gyi yid re mug /rgyu mtshan du mas dkon par grub pa'i lus/ /lan cig tsam zhig thob pa'i lus 'di la/ /sems dang 'dre ba'i chos gcig nus mi 'dra/ /de phyir chos par grags pa'i ming stong 'dis/ /gnyis phung las la sbyar dogs blo re skyon/

/chu bur lta bu 'jig sla'i lus srog 'di/ /nges par 'bral nges nam bral cha med pas/ /nyams myong sna gcig rgyud la ma skyes par/ /'di 'dra'i ngang la 'das dogs sems re 'tshab/ /de ltar ngal ba rnam pa gsum po des/ /dang po'i gnyen por 'dren pa dam pa'i tshogs/ /ngo bo dbyer med yin pas dbang bzhi rdzogs/ /thob pa'i bla ma gang yin gcig nyid la/ /skyabs yul thams cad bsdus nas dus kun du/ /kha zhe med par snying nas gsol btab na/ /yongs 'dzin kun la byin rlabs 'jug par nges/ /bla ma'i mdzad pa ji ltar ngan na yang / /rang nyid las ngan 'thug pas mthong snang ngam/ /yang na sdig sbyongs yin par thag chod na/ /de la yon tan sna gcig med re kan/ /ngal ba gnyis pa'i gnyen por sdig spongs dang / /dge ba bsgrub la le los dben par bya/ /lhag par bslab bya'i tshogs la nan tan gces/ /ngal ba gsum pa'i gnyen por tshe bsgrub dang / /rim gnyis bsgom la brtson 'grus bskyed na legs/ /da ni nyon mongs thams cad kyi/ /gnyen po'i mchog gyur lta ba yis/ /nyams len mdo tsam 'dir bshad bya/ /dben par lus bsrangs skyil krung bcas/ /dus gsum rtogs pa kun spangs te/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal bar lta/ /de yi rang bzhin stong pa ru/ /rtogs par 'gyur gyis stong nyid de/ /nam yang gsal chas 'bral mi srid/ /zung 'jug ngang la lhod de 'jog /de nas snang srid chos 'di kun/ /sems las byung bar sangs rgyas kyis/ /gsungs phyir dogs pa spangs la bsgom/ /sems dpa' de'ang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /bral zhes rgyal bas yang yang gsungs/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin rgyud la sbyor/ /de tshe stong nyid rjen ne ba'i/ /rnam pa 'byung mod de nyid kyang / /gsal ba'i cha yi stong mi 'gyur/ /zung 'jug 'dzin med ngang la bzhag /mdor na lta ba'i mthar thug ni/ /chos kun blang dor dang bral nas/ /bya rgyud gang yang ma brnyed par/ /'di ka yin snyam kho bo sems/

/'on kyang ngos cag sbyangs pa chung bas na/ /skyon 'ga' mchis na blang dor mdzad par zhu/ /zhes bya 'di ni 'khon rigs shākya yis/ /btsun pa rgya mtsho ngag dbang kun bsod kyis/ /bris nas bsod nams kyis thob grogs la bkur/ /dge bas skye med btsan sa zin par shog /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs yid bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs/209 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rje bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /mi chos med yar 'dren gzugs brnyan ngas/ /bu tshangs dbyangs mgrin pa can khyed la/ /sems brtse bas nyams dbyangs 'di 'bul lo/ /khyed sngon bsags las 'phro cher bzang bas/ /khong 'dus pa rgya mtsho tshogs pa'i dbus/ /lus ya yo med pa'i ngang tshugs dang / /ngag 'brug stong ldir ba zil gnon sgra/ /dus rgyun chad med pa lhang nge ba/ /de mchod yul kun kyi mchod rdzas te/ /khong 'dus pa'i tshogs kun yid rab 'phrog /gzhan 'jig rten pa rnams dwangs ba 'dren/ /don des na nyin gcig dge rtsa la'ang / /sems bsam pas zin na bsam mi khyab/ /de skal bzang yin no shes par mdzod/ /med nged kyang sngon bsags las dbang gis/ /lo gzhon nu nyid nas rab byung 'dod/ /tshe 'chad nyan bsgrub la dril snyam kyang / /rje bla ma rnams kyi lung bstan bzhin/ /de mi theg bzhin du dpal sa skya'i/ /sde bstan pa'i khur gyis lus sems mnar/ /tshul de 'dra'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la'ang / /rgyud zab mo'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs/ /khong 'dus pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /las chos spyod dge ba spel ba'i tshe/ /bu khyod nyid sems kyi ngal gsor thob/ /rgyu des na kho bo rjes yi rang / /khyed sngon chad nad med gzugs bzang yang / /dus da lo cung zad ma bde ba/ /tshul de la ngal bar ma mdzad pa/ /dus re zhig spangs blangs 'di bzhin mdzod/ /rje skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la/ /yid kha zhe med pa'i mos gus kyis/ /sngar byas pa'i sdig pa kun bshags shing /

/rkyen bar chad sel ba'i gsol ba thob/ /sngar bzhin du nad med tshe ring na/ /zas longs spyod 'phongs pa mi srid pas/ /'phral rkyen bzlog rim gro'i bya ba la/ /blo rgya dpang bskyed de gtong ba gces/ /mi ngas kyang rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ /thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / /bu dad ldan rnams kyi sems kyi gshis/ /don rang sems ngo bor ro gcig pa'i/ /chos gdod ma'i gnas lugs gsal btab nas/ /mi bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas rnams/ /dus 'di la tshe ring nad med cing / /yid bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / /tshe phyi ma dag pa'i zhing gi mchog /gnas bde ba can du kun skye bar/ /skyabs gcig chog rgyal po bla ma la/ /dus rgyun du gsol ba 'debs shing mchis/ /de dgongs la blo sems 'bol gyi slod/ /yid rtsab rtsob ma mdzad snying gtam lags/ /dus myur du khams 'dus las grol nas/ /sngar bzhin du bsam pa mthar phyin shog /ces pa'i nyams dbyangs 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i ban gtsang dpon gyi dbu mdzad dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas 'phel zhes bya ba re zhig rkang nad kyis gdung ba'i tshe brtse ba'i sems kyis smras pa'i yi ge pa ni shab stod skyes pa'i tshe dbang dpal bzang gis bgyis pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rnam dkar gyi las la spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam dga' bde'i dpal ster bzhugs/210 rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas rnams/ /tshe 'di phyi'i don kun legs 'grub par/ /mgon dbang dang stobs bcu mnga' bas mdzod/ /sngon 'khor bar lan mang 'khyam pa'i tshe/ /las bzang po smon lam gyis 'brel ba'i/ /bdag dpon slob rnams kyis rnam dkar gyi/

/las gsog tshul cung zad 'dir bshad bya/ /bstan dri med skor zhugs gsang sngags 'chang / /zhing ban dhe gtsang ma lnga gsum gyis/ /dus lo gcig zla ba bcu gnyis kyi/ /rje bla ma rnams kyi dus chen skabs/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /chos nyams len bla ma mchod chog dang / /tshul de dang 'brel ba smon lam bzhi/ /rje gong ma rnams kyi bstod ring sogs/ /lan lnga phrag lhag re chag med dang / /de'i steng du tshogs chen bla mchod sogs/ /kun dril ba 'gyur khyad rtsis pa na/ /rje gong bstod bla mchod smon lam sogs/ /dus lo rer stong ra lhag tsam re/ /rje sngags 'chang yab sras mus chen sogs/ /mgon drin can so so'i bstod thung rnams/ /lo gcig la khri gnyis stong gnyis lhag /yang gsang sngags 'dzin pa 'dus tshogs kyis/ /chos zab mo nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i/ /lam tshes bcu sgrub mchod chag med dang / /gzhan mkha' spyod sgrub mchod rnams sdom pas/ /lo gcig gi nang du oṃ gsum ma/ /'bum gnyis dang khri bzhi stong bzhi lhag /dpe 'dis mtshon bde kye gsang gsum dang / /dpal rdo rje phur pa kun rig dang / /gzhan bdag med tshe dpag med sogs kyi/ /sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / /lha'i sgom bzlas sogs kyi grangs tshad kyang / /'gyur rtsis pas mang du 'gro bar nges/ /lha rnams rgyal mchod pa stong rtsa rnams/ /yongs sdom pas lo rer khri lhag re/ /dpal dgyes rdor rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyang / /lo gcig la khri dang brgyad brgya re/ /tshul de ltar brtsis pa'i 'gyur khyad rnams/ /grangs dma' khung kho na bzung ba yin/ /der ma zad bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs rnams/ /lan gsum re sgrog dang zla re bzhin/ /rje gong ma'i dus ja mang ja bdun/ /de rnams la chos spyod bsam mi khyab/ /dus bzang po cho 'phrul zla phyed la/ /nyin bzhin du mang jas bsnyen bkur bas/ /de'i 'bras bu 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/

/chos sman bla smon lam dpag med 'gro/ /der ma zad sgrol ma mtshan brjod dang / /bka' sher snying 'bum gter lo re bzhin/ /dpal ngam ring chos sde chen po ru/ /dus dgun chos mang ja chag med dang / /gzhan phyogs kyi dgon pa che phra'i rigs/ /ngor e waṃ thub bstan gser mdog can/ /byang bzang ldan zhe dgon 'jad yangs can /mus rdo rje gling dang dga' ldan rtse/ /dgon ya ma gling dga' bde ba can/ /yang bya gshong chos 'khor lhun po dang / /gzhan bkra shis lhun po gangs can sogs/ /grangs drug bdun mang na bcu bgrangs la/ /dus lo re bzhin mang du mang skol bgyis/ /de kun la chos spyod bsam las 'das/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /thugs mnyes par byed pa'i bskang gso yang / /lo re rer khri tshar stong tshar dang / /gzhan brgya tshar mang du 'gro nges lags/ /dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang rnams su/ /dus gtan du dkar me'i rgyun bzang dang / /khong 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bsnyen bkur la/ /ja bu ram mar nas chur ba dang / /gzhan gos dar ras sogs mkho dgu'i tshogs/ /dpe ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar bskyil/ /kun bsod nams zhing la 'bul zhing thim/ /de byas kyin dpal 'byor zla ltar rgyas/ /kun rnam par dkar ba'i las bzang la/ /dus khor mo yug tu spyod cing gnas/ /tshe 'di phyir legs pa'i dge ba yis/ /las stobs chen 'di 'dra'i gzhi 'dzin pa/ /bdag skal bzang nang nas skal bzang ste/ /'dis rkang len mthun grogs byed pa yi/ /mi kho bo'i nye 'khor thams cad kyang / /sngon bskal par tshogs rab bsags par nges/ /'di bden rdzun gsung rab bltas pas shes/ /tshul de ltar bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag dpon slob sdig kun byang gyur cig /dpe 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsod nams kyi/ /bdag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /yid bsam pa ma lus lhun grub nas/

/spyi bye brag bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /rgyun rigs brgyud gtsang mas rtag skyong shog /dus nam zhig 'chi 'phor gyur pa'i tshe/ /bdag skal bzang las can dpon slob rnams/ /dus lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /slar gang 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs pas/ /dus srid mthar bstan pa rgyas byed shog /rang dag snang can gyi dpon slob rnams/ /tshe sngon yang smon lam btab btab pas/ dus 'di la bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin/ /da 'dir yang smon lab legs btab pas/ /tshe gtan legs 'dun ma zin nges par/ /pha rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /lha yi dam zhi khros nus pa bskyed/ /ma mkha' 'gro srung mas 'phrin las sgrubs/ /don bsam tshad 'grub par bla ma mkhyen/ /tshig de skad rnam dkar dge las la/ /yid spro ba mchog tu bskyed pa'i gtam/ /blo dpyod ldan yid la dga' bde yis/ /dpal ster ba 'di yi byed po ni/ /rigs dri med 'khon rigs sa skya pa/ /ming ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /rje bla ma kho na'i thugs rje yis/ /tshe 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub nges par/ /blo kha zhe med par yid ches pa'i/ /don skal ba bzang po can des sbyar/ /tshul 'dis kyang kun du dge gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //lam 'jug bzang ngan gyi dris lan phan bde kun khyab bzhugs/211 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dpal sa skya'i dus ja dkar mo'i cha rkyen bsgrub par khams phyogs la 'gro ba'i dpon slob rnams kyi lam 'jug bzang ngan rtsi tshul tshig shin tu nyung ngu'i don rtogs pa zhig dgos zer ba'i lan ni/ za 1 nga 2za3 za 4ba5 nga 6za 7nga 8za 9za 10ba 11nga 12za 13nga 14za 15za 16ba 17nga 18za 19nga 20za 21za 22ba 23nga 24za 25nga 26za 27za 28ba 29nga 30/ zhes pa zla ba gcig gi tshes grangs rnams ni ang gi btab pa bzhin byas par byas la/ de yang za rnams ni lam 'jug shin tu bzang ba'i sde yin la/ nga rnams ni shin tu ngan zhing /

ba rnams ni 'bring du shes par bya'o/ /don 'di la dgongs nas bdag la bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi gsung las/ gcig gsum bzhi yi sde tshan shin tu bzang / /gnyis dang drug gi sde tshan shin tu ngan/ /lnga yi sde tshan 'bring yin thub na spangs/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di yang khams phyogs la 'gro ba'i don gnyer rnams kyis lam 'jug bzang ngan bris pa'i lan du sa skya pa a nan+das sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod kyi blo gros rab tu gsal ba bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so// ༈ //rab 'byams pa kun bsam la smras pa'i nyams dbyangs bzhugs/212 na mo gu ru ye/ pha 'gran zla bral sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /bu mi phyed pa'i dad pas gus btud nas/ /sprang chos ma nus ngag dbang kun bsod ngas/ /khyed rab 'byams kun dga'i ming can la/ /sems brtse ba yi tshig 'ga' smras kyi nyon/ /sngon bsags dge bas las 'phro bzang bas/ /brnyed la ma thang dal 'byor lus brnyed/ /gzhon nu rab 'byung thos pas rgyud phyug /rdo rje 'chang dngos sngags 'chang rje la/ /zab chos nos te ngo mtshar che'o/ /'on kyang thar 'dod bcos min med pas/ /mi tshe dkor nag bza' bas g.yengs te/ /da ni na tshod che cher rgas 'di/ /gang nas bsam yang skyo mo min nam/ /sngon tshe dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid/ dam chos rgya mtsho'i 'byung nas yin yang / /ding sang gang gi dri mas ma gos/ /'di ru 'dug tshe de las ma 'das/ /da ni dgong nyi tsam gyi tshe la/ /don med g.yengs ba thams cad spang te/ /gzhan dbang shor ba'i bsgrub sde min pa'i/ /dben gnas mthun rkyen gang 'dzoms zhig tu/ /lam bzang nyams su len par rigs so/ /nyams su len rgyu'i lam la mang yang / /kun gyi mchog ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ /yin zhes gsung rab rnams las bshad do/ /de nyid nyams su len tshul 'di ste/ /rang la dbang dang man ngag bstan pa'i/

/sngags 'chang bla ma rnam pa dges rdor/ /sku la gdan gsum tshang bar bsgom la/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas mchod cing / /dbang bzhi blangs nas bzhi pa'i don la/ /ci nas bzhag cing gsol ba btab nas/ /bla ma de nyid rang la bstim ste/ /sku gsung thugs dang sgo gsum bsres la/ /bde stong dang la lho de 'jog go /mnyam gzhag dus kyi nyams len de yin/ /rjes thob dus su gzugs dang sgra dang / /sems kyi rtog 'gyu gang snang thams cad/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa/ /yang dang yang du dran 'dzin bya zhing / /kun kyang bden zhen med par gal che/ /da lta'i lam zab nyams su len skabs/ /le lo'i bdud kyi bar gcod byung na/ /nges par 'chi nges nam 'chi cha med/ /'chi tshe gang gi phan med som zhig /nged kyang gzhon dus rkyen 'gas bskul te/ /tshe 'di blos btang bsgrub pa 'dod nas/ /de nyid sna tshogs thabs kyis bsgrub kyang / /tshogs ma bsags pas lag tu ma long / /da ni gzhan don ltar snang bgyid sogs/ /don gnyis bsgrub blo'i g.yengs ba 'di yis/ /gnyis phung las la sbyar dogs 'dug mod/ /'on kyang sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar/ /skyong 'dod legs pas don 'di 'grub par/ /mtshan ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /ces pa 'di ni gzu bo'i blo can rab 'byams pa kun dga' bsam 'grub kyis bskul nas/ tshul khrims kyi dri zhim gyi lus mdzes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bris pa'o/ yang smras pa/ rang ni nam 'chi dang gar skye cha med kyang / /gzhan 'khor ba las skyobs pa'i khas len can/ /mi kho bo 'dra'i yar 'dren gzugs brnyan dag /skyabs bslu med tsho'i thugs rjes 'bral med bzung / /mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //rab 'byams pa bsod nams blo gros la bskur ba'i 'pho ba'i yi ge yod/213 na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ spyir 'pho ba la rnam pa mang yang / rang re sa skya pa la gsung ngag lam 'bras las bshad pa 'di rnams mchog tu gyur pa yin la/

de la yang mang du yod kyang las dang po la snang ba 'gyur ba'i 'da' kha ma 'di bsgom bde ba 'dug pas/ de'i bsgom tshul 'di ltar bya ste/ rang 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ dngos po gang la yang chags zhen rdul tsam yang med par byas la/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi lha dang bla ma tha mi dad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ phyi nang yid 'byung gi mchod yan lag bdun pa byas la/ mos gus drag pos gsol ba dung dung pa yang yang btab/ gang snang lha'i dkyil 'khor du shes dgos pas snang ba za zi gang byung thams cad bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag po rgyun ma chad pa btang la/ de'i thugs kar rang nyid skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin 'phos pa'i dmigs pa yang dang yang du bya'o/ /de'i dus su 'das na lha dang bdag sems ro gcig gyur te bar do med par grub mtha' bsnyogs pa'am/ /rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur gsungs so/ /da lam khams 'tsho bar smon/ gal te mi 'tsho na yang 'chi ba la 'jigs pa dang / skrag pa med par mdzod la/ bag dro hur re/ shes pa spro sing nge ba'i ngang nas 'pho ba zab mo 'di bsgom mdzod dang / gdam ngag gis mi bslu thag chod do/ /skyes phyin chad 'chi ba kun la yong bas ngal rgyu rdul tsam yang med/ dal 'byor thob nas tshig gcig tsam mi shes par 'chi ba dang / sdig pa kho na bsags pas 'chi ba rnams sdug bsngal ba yin mod/ khyed rab tu byung zhing sbyangs pa yang chen po yin pas phyi ma bcol ba len pas 'dra ba zhig yong par go lags/ rang dang nye gnas grwa pa nyi thung du smras pa'i gdams pa bzhugs/214 rje mus pa'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /khyed grwa pa rnams la nyi thung du/ /sprang chos med nga yi glu 'di 'bul/ /rten brnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor 'di/ /dpe nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon/ /'di lung dang rig pa'i dpyad na gsal/ /kho blun po rnams kyi log lta'i rgyu/

/tshe 'dir snang sna tshogs legs nyes kun/ /tshe snga ma'i las kyi 'bras bur gda'/ /rgyu des na tshe 'di'i bde sdug tshogs/ /gang byung yang rang gi nyes pa bsgom/ rang nam 'chi'i gtad re med bzhin du/ /tshe 'dir snang lto gos gtam gsum la/ /yid mngon zhen drag po byed lugs 'di/ /khong rgyal bas gzigs na spyan chab 'chor/ /tshe gtan du legs sam gtan du nyes/ /rten dal 'byor 'di la rag las kyang / /don sdug bsngal bde bar ming btags pa'i/ /tshe 'dir snang 'dun ma sgrub bsgrub nas/ /tshe phyi ma brjed pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /lar 'dir snang rnam rtog gang skyes kyang / /rang 'chi ba'i bsam mno thong mdzod dang / /don gang gi'ang dgos pa 'dug re kan/ /rab tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang ste/ /gnas mi med g.ya' brag gangs brag 'grims/ /zas rlung zas gos su gtum mo gyon/ /'bring tshe 'di'i bya ba rags rim la/ /blo re thag chod la dben pa bsgom/ /tshul de yang yid kyi mi lcogs na/ /blo mtshan ldan bla mar lding khel ba/ /tshe 'dir snang can dang ma 'grogs par/ /las sdig spong dge la 'bad 'bung thon/ /nged gzhon nu'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ /bstan rin chen 'di nyid spel ba'i phyir/ /yid ngal dub drag po mang byas kyang / /da dus ngan 'di la thug pa'i mthus/ /yid ngal ba 'bras med kho nar 'dug /'di som la dad ldan grwa pa rnams/ /bstan 'phel ba'i mthun grogs yang dag mdzod/ /lar deng sang dus 'dir bstan 'dzin du/ /mtshan gsol ba'i gang zag mang na yang / /phal che ba kho bo nyid dang mtshungs/ /don mtshan don ldan pa re re tsam/ /dpe 'dis kyang bstan pa nyams re dma'/ /blo dpyod ldan gzur gnas skyes bu las/ /yid khrel med byed rnams go 'phang mtho/ /dpe 'dis kyang bstan pa nyams re dma'/ /lar deng sang skabs kyi snang tshul kun/ /bstan nyams pa'i rgyud las gzhan ma mchis/ /rgyu des na bsam gyin skyo ba la/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'khon rigs rnal 'byor pa a nan+da'i ming can gyi rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i grwa pa rnams la nyi thung du smras pa'o/

/rang gi slob bu chags can 'ga' la smras pa'i yi ge bzhugs/215 'dir smras pa/ 'ga' zhig 'dod chags chu ltar 'khrug byed cing / /phal cher phrag dog zhe sdang drag po bskyed/ /kun kyang nyon mongs dag la sbyor byed pa'i/ /bdag lus mdzes pa 'di yi ci zhig bya/ /phung khams skye mched lha sku bde stong che/ /thabs kyi bsgyur na 'gyur mod tha mal lus/ /sha khrag mi gtsang rdzas kyi gong bu la/ /chags pa spyod 'dod de dag ma 'khrul lam/ /dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad tshe mdzes lus kyi/ /sha rus lpags pa bya khyi'i za mthong bas/ /gtad med de la chags sems bskyed pa las/ /rang lus lha skur bsgom na mi legs sam/ /lang 'tsho yol ba'i bzhin ras gnyer mas gang / /rab mdzes so yi phreng ba rnams kyang 'thor/ /mnyen drang lus kyang rgur zhing 'khar la brten/ /de 'dra'i rgyu la su zhig chags sems bskyed/ /'byung bzhi 'khrug pa'i nad kyi gdung ba'i tshe/ /kha skam mig sdibs lus kyis ldang mi nus/ /dbugs ma chad pa'i ro 'dra 'gyur ba'i gzhi/ /so skye'i lus rten mdzes kyang rtag mi thub/ /de phyir de la blo ldan su zhig chags/ /mdor na so skye'i grogs 'di phal che ba/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran sems can/ /bstod na nga rgyal smad na khong khro skye/ /de dag bdag la mgu bar byed pa yi/ /sna tshogs thabs la 'bad pa byed byed nas/ /rang gi 'di phyi'i don rnams yal bar 'chor/ /des na 'byor dus gnyen la rgud dus dgra/ /deng sang dus kyi skye bo 'di rnams kyi/ /bzhin legs la sogs mdzes dang mi mdzes pa/ /su la'ang zhen chags ches na rang phung lags/ /zhes pa 'di yang rnal 'byor pa nan+da'i ming can gyis rang gi slob bu chags can 'ga' zhig gi don du shin du myur bar bris pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ tshul 'di myur bar bris pa'i phyir/ /tshig sbyor ha cang mi lags kyang / /don la som dang deng dus kyi/

/skye bo kun gyi sems la phan/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs blo bde'i myu gu zhes bya bzhugs/216 pha gcig chog rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu slob mar bcas la byin gyis rlobs/ /rje gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /gnas ya mtshan can chu mig rdzing kha 'di/ /nga rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun bsod nga / /rang sems nyams len bsres nas 'jog /khyed 'dir gnas kyi grwa pa bu slob rnams/ /blo sdug btsir gyi rang sdug ma bzo bar/ /khong gdan sa yi lha mi byin rnams kyi/ /dus deng sang gi rnam thar ya re nga / /dpon mang po yi thugs ngo 'dzin 'dzin nas/ /nyin mtshan med lus sems ngal byas kyang / /khong nyes med 'ga' don med chad pas bcad/ /de bsam gyin yang khong rnams snying rtsar 'dar/ /da ci 'dra rang drag zhes smre sngags 'don/ /blo chung ba 'ga' don med mchi ma gtong / /khong 'di tsho yi snang tshul la som dang / /rang dpon slob bde ba'i tshad du gda'/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mas bzung ste bde/ /blo gsung rab don la sbyangs ste bde/ /'phral 'du 'dzi'i g.yengs bas ma khyer bde/ /chos mthun gyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms te bde/ /rang dpon slob kun chos dang mthun pas bde/ /rgyu de bas na rang sems gzur gnas pa'i/ /sa dbus gtsang gi skye bo drag zhan kun/ /rang dpon slob la gcig tu dad pas na/ /khong mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams/ /las dge ba'i las la bkol te bde/ /lar bde ba'i gnas tshul brjod mi lang / /gnas bde mchog pho brang ming don ldan/ /nga kun dga'i ming can don la gnas/ /khyed 'dir tshogs grwa pa nyams re dga'/ /'di mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /lar chog shes blo dang mi ldan na/ /gang byas kyang bde ba'i skabs mi srid/ /'di grwa pa kun gyi thugs la zhog /ces pa 'di yang rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yud tsam zhig la bris pa'o/

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //grogs mchog bshes gnyen rnam gnyis la/ smras pa'i gsang ba'i nyams dbyangs bzhugs/217 na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ pha dran pas gdung sel mus pa rjer/ /bdag shes nas dad pas rgyun du 'dud/ /mgon khyod zhabs lo brgya brtan pa dang / /gsung bdud rtsir slar yang 'thung bar shog /mi kho bos bsod nams gyis thob pa'i/ /grogs mchog gyur bshes gnyen rnam pa gnyis/ /sems dwangs ba'i yid kyis yud tsam gson/ /gnas phun tshogs gdan sa chen po 'di/ /sngon yongs 'dzin bzhugs pa'i bla brang yin/ /yongs bshes gnyen 'du ba'i 'du khang yin/ /chos zab rgyas kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /don sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel sa yin/ /dus ding sang dpal ldan sa skya 'dir/ /de thams cad srid pa tsam du snang / /tshul 'di la bsam bzhin skyo ba skyes/ /chos shes pa'i skye bo med gyur na/ /gsung po ti mang yang sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan rin chen zhig pa yin no zhes/ /chos kun mkhyen sa skya paṇa chen gsungs/ /de deng sang dpal ldan sa skyar gda'/ /tshul 'di yang skyong ba skye ba'i gzhi/ /gnas mchog 'dir 'khrul zad sngon byon pa'i/ /rje gong mas bzhengs pa'i glegs bam rnams/ /dus deng sang mthong 'dod skye bo dkon/ /'ga' yod kyang la le'i mthong dogs dgag /'di dpyod ldan khrel ba'i rgyu min nam/ /bka' mdo rgyud sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas/ /bstan gsal bar byed pa'i bshes gnyen la/ /chos gang yang mi shes blun po dag /chos mchog tu 'dzin pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /bstan 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu gda' 'am/ /mi kho bo sngon byon gong ma yis/ /gang mdzad pa'i rnam thar skyong 'dod pa/ /don kha zhe med par yin pa'i phyir/ /skyabs bslu med dkon mchog dpang bzhag pa'i/ /las dus rnams kun du spyad na yang / /khyod chos bzhin bgyid pa mi 'os zhes/ /khong dam par khas 'che skyes bu'i yang / /tshig de skad yang yang smra ba thos/

/'di rang sems bag chags ngan pa'i tshogs/ /rab 'thug pas mthong snang yin snyam sems/ /tshul 'di la kho bos mchi ma dku/ sems dung ba las kyang dung ba'i mchog /ma lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo de/ /mi nged dang skad cig 'bral mi phod/ /tshul de ltar yod kyang sngon bsags pa'i/ /las ngan pas glo bur gtan bral byung / /'di yang yang skyo ba'i gzhi na gda'/ /dus deng sang chos mthun las byed pa'i/ /mi de la mthun rkyen gser bas dkon/ /chos mi mthun spyod kyis dus 'da' ba/ /de rnams la dgos 'dod char ltar 'bab/ /tshul 'di yang bsam gyin skyo ba 'phel/ /khong ngan pa 'ga' zhig dam pa la/ /yid mthun la che cher mi dga' bas/ /tshig ngan pa du mas phan tshun dkrugs/ /tshul 'di nyid rang gzhan gnyis phung rgyu/ /yin phyir na 'di yang bsam bzhin skyo/ /dus deng sang skabs 'dir sngags dgon 'gar/ /ming don ldan sngags 'chang rnams dor nas/ /kho nag chang bag med spyod pa rnams/ /kha drag zhan kun gyis mchod pa mthong / /tshul de bzhin deng sang bshad grwa 'gar/ /khong blo ldan thos bsam spyod rnams dang / /zas kho na don du gnyer ba dag /khyad med par dam par khas 'che ba'i/ /khong skyes bu rnams kyi'ang 'dzin par mthong / /tshul 'di rnams bsam na bstan bsam pa'i/ /mi deng sang rin chen gser bas dkon/ /'di skyo ba las kyang skyo ba 'dug /sngon bsags pa'i las bzang gyis 'brel ba'i/ /chos mthun pa'i rang re dpon slob rnams/ /dus da nas byang chub bar gyi skyabs/ /skyabs kun 'dus sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /skyon tshig gcig brjod pa'i gzhi bral ba'i/ /pha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan khong la zhu/ /dus rgyun du rang gzhan bstan gsum la/ /cher phan pa'i las kyi sgo gsum po/ /rab ngal yang 'bad pa spyad par bya/ /lar 'gyod med las kyis dus 'das na/ /dus deng sang khrel med mang ba'i phyir/ /gang bden na de nyid pham par go /'phral de ltar snang yang rang re rnams/

/gnas kun gyi mi mngon dbyings bzhugs pa'i/ /khong dkon mchog rgya mtsho ma khrel na/ /dus deng sang skabs kyi mi phal cher/ /don ngan par 'dug pas de rnams la/ /rang pham par byung ba dus kyi dbang / /de yin phyir pham la ngal mi dgos/ /'phral pham yang phugs su rgyal ba yin/ /de'i rgyu mtshan 'khrul ngor dkon mchog dang / /las rgyu 'bras thams cad bden phyir ro/ /zhes pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis sems skyo ba'i ngang nas myur bar bris te grogs mchog bshes gnyen rnam gnyis la phul ba'o/ /yi ge 'di gtad thub grogs po min pa kun la gsang bar zhu/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //grogs mchog smra ba dge 'dun 'od zer la gdams pa'i yi ge bzhugs/21ྃ8 thos bsam bsgom pa'i nyams len mthar phyin pa'i/ /rgyal ba mus pa rje la gus btud nas/ /blo ldan shes nas dwangs ba bskyed pa'i yul/ /rab 'byams ming don ldan la 'di skad smra/ nam yang shes bya'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'ang nam yong cha med pas/ /dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba rnams/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsgom cig rab 'byams pa/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ldan mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa'i tshogs/ /chos brgyad rkyen gyi kha nas ma skyug par/ /blo kha nang du phyogs pa'i nyams len gyis/ /sgro 'dogs nang nas chod cig rab 'byams pa/ /don med rtsod pas rang gzhan ma bsreg par/ /don ldan gnad la 'dris pa'i 'brel gtam gyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon rdo rje spun grogs sogs/ /dges phyir rtog pa phul cig rab 'byams pa/ /rab bsnyen mtha' ru 'khyol ba'i gdengs tshad kyis/ /rang nyid mi bslu'i gnas su ma sleb par/ /yar 'dren gzugs kyi rang gzhan mi bslu bar/ /rtse gcig rang mgo thon cig rab 'byams pa/ /bshad rtsod gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /chos kun gtan la dbab par ci mkhas kyang / /rkyen ngan byung tshe phan par mi gda' bas/

/rtag tu zab don bsgom zhig rab 'byams pa/ /kun la gnod pas ngan pa'i grogs dag la/ /dung sems ches na rang gzhan kun phung bas/ /phul de drag po'i sbyor ba ma yin pa'i/ /thabs la mkhas pas spongs shig rab 'byams pa/ /mtshan ldan dbang bzhi bskur ba'i bla ma de/ /sangs rgyas dngos su blo thag chod pa dang / de gsung srog la babs kyang bsgrub snyam pa'i/ /mi phyed dad pa bskyed cig rab 'byams pa/ /bag chags ngan pas blang bas snang srid 'di/ /bla ma lha dang gnyis su med pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin bde stong cher/ /dran 'dun drag pos bskyed cig rab 'byams pa/ /rtag tu rtog 'gyu ngan pa'i rgyun bcad de/ /yang yang sems kyi rang zhal blta ba dang / /chos kun rig stong ngang du brjod med du/ /rang ngo shes par mdzod cig rab 'byams pa/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyi grogs mchog dam pa rab 'byams smra ba dge 'dun 'od zer la smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //grogs mchog dam pa rab 'byam smra ba la gdams pa'i yi ge mthong ba rab dga' bzhugs/219 'dir smras pa/ grogs mchog dam pa snyoms ldan gyi ngang du gnas legs sam/ kho bo cag kyang sems rtse gcig pas dkon mchog rin po cher blo gtad zhu ba'i gsol 'debs su phur tshugs ngang nas bde legs su gnas/ bsrings don rang re mjal bar gyi zhag kha yar 'di'i bar grogs mchog khyed rang zab lam thams cad kyi bcud bsdus bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad 'bungs thon la/ de kho na nyid la blo 'jog pa'i skabs su man ngag gi gnad 'di yang yang dran par mdzod la/ thun re la blo bskyed gong 'phel du 'gro ba bgyid pa cis kyang gal che che/ man ngag gi gnad 'di dag yin te/ pha bla ma yi dam rang sems gsum/ /don gdod nas dbyer med yin pa la/ /de de ltar rang ngo shes byas nas/ /lus skyil krung mnyam gzhag rgal tshigs bsrangs/
