/mig dbye btsum ran pa gang bde bya/ /dus de tshe sems kyi sems nyid la/ /blo khrims kyi sgrim nas cher gyis lta/ /nam langs pa bzhin du gsal le ba/ /de sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba yin/ /sems gsal bar snang ba'i rang mdangs de/ /legs brtags na skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /mkha' dag pa bzhin du sang nge ba/ /de sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa yin/ /stong pa mnyam du 'dzin pa gsal ba ste/ /blo gsal snang gdod nas spros dang bral/ /tshul de la ngo bo zung 'jug zer/ /gnad 'di tsho sems la bzung mdzod la/ /de yang dang yang du bsgom pa las/ /sems rtog med gsal le sing nge ba/ /de mar me rlung bral ji bzhin du/ /yun ji tsam bzhag kyang gnas 'dod na/ /chos kha bshad tsam du ma lus pa/ /don sems la 'jug sgo dod pa yin/ /rje yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan gyis/ /gsung bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i tshogs bsags rnams/ /gnad 'di 'dra bsgom pa skal ba bzang / /gzhan dam pas dben pa'i skye bo dag /gang byas kyang thar pa'i go skabasadaka'/ /rgyu des na grogs mchog dam pa khyed/ /sems dga' dang spro ba cher bskyed la/ /yid le lo'i ngang du mi btang 'tshal/ /mi kho bo'i drung du gnas na yang / tshig 'di las gzhan 'ga' smra rgyu med/ /rgyang ring por gnas kyang 'di bsgom na/ /mi nged dang cung zad 'bral mi srid/ /gang ltar kyang sngon bsags las bzang pos/ /thugs yid gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa yis/ /blo rab gsal rang re dpon slob gnyis/ /dus 'dir yang yun du 'grogs pa dang / /mtha' byang chub bar du 'bral ba med/ /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ grogs mchog dam pa rab 'byams smra ba dge 'dun 'od zer la sems lhag par brtse bas bsam pas kun nas blangs te gdams pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bka' bcu pa 'od zer gyi mtha' can la smras pa'i legs bshad dpyod ldan legs par byed pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs/220

lo ka tsak+ṣu: bud+dha dh+wa dza ya na maḥ mi kho bos sngon bsags bsod nams las/ /legs grub pa sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /rje mus pa chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas rnams/ /yid bsam don 'bad med mthar phyin par/ /pha mtshan ldan khyed kyi byin gyis rlobs/ /bu tshur la gson dang bka' bcu pa/ /khyed sngar byas dge ba mi dman pas/ /dus 'di ru dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /thob tsam du ma zad chos sgor zhugs/ /sngon sbyangs pas skyes thob blo gsal bas/ /chos shes bya kun la yid rab 'jug /de 'gal rkyen dbang du ma shor bas/ /dus deng sang skabs kyi rab 'byams pa/ /khas 'che ba 'ga' las da lta yang / /khyed gzhung lugs don la mkhas so zhes/ /khong dpyod ldan gzur gnas phal cher sgrog /'di ngo mtshar che'o rjes yi rang / /lar mdo rgyud dgongs 'brel gsung rab don/ /sna gcig la tshe gang sbyangs na yang / /de'i don de'ang mthar phyin rtogs pa dka'/ /rgyu des na lo 'ga' sbyangs pa las/ /gzhung 'ga' re'i don rnams cha tsam zhig /go tsam la mkhas pa chen po nyid/ /yin snyam du sems pa de dag ni/ /don blun po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yin/ /'di som la blo gros ldan pa khyed/ /yid shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs pa dag /mthar phyin par mdzod cig bka' bcu pa/ /de'i rjes su mtshan ldan bla ma'i tshogs/ /grangs mang du 'tshol la de rnams la/ /gsung bdud rtsi mtha' dag legs 'thung la/ /rang sems dang bsres nas bsgom pa dang / /'gro gzhan la'ang spel cig bka' bcu pa/ /rje gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig tu/ /legs gsal ba'i chos rgyun de thams cad/ /dus deng sang med pa shas che bas/ /chos zab mo yod pa'i skye bo de/ /rten gshan pa yin yang zab chos la/ /khung rnam dag yod na blang bar rigs/ /don bstan pa'i rgyun la phan phyir ro/ /hril bsdu ba'i don 'bras 'di ltar ste/ /rang gtan du legs sam gtan du nyes/

/rten dal 'byor 'di la rag legs pas/ /de yang yang som zhig bka' bcu pa/ /rang dus rnams gtan du legs 'dod na/ /mi kho bos gong du legs bshad pa'i/ /don de dag blang dor byed pa la/ /sems the tshom ma byed bka' bcu pa/ /rang dus rnams gtan du nyes 'dod na/ /dus deng sang mi rnams phal che ba'i/ /las byed lugs 'di bzhin mdzad pas chog /ha ha/ bu blangs dor tshul bzhin bgyid pa la/ /gegs bar gcod gang yang mi 'byung bar/ /don mtha' ru 'khyol ba bla ma mkhyen/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyi bka' bcu pa bsod nams 'od zer la smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //ki ra ṇa'i mtha' can la sems brtse ba'i lak+ṣ+ma ṇi lin+ta bzhugs/221 na maḥtsakra sam+ba ra: 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ gnas mchog bhu mi sa skyar/ paṇ+ḍu kar skyes pa'i/ /madzñu shrīs 'jam dpal/ byin rlabs a nan+das/ kun dga'/ bhik+ṣu dge slong / nyal slong che ldan ki ra ṇa'i/ 'od zer/ mtha' can khyed la an+ta ka ra ṇaṃ/ nang gi byed pa ste sems kyi mngon brjod/ shiṅka som pa ste the tshom gyi mngon brjod/ dang bral shu kla'i ngang nyid nas/ dkar po/ ne gus med/ la ri ṭa spangs pa'i a mnyes byed/ na nā/ /cung zad smra ba'i shru gus par nyan pa/ shru ṣaṃ gyis shig /sid+dhar+tha: don 'grub ste shākya thub pa'i mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ yi gsung rab u da dhi/ chu gter ste rgya mtsho'i mngon brjod/ lta bur snang mod khyod kyi ma ṇi ṣās/ yid tshol ste shes rab kyi mngon brjod/ ma hā bī tsi rlabs chen ta lbu ba'i mngon brjod/ tsam zhig shes pa'i don/ /a na me pho 'brug la yi lo 'di mkhas mang dbus/ /bāg+mī smra mkhas/ bgyis te rab 'byams ming /

nā ma nyid/ /bgyid pa de la blo gsal ma nu ṣ+ya/ yid skyes te mi'i mngon brjod/ kho bos hri snying po ste sems kyi mngon brjod/ da yam mchog dga' bar 'gyur/ /'on kyang ma nu bu ngas bsam pa ni/ /san+de the tshom/ ha nyid gyur te 'di ltar sems/ /dus ngan ka li: rtsod dus/ 'di la sarba kun mkhyen/ dzñā/ na ra'i mi'i/ gzugs 'dzin dharmā chos kyi rje/ swa mi yi/ /drung du at+ma bdag nyid dang lhan cig pas/ /bya gi a shā kun khyab ste phyogs kyi mngon brjod/ a shū legs/ myur du/ bgrod ste/ /'khrul pa'i dri med shrī wan+sargu rus/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ gsung gi a mṛ ta bdud rtsi/ dag legs 'thung nas/ /de rjes 'phrin las mtha' med ste nam mkha'i mngon brjod/ a nan+daṃ khyab par/ bskyangs te skabs su babs tshe dzi ba dang / 'tsho ba ste bdag gi mngon brjod/ khyod nyid gcig tu dharmā chos/ 'i legs bshad kyis/ /dga' ston bgyis na nyid kyang ut+pa ta/ skye ba/ mchog gyur thob dus lo ka nā thā: 'jig rten mgon po/ mchog /rje btsun tra kā la dus gsum mkhyen pa/ dzñā:dang mjal bas/ /tshe rabs gtan du legs pa'i gzhi thob cing / /nged kyang dha ra ṇa ba ti khyod dang / zung ldan te blo'i mngon brjod/ rab tu mthun phyir tsit+ta 'dir lus nas/ sems/ bem po'i gā lus/ tāṃ di sha: phyogs/ la bzhud pa'i/ /li shu a kaṃ bde med/ mi 'byung ba ma sogs/ /rang gzhan rtag tu shu bhaṃ bde legs/ 'gyur snyam legs/ /de ltar na yang drin chen ā tsar+yas/ slob dpon/ wa ga ngag tshig brjod pa/ gi rā bā ṇi ji bzhin du/ /mahā ma ti ldan pa khyed rang kyang / blo gros chen po/ bgyid 'dod yod na dhi blo/ dang sbyor ba mdzod/ /de ltar rtse ta sems dpa' ste sems kyi mngon brjod/

nye ba'i ak+ṣ+ma ṇaṃ/ mtshon byed/ lin+ta yi ge 'di ni mañdzu badz+ra 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ kyis/ /thig le 'dzin pa shākya'i bha dan+tu/ btsun pa/ a nan+da kun dga'/ yi ā hwa ya 'bod phyogs/ ldan pa gang des shrī dpal/ bhu mi sa skya/ paṇ+ḍu ka'i/ /lha chen bla brang phun tshogs gling nyid kyis/ /dh+ya na gā rar bsam gtan khang bu/ myur bar bris pa'o/ /gang 'di'i rang bzhin swasti dza yan+tu/ bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig sarba maṅgal/ thams cad bkra shis/ ka l+ye na war+dhan+tu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ ༈ //rab 'byams smra ba ki ra ṇa'i mtha' can la gnang ba'i bka' shog bzhugs/222 rgyal ba mus pa rje la gus btud nas/ /mang du thos pa'i dge slong sa skya pa/ /byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /grogs mchog rab 'byams smra bar 'phrin 'di bsrings/ /blo ldan khyod kyi ri mo rten dang bcas/ /kho bos gzugs 'dzin dbang po skyon med drung / /nyams med rgya ldan 'byor pas shes pa spro/ /phan tshun dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' bde rgyas/ /de nang bsring don ji bzhin nges pa'i lan/ /grogs mchog khyed kyi snga phyi'i bsam sbyar la/ /snying yod su zhig dga' ba cis mi skye/ /de phyir kho bo'ang mchog tu bsam pa tshim/ /lhag par ngo mtshar che'o rje yid rang / /da dung de bzhin yeng med brjed med mdzod/ /khyod kyi bsam sbyor de las ma 'das na/ /kho bo cag dang rje btsun mus chen gnyis/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med zhal bzhes yod/ /de phyir khyod kyi 'di phyi'i 'dun ma legs/ /blang dor ma log dga' ba sgoms shig bu/ /kho bo 'di phyogs dad ldan 'ga' re la/ /'dod chos 'chad dang mchog gsum gsol 'debs la/ /brtson pa'i ngang nas gsar bu med tsam gnas/ /dpyod ldan kho bos dus rnams thams cad du/ /thos bsam sgom dang mkhas pa'i las gsum gyis/

/spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /rab rgyas dbyar mtsho bzhin du spel snyam pa'i/ /bsam sbyor drag pos ngal ba mang byas kyang / /kye ma da ni bstan pa nyams 'dod pas/ /ngan pa'i skye bos gdug rtsub sna tshogs kyi/ /dus rnams gtan du bsam don bsgrub dka' ba/ /'di la bsam pas yang yang mchi ma dku/ lhag par gzur gnas mang thos rnams dpyod can/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i grogs mchog rnams/ /skye bo ngan pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /kho bo cag dang sa yul gyi bskal ba/ /'di las ngal ba byung tshul 'di ltar ste/ /rang nyid gcig pu'am tshogs pa'i dbus gnas kyang / /'brel thabs med pa'i snying gi grogs mchog khyed/ /brjed med snying gi dkyil na lhang nge ba/ /'bral med dran pa'i yul du gsal le ba/ /dus rnams kun du sems la dung nge ba/ /yang dang yang du mig sngar lam me ba/ /de phyir rmi lam ngang du yud tsam mjal/ /mjal kyang mngon sum spyod pa'i yul med pas/ /kye ma mi srid srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /bdag gi chos bzhin byas pas thog tu babs/ /bslu med dkon mchog rnams kyang thugs rje chung / /bka' srung rnams kyang mthu rtsal dman no snyam/ /yid chad sdug bsngal bzod glag med pa'i ngang / /khyad par 'khor ngan spyod pas sems dkrugs tshe/ /grogs mchog rab 'byams smra ba snying nas dran/ /'on kyang rang nyid sngon gyi las 'phro yis/ /tshe 'dir lugs gnyis shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la/ /blang dor byed pa'i blo gros mig gsal zhing / /lhag par yongs 'dzin mchog gi bka' drin las/ /gang snang lha dang bla ma'i rnam rol du/ /dran 'dun drag pos gsol 'debs ngang du gnas/ /slar yang de phyogs khams kyi 'tsho skyong dang / /gang spyi'i gnas la blang dor rab mkhas shing / /bslu med skyabs la gsol 'debs 'bad rtsol thon/ /da lam yi ge rten du rgya dar la/ /sngags btab rdo rje mdud pa rgya ldan bcas/

/bsam rtse brang chen yang thog gnas nas bris// ༈ //legs bshad mthong ba bde skyed bzhugs/223 'dir smras pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs bzung nas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad la btud de/ /'khon rigs btsun pa ngag dbang kun bsod ngas/ /bka' bcu 'dzin pa bsod nams 'od zer la/ /snying nas brtse ba'i tshig 'ga' smra yi nyon/ /mang thos blo gsal ngag dbang kun bsod nga / /chos rgyal chen po nam mkha' tshe dbang sogs/ /byang phyogs bstan skyong rnams dang mjal ba dang / /las can 'ga' la 'brel ba 'jog phyir dang / /gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon pa'am/ /skal ldan slob sogs mthun rkyen gang 'dzoms sar/ /gsung ngag rin chen dga' ston spel ba dang / /khyad par bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs/ /rje btsun bud+dha'i zhal dkyil blta ba dang / /gsung gi bdud rtsi lhag rnams 'thung ba la/ /ring por mi thogs myur du 'gro bar bgyid/ /dngos cag phyogs na yod pa'i gnas skabs 'gar/ /dad ldan khyod nyid kho bo dran gyur na/ /sems nyid ngal ba'i rtog 'gyu'i rgyun bcad de/ /man ngag 'di nyid rtag tu dran par mdzod/ /rang sems dag pa'i mig gis blta shes na/ /snang srid 'di kun bla ma'i rang bzhin te/ /da lta snod bcud tha mal snang ba 'di'i/ /sems nyid bag chags ngan pas bslad las byung / /rang rig gdod ma'i bla ma ngo shes nas/ /sems snang 'di kun de yi ngo bor 'char/ /de ltar shes nas 'khor gsum shes rab kyi/ /zin pa'i ngang nas gsol 'debs la brtson na/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bad med 'grub par nges/ /gnad 'di shes na mtshan ldan bla ma dang / /byang chub bar du skad cig 'bral mi srid/ /tshul 'di mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi/ /zab don kun gyi bcud bsdus man ngag la/ /de phyir gzugs sku snang ba'i bla ma de/ /nye ring gang na bzhugs kyang sngar bshad pa'i/ /zab don de dag rgyud la sbyor ba gces/

/de min bla ma'i lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'grogs kyang rang sems bag chags ngan pa yis/ /dug chus bslad phyir log lta cher 'phel nas/ /don med gtan phugs dam tshig nyams su dogs/ /da dung legs bshad cha 'ga' bshad kyi nyon/ /kye ma deng dus skye bo phal cher rnams/ /rang nyid bde yang gzhan dag bde dogs pa'i/ /bsam ngan drag pos spyod ngan sna tshogs kyi/ /gnyis phung las la sbyor ba mang zhing mthong / /blun po rang gi mtshan nyid ston pa la/ /'jug dogs ma byed ci bder bzhag na legs/ /kye hud snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs rags/ /ji ltar byas kyang smon tshig kho na smra/ /de phyir gzhan gyi blo khrid byed byed nas/ /rang don yal bar shor ba'i nyan yod do/ /sems nyid bag chags 'thug pas snang srid yul/ /gang la chags sdang drag po skyes pa'i tshe/ /chos kun mtha' bzhi spros dang bral ba dang / /nam 'chi nges pa med snyam bsam pa mdzod/ /'dir snang grags bde'i zar zir la dga' na/ /brnyed dka' dal 'byor rin chen stong log la/ /des na da lta'i bsam pabazang po'i rgyun/ /'di bzhin rtag tu khyod dang brtan pa zin/ /mtshan nyid ldan ba'i bla ma srog ltar bzung / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mig 'bras bzhin du bsten/ /blo ldan grogs mchog rin chen rgyan ltar khyong / /de ltar byas na yon tan khong 'phel 'gyur/ /rtag tu rang gi 'gyod med las byas kyang / /ngan pa'i grogs kyis yang yang sems dkrug na/ /yul de thabs kyis mkhas pas spongs rigs kyi/ /drag sbyor bgyis na rang gzhan gnyis phung lags/ /da res dal 'byor lan cig thob dus 'dir/ /gtan du legs pa'i 'dun ma bsgrub pa la/ /le lo ches na nam 'chi cha med cing / /'chi tshe 'gyod kyang bya thabs ma mchis la/ /des na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /thos bsam sgom la 'bad rtsol bgyid pa dang / /gzhan phan byang chub sems dang ma bral zhing / /kun kyang dri med lta ba rgyas theb na/

/rgyal ba dges pa'i lam du 'gyur ro zhes/ /bdag gi bla ma mus pa chen pos gsungs/ /tshul 'di ma brjed snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa legs bshad mthong ba bde bskyed ces bya ba 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong bsod nams 'od zer ram/ bka' bzhi pa bsod nams 'od zer ram/ rang 'grel ba bsod nams 'od zer ram/ bka' bcu pa bsod nams 'od zer ram/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams 'od zer zhes bya ba'i ming mang don dang ldan pa'i blo gros rab tu gsal ba de nyid kyi don du/ shrī sa skya pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ a na la zhes pa'i lo/ sha ra ta'i dus kyi/ bha tro zhes pa'i zla ba'i rdzogs pa dang po'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i bla brang phun tshogs gling thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur bris pa'o/ /yang smras pa/ sprang rnal 'byor chos med nga yi sems/ /grogs blun pos yang yang dkrugs pa 'di/ /las ngan pa'i tshogs rnams 'dag srid na/ /de sgrib pa'i lhag ma kun zad nas/ /dus da lta sangs rgyas thob snyam sems/ /ha hā/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //grogs mchog rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer la smras pa'i yi ge nyams dga' blo bde zhes bya ba bzhugs so/224 /skyabs gcig chog rgyal ba mus pa rje/ /gnas dag pa'i zhing nas bdag la dgongs/ /bu snying dang 'dra ba'i slob bu 'di/ /dus da nas byang chub bar du skyobs/ /bu dwangs ba'i yid kyis tshur gson dang / /khyed dus rnams kun du ngag 'jam shing / /sems gzhan gnod bsam pa dug bzhin spangs/ /chos lugs gnyis gang la'ang blo gros rgyas/ /ngag don med cal col dang bral bas/ /mi dpyod ldan kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin/ /blo gtad pa'i grogs phyir srog kyang gtong / /bstan 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam can/ /rgyud nga rgyal dang bral 'grogs na bde/ /lar khyod kyi ngo mtshar snang tshul la/

/mi kho bos bsam bzhin spro ba 'phel/ /gzhan dpyod ldan gzur gnas thams cad kyang / /mi khyod la gcig tu 'dun par mthong / /nga dus rnams kun du thos bsam dang / /chos 'chad rtsod zab don bsgom pa la/ /'phral gzhan gyi ngo bsrung sna len sogs/ /bu khyod gyi lag len 'khur bgyis pas/ /mi nga yi chos spyod bshol ma dgos/ /drin 'di bas che ba gzhan ci yod/ /bu khyod kyi lus sems rab brel bas/ /'phral ngal dub ji snyed gang byung ba/ /de thams cad kho bo'i phyir yin pa/ /nga nges shes gting nas skyes pas na/ /lam zab mo'i nyams len gang byed kyang / /bu ma brjed sems la dung nge yod/ /chos rten 'brel 'di yi byin rlabs kyis/ /dus byang chub bar du mi 'bral snyam/ /bu skyon med yon tan kun ldan khyod/ /mi nged dang lhan cig rab gnas shing / /thugs yid gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa 'di/ /rje mus pa chen po'i thugs rje yis/ /dpal 'phrin las mgon pos bsgrub pa yin/ /tshul 'di la kho bo nges shes yod/ /dus da dung rang re dpon slob gnyis/ /'phral rkyen ngan dam sel ga la srid/ /rgyu des na gnas skabs thams cad du/ /khong bla ma yi dam chos skyong gis/ /dus 'bral med lhan cig skyong bar nges/ /bu nyams re dga' 'o blo re bde/ /blo bde ba'i ngang nas zab don bsgom/ /chos thun mtshams skabs su snod bcud 'di/ /rten brten pa'i rol par dran 'dun bskyed/ /dus rgyun du sems kyi rang zhal ltos/ /dbyings rig pa bsres la sing nge zhog /yul gang la'ang mngon zhen skyes pa'i tshe/ /chos 'di las zab pa gcig kyang med/ /spyir chos kyi nang nas gsang sngags zab/ /de'i nang nas ma rgyud mtha' dag zab/ /de kun gyi yang rtse'i mthar thug ni/ /dpal nā ro mkha' spyod yin par bshad/ /rgyu des na dad ldan bu khyod la/ /spyir gsang mtha'i lam srol thams cad dang / /dgos nā ro mkha' spyod chos skor rnams/

/mi kho bos ma sbas lhug par ston/ /lam zab mo kun gyi bcud bsdus mchog /chos rnal 'byor bcu gcig 'di nyid la/ /sems le lo spangs te chig sgril mdzod/ /der ma zad myur lam mchog gyur pa/ /mi kho bo'i bla ma mus chen rje/ /gnas 'og min chen por gshegs pa'i lam/ /chos zab mo 'pho ba chig brgyud ma/ /bu khyod la brtse bas legs ston gyi/ /'di ma 'byongs bar du 'bad nas bsgom/ /rang 'chi khar theb pa'i gdengs thob na/ /thun ma chag tsam gyi bsam don 'grub/ /spyir 'pho ba'i rigs rnams thams cad la/ /chos bdag med lta bas rgyas theb dgos/ /yid dmigs pa gsal yang don mi 'grub/ /rang 'chi khar chags zhen kun spangs te/ /chos zab mo 'di yi mtshams sbyar na/ /khong tshogs rab bsags pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /dus skad cig gcig gi bye brag gi /gnas 'og min chen por rdzogs sangs rgya/ /de min na'ang mkha' spyod chung ngu thob/ /khong mkha' spyod chung ngu'i yon tan ni/ /lus yid 'ong gzhon nu lha yi sku/ /lo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ /rje sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku nyid las/ /chos zab yang nod pa'i skal ba can/ /skra sil bur gyur cing yid rab 'phrog /lus rdzu 'phrul dbang gi nam mkhar 'gro/ /ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod mkha' las byung / /tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub/ /nyams rtogs pa'i tshogs rnams gong 'phel 'gyur/ /mdor bsdu na lus sems rten kho nas/ /sangs rgya bar nges pa'i lus rten yin/ /lar mkha' spyod chung ngu'i yon tan ni/ /rang so skye'i bsam brjod yul las 'das/ /rgyu des na dad ldan slob bu khyod/ /lam mchog zab 'pho ba chig brgyud ma/ /yid rtse gcig dril la nyams len mdzod/ /gnad cung zad tsam gyi bye brag gis/ /tshe gtan legs 'dun ma zin par nges/ /don des na nyams dga' blo re bde/ /'di mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /dus da dung bla ma'i thugs rje yi/

/bdag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /yid bsam don 'bad med mthar phyin par/ /bu gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyi grogs mchog dam pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer la nyams dga' blo bde'i ngang nas legs par smras pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //rang dang nyer gnas dam tshig can gyi slob bu la smras pa'i nyams dbyangs bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs/225 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ skyabs bslu med kun 'dus mus chen rje/ /bdag snying gi dkyil nas gsol 'debs kyis/ /bu dad ldan slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /dus byang chub bar du 'bral med mdzod/ /khyed dad pa can gyi slob bu la/ /yid brtse ba'i ngang nas 'di skad smras/ /nga rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun bsod dang / /khyed rab 'byams smra ba puṇ+ya ba/ /sngon las 'brel dbang gis lhan cig 'dzoms/ /lo gzhon nu nyid nas da lta'i bar/ /dus rtag tu sel med zhabs tog bgyis/ /de ngo mtshar che'o skal ba bzang / /bu khyod kyi bsam pa'i khyer so la/ /rang zhi bde'i ngang nas thos bsam dang / /dus rtag tu 'chad nyan bsgom bsgrub sogs/ /don mi tshe chos la bskyal ba las/ mi chos med kho bo'i go re len/ /'di bgyis pa 'di phyir don che bar/ /blo kha zhe med par thag chod pa/ /'di dpyod ldan nang nas dpyod ldan te/ /spyir bsam pa dge na ci byas chos/ /de min na kun kyang tshul chos yin/ /khong mdo rgyud sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /don mkhas shing mkhas par grags 'ga' dang / /lam zab mo bsgrub la gcig gzhol bas/ /yid bskyed rim ting 'dzin brtan 'ga' yang / /gnad 'chugs pas 'byung por skyes zhes thos/ /tshe 'dir snang bsam pa'i thos bsam dang / /'phral nyan bshad bsgrub la brtson blo yis/ /rang grags 'dod nga rgyal spel ba yis/

/dpe gser chas gyon pa'i khyim pa ltar/ /don kha chos gzugs chos yin no som/ /rgyu des dad ldan bu khyod kyis/ /dus rgyun chad med pa kho bo'i phyir/ lus brel zhing sems nyid ngal gyur ba'i/ /las 'di kun bstan dang 'gro ba yis/ /don rlabs chen mtha' dag bsgrub pa dang / /rje bla ma'i zhabs tog kho na'i phyir/ /'phral 'phrin las rnam bzhi cir snang yang / /don bsam pa dge bas zin pa'i phyir/ /las ci byas chos mthun yin pas na/ /de khyad sod med pa'i dag snang dang / /rje bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa la/ /blo kha zhe med par yid ches na/ /rang 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub pa'i tshul/ bka' mdo rgyud gong ma'i gsung rab las/ tshul mang du gsungs mod de dag rnams/ bu thos ldan khyed la bshad ci dgos/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ bdag bu slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'di la tshe ring nad med cing / /yid bsam pa thams cad lhun grub te/ /bstan rin chen mchog tu rgyas pa dang / /rgyun rigs brgyud gtsang mas rtag skyong zhing / /dus phyi ma bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /gnas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /kun smon lam dbang gis legs skyes nas/ /khong pha mar gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /thabs du mas zhing der 'dren par shog /don 'di rnams gegs med kun 'grub par/ pha rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /lha yi dam mkha' 'gros nus pa bskyed/ /khyed chos skyong srung mas 'phrin las dza/ don snying po skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i/ /rje bla ma mchog la gsol btab pas/ /sngar yan kyang bsam pa lhun gyis grub/ /dus da dung bsam don kun 'grub shog /ces nyams dbyangs bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / rje btsun byang chub kyi sems rdo rje bud+dha'i mtshan can skyabs gnas kun 'dus de nyid kyi thugs rjes 'di phyi'i don kun 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar yid ches kyi gdeng khyad par can brnyed pa'i nye lam mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang dang nye gnas dam tshig can gyi slob ma'i mchog shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'byams smra ba puṇ+ya rasmi la brtse ba'i sems kyis smras pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du bkra shis dang dge legs kyis khyab par gyur cig

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //mchog dman gyi grogs la blang dor bya tshul gyi nyams dbyangs gtan du bde ba'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs/226 rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mus pa rje/ /gnas mi mngon dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /bu dad ldan slob mar bcas pa yis/ /don bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs /ljongs 'di na blo gsal gzhon nu 'ga'/ /rang skyon med yon tan kun ldan yang / /grogs ngan dang 'grogs pa'i le lan gyi/ /yid rtog dpyod med pa'i skye bo rnams/ /mi ngan dang lhan cig ring gnas shing / /yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i grogs yin pas/ /gang byas kyang rang mtshar gnas min zhes/ /dpe ri bong cal bzhin phal cher sgrog /tshul 'di 'dra 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /mi gang gi bsten kyang rang phung ba'i/ /grogs ngan pa de 'dra bsten pas lan/ /grogs de yi snang tshul bshad tsa na/ /'phral ngo nag khog chung bsam pa ngan/ /tshig nga rgyal smra bas dus kun 'da'/ /grogs kun gyi bsam sbyor gang bzang yang / /skyon 'dogs rgyu med pa'i skabs mi srid/ /'phral dgos med gzhan sems bsreg byed pa'i/ /tshig ngan pas thams cad dgra ru slong / /mig blta lugs tsam gyi'ang gzhan rgyud dkrug /gzhan phan tshun mthun la phrag dog che/ /gang nye ba de la rgyun du 'thab/ /sems dag pas bstun na ha cang khro/ /rang rang tshugs bzung na tshig rgyag smra/ su'i 'grogs kyang klog tu mi snyan sgrog /rang dgos dus byams la rgyun du sdang / tshul de 'dra ngan pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ yul de la bstun pa rab dka' yang / /mi bsam med rang nyid ngal bzhin du/ /don dgos med ngan pa'i rjes 'brangs bas/ /'phral lus ngag dang spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis/ /khong skyes bu rab 'bring phal mo che/ /don rang gi ngang nas dgrar lang nas/ /grogs ngan pa'i ngag la nyan pa'i mthus/ /rang 'phral phugs bde ba'i skabs dang bral/ /skyon 'di 'dra mngon sum mthong bzhin du/

/dus da dung grogs ngan mi spongs na/ mi de ni gdon gyi bslad pa'am/ /de min na rang gi rang brlag yin/ /'di blo gsal rnams kyi dgongs par mdzod/ /grogs ngan pa'i snang tshul de yin na/ /mi su dang 'brel kyang bde ster ba'i/ /grogs dam pa'i snang tshul gang zhe na/ /grogs rab ste ngag 'jam sems bzang zhing / /blo gsal bas blang dor kun la mkhas/ /ngag smra ba mi mang blo khog yangs/ /mi ngan pa'i phra ma gang bcug kyang / /yid mi 'gyur dbye dka' 'dum pa sla/ /blo gtad pa'i gros la ngo lkog med/ tshig kha ru mi smra khong rtsis mkhas/ /chos lugs gnyis 'dul skyong ci byed kyang / 'phral 'jam pa'i don kun 'grub byed cing / /mi rang la phan pa'i grogs dag la/ /rdzas zas nor gtong la phang pa med/ /dus rgyun du dul yang gnas min la/ /thabs gang gi'ang mi bzlog brtul phod che/ /yul de 'dra dam pa'i grogs su bzung / /grogs 'bring la yon tan de dag rnams/ /phal che ba tshang ba dgos pa yin/ /mi tshogs bsags yongs 'dzin mgon dang 'brel/ /mi tshogs 'bring dam pa'i grogs dang 'brel/ /mi tshogs ma bsags rnams ngan dang 'brel/ /grogs rab 'bring tha ma'i bye brag gis/ /dpe rnam dkar tshos kyis bsgyur ba ltar/ /mi rang yang rab 'bring tha mar 'gyur/ /rgyu des na blo gsal gzhon nu rnams/ /grogs rab dang 'grogs na kun gyis byams/ /grogs ngan dang 'grogs na kun gyis sdang / /'di som la ngan pa'i grogs spongs la/ /grogs dam pa 'bad de bstan pa gces/ /nga chos med rnal 'byor a nan+das/ /blo thol byung bris pa'i nyams dbyangs 'di/ /khong blo gsal dpyod ldan gzhon nu 'ga'/ /mi rang gi ngos nas skyon bral yang / /grogs ngan dang 'grogs skyon can du/ /mi phal gyi 'dzin pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /grogs bsten tshul spangs blangs ma shes na/ /gang byas kyang bde ba'i skabs bral zhing / /de'i blang dor tshul bzhin shes gyur na/

/rang gtan du legs pa'i gzhir 'dug snyam/ /dus yud tsam zhig la bris pa lags/ /dge des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //ya rab rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs ba'i gtam yid 'ong lang tsho gzhon nu'i bzhin ras dpyod ldan yid 'phrog bzhugs/227 /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ skabs 'dir bshad pa cung zad cig 'bul bar byed pa la/ de yang gang zhig la skyabs su song na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsol zhing / ngan 'gro dang srid zhi'i rgud pa las yongs su skyobs par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / skyabs gnas dam pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug rgyan dam par bzhugs pa legs shing / de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten yang / spyir gyi rgyal ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams rnams na bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing / bye brag tu yang 'o skol rang nyid kyi chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid kyi gtsug lag khang rnams na yang ngo mtshar ba'i rten bzhi'i gtsos pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams ngor mtshar yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin phung gi dbus na/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag pa'i dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyad par can rnams dang bcas pa gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags shing byin rlabs kyi zil dang ldan par bzhugs shing / lhag par du bod kha ba can pa rnams la bde skyid 'byung ba'i rtsa ba gcig pu mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rgyun ma chad par da lta'i bar du rim par byon te srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na sku lham me/ gsung lhang nge / thugs lhan ne bzhugs pa legs mod/

de rnams kyi skyabs kyi 'og nas mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyi gtso mdzad/ mkhan chen byon yod na mkhan chen 'di zhes pas gtso mdzad ces zer/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / mi che ba rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/ /yon tan mkhyen pa rnams kyis gral gyi zur brgyan/ bya ba byed pa rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten te 'di ltar tshogs pa gdan gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang dkar po dge ba'i las kyi gzhi bzung / dag pa smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la nye bar thob pa'i chos dang dam tshig zab mos sbrel bas na 'brel pa zab/ tshogs pa yang sbyin bdag gi rgyud la tshogs gnyis rgyas pa'i thabs su tshogs pas na tshogs pa bzang ba yin zhing / lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ spyir khams gsum gyi sems can dug gsum nad kyis gzir ba rnams la/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang / mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la skyobs pa shākya'i rgyal po de nyid shin tu bka' drin che la/ dgos 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis te brgyad du grags pa rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par bod kha ba can pa rnams la sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rim par byon pa rnams dang / sprul pa'i lo paṇa skyes mchog khyad par can rnams shin tu bka' drin che ba yin la/ dus phyis kyi 'gro ba phal mo che rnams la/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa rim par byon pa rnams dang / chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa g.yag rong rnam gnyis/

kun dga' rnam gnyis/ go shaka rnam gnyis la sogs bgrang ba las 'das pa rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che ba legs mod/ lhag par da res sbyin bdag gi mchod yul du zhabs yangs par byon pa'i dge 'dun tshogs pa 'di rnams sbyin pa'i bdag po la shin tu bka' drin che ba legs/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ 'di ltar zhal mngon sum du gyur pa'i yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi drung du dam pa'i chos kyi legs par bshad pa'i gtam gyi mchod pa 'bul ba 'di ni/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu yin pas na tshul 'di la dga' ba dang spro ba rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis 'jug par bya dgos pa yin pas na de la 'dir zhes sogs kyi 'brel btsal la bshad pa dngos la 'jug par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ tshul 'di mang thos blo gsal gzhon nu 'ga'/ /tshogs kyi dbus su legs bshad ngom pa'i phyir/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sa skya pa des sbyar/ /'di ni gsung rab don la chags pa yis/ /dpyod ldan rnams la yid rab 'phrog byed pa'i/ /yid 'ong lang tsho gzhon nu'i bzhin ras te/ /skal bzang dga' bde bskyed pa'i ma ma yin/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don kun 'grub cing / /chos grwa chen po 'phel zhing rab rgyas te/ /bshes gnyen rgya mtshos ljongs 'di khyab gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //zhal gdams nye lam rab bsngags bzhugs/228 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag he ru ka /zhing 'dir ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /skal bzang 'gro rnams rnam grol lam bkod pa'i/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bslu med gang de rgyal/ /de ltar mchod par brjod nas rigs sngags 'chang / /rnal 'byor chos med kun dga'i ming can gyis/

/blo gsal mang thos skal bzang gzhon nu la/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis legs bshad 'di spel lo/ /'di dang phyi ma'i phan bde ma lus pa/ /bla ma mchog la rag las de yi phyir/ /grub mchog rnams kyang rigs kyi bdag po yis/ /tshul gyi rang gi bla mar srid zhu mdzad/ /de phyir bla ma mchog la mos pa ni/ /sde snod snying po rgyud sde kun gyi bcud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bgrod gcig lam/ /mkhas grub dam pa kun gyi gshegs shul yin/ /rang nyid rgyal rigs mchog tu khas 'che zhing / /pha mes gdol par sgrog pa'i blun po ltar/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma smod la lhur len pa/ /de la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ring / /dang por bla ma sangs rgyas nyid du bsgom/ /bar du bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /tha mar rang sems bla mar gyur pa 'di/ /zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin/ /de phyir sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod don che zhes/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /dbyangs dang dgongs pa gcig gis gsal bar gsungs/ /mos gus med la byin rlabs 'byung min la/ /byin rlabs ma zhugs rtogs pa mi skye bas/ /gcig chog rgyal po bla ma'i mos gus shes/ /grub mchog stong gis mgrin gcig bsngags par mdzad/ /de phyir lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /nyin mtshan thun du bcad nas bsgom pa dang / /thun mtshams rnams su bla ma'i zhabs tog la/ /'bad cing thos bsam dag la brtson 'grus 'tshal/ /skabs su tshe bsgrub zab mo'i bcud len la/ /bdun phrag gcig gnyis gsum sogs 'bad pa dang / /rgyun du skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /dkon mchog mkhyen snyam yid gnyis spangs 'tshal lo/ /kho bo gzhon nu'i dus nas nges 'byung dang / /tshe gang bsgrub la dril snyam 'dun pa che/ /'on kyang rnam g.yengs dbang gis rim bzhin 'gyang / /de ni mi theg bzhin du sa skya yi/

/sde dang bstan pa'i khur gyis lus sems mnar/ /lo zla 'khor yug rnam g.yengs ngang du lus/ /rang nyid lugs gnyis blo gros dman pa dang / /lhag par dus ngan skye bo'i spyod ngan gyis/ /rtag tu yid la zug rngu bskyed pa 'di/ /sngon las zhes bya'i grags ldan de yin lo/ /'on kyang bslu med bla mar blo gtad nas/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs chen bgyid pa dang / /rang nyid bsgrub la chig sgril bya ba sogs/ /ji ltar byed kyang yid gnyis dang bral ba'i/ /blang dor shes 'di kho bo'i rnam thar yin/ /skal bzang khyed kyang dam pa gong ma yis/ /mdzad 'phrin dag gi rjes su slob pa dang / /skyes ngan dag gi spyod pa'i rjes mi 'brangs/ /de ltar bgyis na don gnyis lhun 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa za nyal chag gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rab 'byams smra ba sa mu tra'i ming can la gdams pa'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyi bgyis pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nyams dbyangs yid bde'i myu gu bzhugs/229 rje rang rig bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu gson dang blo gsal rnam dpyod can/ /mi nged la lung rtogs yon tan cha/ /don til 'bru tsam yang med nges pas/ /nga chos 'byor bral ba'i sprang po la/ /snying thag pa'i gsol ba 'debs 'dod na/ /gnad 'di 'dra sems la bcangs ba mdzod/ /khong 'jam dbyangs mched dang mus pa rje'i/ /thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / /gzhan bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs/ /don skyabs gnas kun gyi thugs kyi gshis/ /gzhi gdod ma'i gnas lugs ro gcig de/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyi rang babs yin/ /de rang gi sems dang ro gcig par/ /don gnas lugs dran pas gsos btab ste/ /yul snod bcud lha ru bsgom pa dang / /sgra yi dam sngags su dran pa dang / /sems ma 'gags ye nas stong pa yis/ /don ye shes myong stong skyong ba dang /

/'phral sdig spongs dge la brtson pa dang / /rje skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la/ /sems rtse gnyis med pa'i blo gtad dang / /'phral bzang ngan snang ba gang shar kyang / /rang las snang yin par thag chod dang / /kun 'dzin med lta bas rgyas 'debs gces/ /skabs skabs su chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ /gsung lam zab ling chu rtse khab ma'i/ /chos sbyor ba'i skabs dang rjes kyi skabs/ /'di yang yang bltas na byin rlabs 'jug /bu dad ldan sems la de ltar bzhog /nga chos med rnal 'byor a nan+da/ /yid dag pa'i mig gis blta shes na/ /khong rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /don bzang ngan med pa'i mos gus bskyed/ /rang ci byas bstan 'gro'i don du shes/ /gzhan thos pa can dang bsgom yun can/ /khong de rnams so sor bzang na yang / /mi kho bo 'gram chu ldang dgos med/ /don bstan 'gror phan na ci byas chos/ /nga skal ba bzang ngo blo re bde/ /nga smon lam bzang po btab btab pa'i/ /khong nyer gnas rnams kyang bsod nams bsags/ /de mkhyen par mdzod dang rnam dpyod can/ /blo bde mo'i ngang nas 'bol gyis slod/ blo tsab tsob ma mang snying gtam lags/ /rje bla mas don kun 'grub par mdzod// ༈ //zhal gdams yid kyi 'dod 'jo bzhugs/230 rje rang rig bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu dad pa can la byin gyis rlobs/ /spyir dal 'byor rin chen legs thob cing / /dgos mdo rgyud bstan bcos dgongs don la/ /blo thos bsam spyod pa'i skal ba 'di/ /tshul gang nas bsam yang ngo mtshar gnas/ /lar thos bsam byas pa'i dgos pa yang / /rgyud chos dang 'dre ba'i ched yin pas/ /de nyams su len pa'i man ngag gi /don snying po bsdu na 'di ltar yin/ /bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho nas/ /lam zab mo kun gyi yangs rtse ni/ /gnad bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin par gsungs/ /de kho bos khyed la bstan zin pas/ /da nyams len mdzad tshul 'di ltar mdzod/ /dus rgyun du srod dang tho rengs dus/

/lam zab mo rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang / /chos thun mtshams nyams len 'di ltar ste/ /gzugs mthong tshad lha dang bla ma'i sku/ /sgra thos tshad lha dang bla ma'i gsung / /yid rtog 'gyu thams cad bla ma'i thugs/ /gnad 'di la yang yang dran 'dun bskyed/ /'di goms pa rab kyi mthar son na/ /bsgom mi dgos ngang gi 'char ba yin/ /mdor bsdu na 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug kun/ /lam zab mo'i rgyun dang mi 'bral zhing / /kun gsang sngags zab mo'i lta ba'i mchog /chos snang stong gsal stong bde stong gi /don gzhi med rtsa bral ye 'jam che/ /gnad 'di yi rtsis kyi zin pa gces/ /don dam par chos kun spros bral yang / /'phral 'khrul ngos las 'bral mi bslu bas/ /las mi dge spongs la dge ba bsgrub/ /de dmigs med sems can don du bsngo/ /lar nyams len kun gyi snying po ni/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems/ /khong dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs gnyis med ye shes gnas lugs rnams/ /gzhi gdod nas dbyer med ro gcig pa/ /'di blos byas ma yin gnas lugs yin/ /'di bsgom na nang nas nges shes skyes/ /tshig brjod pas go ba'i chos min pas/ /bu khyod la brda tsam bstan pa yin/ /'di yid la zhog la nyams len mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni sa skya pa gdod nas rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rab 'byams smra ba sa mu tra'i mtha' can la gdams pa re zhig rdzogs so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //legs bshad skal bzang dpyod ldan yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs/231 dharmā dza yan+tu/ rang gi slob bu gzhon nu rnams tshad ma'i skyes bu sangs rgyas kyi sar dkri ba'i slad du/ sngon rjes/ sgrub pa sun 'byin gyi tshul rnam par yang dag pa dang / ltar snang ba'i rnag gzhag rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad la bslab ste/ 'gal ba/ ma nges/ ma grub pa'i rtags kyis bslus nas the tshom gyi lam la zhugs pa dag

tshul gsum pa can gyi gtan tshig rnam par dag pa'i drang po'i lam bden pa nyid la 'god par byed pa'i rig pa smra ba'i khyu mchog gang der smras pa/ dpal ldan grags pa'i ring lugs nags tshal du/ dngos stobs rig pa'i gad rgyangs cher bsgrags pas/ /log smra'i lag ldan mtha' dag phyir skrod pa'i/ /smra ba'i seng ge gang de tshur la gson/ /dper na dri ma med pa'i shel dkar la/ /sna tshogs tshon gyi kha dog der snang bzhin/ /khyod sems dkar po ngan pa'i grogs dag gi /drin las nag por byas pa'i kun spyod kyis/ /rang gzhan kun gyi shes rgyud bsregs pa'i tshul/ /de la 'gyod sems skyes pa rjes yi rang / /da ni de 'dra'i tshul lugs kun spangs te/ /kho bo'i ngag la nyan na 'di bzhin gyis/ /drag zhan su dang 'phrad kyang bzhin dkar zhing / /lhun chags brjid mdzes spyod pas gzhan sems khrid/ /rnam 'gyur tsam gyi rang mtshang ston byed pa'i/ /g.yas chung bgyis na kun gyis brnyas pas spongs/ /dngos grub kun 'byung mtshan ldan bla ma dang / /'di phyir phan pa ston pa'i rgan grogs dang / /kha gnyis spangs pa'i gtad thug gang zag rnams/ /gces par bzung dang rang la 'di phyir phan/ /rang 'od phugs mtshams smra ba'i gzhon nu dang / /mtho dman kun dang 'gal ba'i yul dag la/ /dung sems ches na rang la mi phan zhing / /gnod par 'gyur phyir dgos med tshul de spongs/ /kye ma ngan pa'i grogs dang 'brel ba yis/ /ji ltar byas kyang bde ba'i skabs bral ba'i/ /snang tshul de dag cha tsam 'dir bshad kyi/ /bden dang mi bden skye bo kun la gsal/ /khyod nyid gzhon nu'i dus su 'gro kun gyis/ /byams dang bar ma'i yul las gzhan min yang / /ngan pa'i grogs dang 'phrad pa nas brtsams te/ /de nyid ci zer 'dod pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mtho dman bar ma'i skye bo thams cad la/ /ltos med khros pa'i gdong zur nag po dang / /ba re re'i don med spyod ngan gyis/

/gzhan rgyud bsreg phyir mang po'i tshogs dbus su/ /gdong gang ma gtogs mig gis mi mthong ba'i/ /sdug btsir de 'dra grogs ngan drin min nam/ /kye hud de 'dra'i spyod pa goms pa'i mthus/ /rang bzhin 'dug na khros pa'i ngang tshul dang / /gzhan blo khrid tshe brjid med g.yas chung po/ /ji ltar byas kyang mig sngar mi mdzes pa'i/ /spyod ngan 'di yang grogs ngan drin min nam/ /kye ma ngan pa'i grogs kyi ci tsam phan/ /de la brten nas gzhan kun dgrar lang pa'i/ /gyen lan thur gyi gnod pas lan 'thal ba'i/ /sa gzhi khyab de'ang grogs ngan drin min ni/ /skyes stobs sbyangs pas blo mig rab gsal ba/ /kun dang mthun pa'i bshes gnyen dang 'brel na/ /rang mdzes gzhan mdzes kun gyi yid dgar 'ong / /de las ldog ste'ang grogs ngan drin min nam/ /bar skabs dus der khyed la brtse ba ni/ /rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas 'os min zhes/ /dgra gnyen kun gyi ngag rjes mi 'brangs ba'i/ /gang zag de dag drin chen ma yin nam/ /phan gnod nus pa'i stobs ldan skyes bu yis /ngan lan bzang pos 'jal ba ngo mtshar mod/ /nus med rnams kyi thabs kyis ma 'dus pa'i/ /legs legs bgyid la snying po cang mchis sam/ /deng sang dus kyang skye bo mang po'i dbus/ /snying nas brtse ba rnams kyang ngo gnong zhing / /rang yang bsam mno btang gyin yid zhum pa/ /'di 'dra ngan pa'i grogs kyi ngag nyan nas/ /kun la ltos med spyod ngan byas pas lan/ /de phyir kun tu gnod pa'i grogs po dang / /'di phyi gnyis su phan pa'i grogs po'i drin/ /drin du 'dra mod mchog dman phyed par gces/ /de ltar ngan pa'i grogs drin bsam pas kyang / /'on kyang las 'phro bzang bas dam pa'i grogs/ /phyis nas brnyed pas 'khril shing ljon shing gi /rtse mor phyin pa'i ngo mtshar gnas 'di la/ /sems yod su zhig mtshar du cis mi 'dzin/ /grogs de dam pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/

/deng sang 'di na skye bo phal cher rnams/ /rang dang mthun pa de la lkog tu smod/ /go 'phang mtho dog thabs tshul du mas 'gegs/ /nus ma thon kyang gzhi med skur 'debs kyis/ /gtam ngan phyogs bcur sgrog pa ma mthong sam/ /de phyir de 'dra'i tshul lugs kun spangs nas/ /rang bde gzhan bde kun kyang bde ba'i thabs/ /byed pa dngos su mthong phyir dam pa yis/ /grogs su 'dzin la su zhig som nyi byed/ /de phyir da ni mang po'i blo spongs la/ /dam pa'i grogs dang lhan cig bla ma'i phyir/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i khur chen khyer ba la/ /skal ba bzang pa'i don gzhan med snyam sems/ /de ltar kho bos lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /legs bshad 'di don tshul bzhin nyams su long / /de ltar bgyis na srid dang zhi ba yi/ /yon tan tshogs rnams ngang gi 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de skad 'di ni dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla mas rjes bzung ba'i/ /skal ba bzang po can des sbyar ba yin/ /bsod nams 'di yi bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //zhal gdams don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/232 rje rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu don gnyis lhun gyi grub par mdzod/ /rkyen ci byung lam du khyer ba'i thabs/ /gnad 'di 'dra thugs la 'jog par mdzod/ /rang longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas pa na/ /bsog bsrung gi sdug bsngal mi bsgom par/ /bsod nams kyi dge tshogs spel bar mdzod/ /'di phyi'i phan bde kun de las 'byung / /yang zang zing 'byor pas dman pa na/ /de bsrung ba dang brlag pa'i sdug bsngal med/ /'thab rtsod kun 'dzin chags nor las 'byung / /de med na med kyis dga' ba bsgom/ /yang skabs 'gar cung zad na ba'i tshe/ /de rang gi lam du khyer shes na/ /sngar byas kyi sdig pa 'dzad nges pas/ /de de ltar shes shing stong len bsgom/

/yang myur du shi bar 'gyur na yang / /dus rgyun du dkon mchog zhabs tog gi /las bzang po smon lam mtshams sbyar bas/ /rang gang 'dod zhing du skye bar nges/ /rang gi bde dge gzhan la gtong zhing gzhan gyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal rang la len pa'i yang tshe mthar phyin na phyin pas dga'/ /'phral spyod lam bya ba che phra yis/ /rje bla ma mchog gi zhabs tog dang / /bstan 'gro ba'i don mang 'grub phyir ro/ /bu des na 'di phyi kun du bde/ /don bsam tshad 'grub pa bla ma mkhyen/ /tshig de skad smra ba sa skya pa/ /sprang chos med rnal 'byor a nan+da'o/ /tshul 'di yang dh+ya nar gdams pa dge/ ༈ //dad ldan ma ti bha dra la gdams pa'i legs bshad bzhugs/233 rje rgyal ba mus pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu dad pa can gyi gang zag gis/ /don bsam pa bzhin du 'grub par mdzod/ /khyed sngon bsags blo gros bzang po can/ /sems dwangs ba'i yid kyi legs par nyon/ /rje rgyal bas gsungs pa'i las 'bras chos/ /legs bsam na dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /dus da res tsam las thob pa dka'/ /'di mi rtag 'chi ba'i chos can yin/ /nam 'chi ba'i nges pa'ang cung zad med/ /dus de ring kho na'ang mi 'chi zhes/ /blo bde bar 'dug pa'i gdeng yod dam/ /rang bem rig bral nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /rten khang gzhis gnyen bshes mdza' grogs sogs/ /tshe 'dir snang kun gyi sleb pa med/ /gtam thos pa tsam gyi snying 'dar ba'i/ /ming bar do zhes pa'i gnas ngan der/ /khong man ngag ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /sems 'jigs med dag snang legs shar te/ /gnas dag pa'i zhing du 'gro ba yin/ /tshe 'dir snang can gyi skye bo rnams/ /sa de nas dmyal ba yid dgas sogs/ /gnas rigs drug grong du 'khor zhing 'khyams/ /rgyu des na sdug bsngal las thar dus med/ /'di som la blo gros ldan pa khyod/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa dang / /chos zab yang bdud rtsi 'thung ba dang /

/rang gang mos lam la chig sgril dang / /dus rgyun du mi rtag dran pa dang / /grogs ngan pa'i rjes su mi 'brangs shing / /blo chos mthun skyes bu bsten pa ste/ /gnad drug po 'di la nyams len mdzod/ /tshul de bzhin lag tu len nus na/ /cher rnyed dka' dal 'byor thob pa dang / /chos rang sgor zhugs pa don med 'gyur/ /gzhan dam pas rjes su ma bzung dang / /chos gang yang mi shes rmongs pa dang / /rang nyams len med pa'i kha bshad dang / /blo chos mthun rjes su mi 'brang ba/ /grogs ngan pa'i ngag la nyan pa rnams/ /rang 'phral dang yun du phung ba'i rgyu/ /rgyu des na kho bos legs bshad pa'i/ /don de dag blang dor tshul bzhin mdzod/ /dus snyigs ma'i grogs la yid ma ston/ /blo chos mthun rang tshugs thub pa gces/ /'di chos dang 'jig rten gang byed kyang / /rang 'phral phugs legs pa'i gzhi ma yin/ /tshul 'di yang ma brjed snying la chongs/ /zhes pa 'di yang shrī sa skya pa rigs sngags 'chang ba shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dad ldan gyi slob ma ma ti bha dra la gdams pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dad ldan gyi grwa pa 'phrin las rin chen dang chos grags grogs mched la gdams pa'i yi ge bzhugs/234 dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i mus pa rje/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bdag la brtse bas skyongs/ /kho bo'i phyir du ngal dub khyad gsod pa'i/ /dad ldan grwa pa rnams gnyis tshur la gson/ /khyed gnyis la chu phreng sogs bgrod dka'i lam/ /gang la bzhud kyang dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /brjed med snying gi dkyil nas dran pa dang / /kho bo cag kyang yid sngar lam me gshegs/ /'dir yang 'phral dang yun du khyed gnyis la/ /brtse ba'i sems kyi thugs yid gcig bsres nas/ /gcig chog rgyal po mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /bsam don gegs med 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs bgyid/

/de ltar nges par mdzod la bde bar bzhud/ /phan tshun mthun par mdzod la bde bar bzhud/ /bla ma spyi bor bsgom la bde bar bzhud/ /ring por ma thogs rang re dpon slob rnams/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub nas mjal bar smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang ba a nan+da'i ming can gyis dad ldan gyi grwa pa grogs mched sgar chen zhabs drung du dpal sa skya nas brdzangs dus gdams pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ dge legs 'phel// ༈ //bklags pa tsam gyi skye med don/ /rtogs byed legs bshad 'di na yod/235 /bud+dha bha ba yam dza gar+dha tā ya/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshan ldan bla ma'i/ /sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum/ /dbyer med bsres la lta ba 'di skyong / /chos kun sems las logs na med pa/ /lung rigs sgrub byed bsam la thag bcad/ /de nas sems kyi ngo bo la bltas pas/ /dang por mtshan nyid gsal bar mthong 'gyur/ /de nas de yi rang bzhin stong pa/ /shugs kyis shes la stong de gsal chas/ /nam yang ma 'bral de phyir zung 'jug /ngang la slod 'jog de la goms pa/ /rtog med gsal le rgyun du gnas 'ong / /de tshe lta rgyus lta ba de dang / /rtogs thabs rtogs mkhan gsum po dbyer med/ /shes par byas la shes pa de yang / /'dzin pa med pa'i ngang la 'jog go /mdor na gang yang bya rgyu brjod rgyu/ /med par shes pa'i med pa'ang med pa/ /thag bcad de yi ngang la ci gnas/ /bzhag go lta ba mthar phyin tshad ni/ /bden 'dzin rtsad nas chod pa de yin/ /yin par zhen na lta ba'i dug legs/ /tshul 'di lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ /nyams len dus su le lo spong la/ /'bad pa chen pos rang rgyud 'di la/ /'byor nges shes gyi mai tri bha dra/ /zhes bya 'di ni mkhon rigs shākya yis/ /btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /rang lo bcu dgu lon tshe dpal sa skyar/

/bris 'dis rang dang nyer gnas grogs kyi mchog /skye med btsan sa myur du zin gyur cig /yang smras pa/ dus deng sang skabs kyi gnyen 'khor la/ /sems dung pa ches na snying rlung slong / /'phral gzhan la gnod 'tshe ma byed par/ /blo rang tshugs bzung dang rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhan 'dir snang phun tshogs mthong ba'i tshe/ /blo brtan po'ang dam chos spongs mthong bas/ /tshe 'dir snang rnam rtog gang skyes kyang / /de de 'phral chod cig rnal 'byor pa/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //byams pa bzang po la smras pa'i nyams dbyangs mthong ba dga' bskyed ces bya ba bzhugs/236 gu ru rat+na ya na ma: skyabs rang rig sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /bu gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed gson dang byams pa bzang po ba/ /spyir grogs la rnam pa gsum yod de/ /grogs rab kyi yon tan 'phel bar byed/ /grogs 'bring gi phan gnod gang yang med/ /grogs tha mas nyon mongs gting nas slong / /da dus kyi dbang gi rab 'bring gi /grogs gser bas dkon zhing ngan pa'i grogs/ /grangs rdul phran las kyang mang bar gda'/ /rgyu des na bde ba'i go skabs dka'/ /lar khyed kyang blo gros cher dman pas/ /mi gzhan gyi blo khrid mi shes par/ /tshig cung zad tsam la 'khon du 'dzin/ /lus rnam 'gyur 'ga' la khro gnyer g.yo/ /rgyud gyong po'i shing lag bas kyang gyong / /thabs ji ltar byas kyang 'grogs dka' ba/ /tshul 'di 'dra brgyud mar byas gyur na/ /mi khyed la snying nas brtse ba'i grogs/ /dpe nyin skar las kyang dkon par 'gyur/ /'gyur mi 'gyur gzu bos dpyod par zhu/ /'phral spyod pa de ltar snang na yang / /dus rgyun par sems ngan mi 'chang zhing / /tshig ngan pas gzhan rgyud mi bsreg par/ /tshul 'di la kho bo spro ba skyes/ /rgyu des na snying gtam bshad kyi nyon/ /dus ding sang skabs kyi ngan pa 'gas/ /las spyod tshul 'di 'dra la bsam na/ /mig mchi ma 'chor ba bden mod kyi/

/de'i gnyen po 'di ltar bsam pa mdzod/ /rje mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa paṇa gyis/ /mi rang gi ngan spyod ma byas na/ /khong brgya byin gyis kyang smad mi nus/ /dpe chu mig rang nyid ma skam na/ /sa yis mnan yang thub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'di rgyud la sbyor/ don rang gi lam du sbyor shes na/ /mi ngan dang lhan cig gnas pa de/ /chos bzod pa 'phel ba'i thabs mchog yin/ /tshul 'di la'ang nges shes bskyed par rigs/ /rgyu des na re zhig grogs ngan pas/ /gang gnod kyang bzod pa sgom mdzod dang / /phugs khyed rang rgyal bar the tshom med/ /mi kho bos de ltar bshad pa yin/ /don de dag 'thad na blang bar gyis/ /nga rnal 'byor ngag dbang kun bsod ngas/ /blo gtad sa bla ma dkon mchog yin/ /grogs blo ldan bshes gnyen rnams la byed/ /las byed rgyu thos bsam sgom gsum dang / /de'i 'bras bu 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum yin/ /nga 'dug sa bshes gnyen mang po'i tshogs/ /gnas gang du 'dug pa'i sa de yin/ /mdor bsdu na chos mthun las gzhan pa'i/ /las bya rgyu gang yang yod ma yin/ /rgyu des na 'di phyi kun du bde/ /tshul 'di las nyams dga' ci zhig yod/ /'di mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /drin 'khor thabs med pa'i mgon khyod kyis/ /dus byang chub bar du 'bral med bzung / /ces pa 'di sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis rang dang nyer gnas dge tshul byams pa bzang po grogs la re thag chad pa'i gtam du smra zhing mig nas mchi ma mang du 'byung gin 'dug pa'i tshe sems skyo ba dang snying rje zung 'brel gyi ngang nas smras pa'o// ༈ //gdams pa bskul byed re skongs bzhugs/237 yab rje bka' drin la mnyam med/ /rgyal sras sbas pa yi rnal 'byor/ /sngags 'chang grags pa yi mtshan dang / /dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i/ /rje btsun bud+dha yi mtshan can/ /yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas rnams/

/kho bos spyi gtsug gi rgyan te/ /da dung byang chub kyi bar du/ /bdag dang gdul bya yi tshogs rnams/ /'bral med thugs rje yis zungs shig /dad ldan dam chos la 'dun pa'i/ /gzhon nu blo gsal khyed gson dang / /'dir snang skyid sdug dang legs nyes/ /sngon bsags las 'bras su bshad pas/ /gang byung lam khyer du srol la/ /gzhan la sdug yus de spongs mdzod/ /phyi ma skyi sdug gi rtsa ba/ /da lta'i bsam sbyor la rags pas/ /sdig spongs dge bsgrub kyi las la/ /nam yang 'bad 'bung rang bskyed mdzod/ /gnyen 'khor mdza' bshes de mang yang / /sdug la bsnan kha rang legs pas/ /kun dang mi mthun pa min pa/ /su la'ang zhen chags de spongs mdzod/ /dam chos sha ma cig byed na/ /mtshan ldan bla ma zhig bsten nas/ /dbang khrid man ngag dang lag len/ /chog tshod med pa zhig zhus nas/ /'dir snang lto gos dang gtam la/ /'khri ba rbad chod zhig byas te/ /gang byung chog shes kyi sgo nas/ /chos mthun gnas grogs shig bsten te/ /sems dang nyams len gnyis bsres nas/ /lo zla zhag dang la za ma/ /khor yug dge sbyor gyis 'das nas/ /gtan legs 'dun ma de zin pas/ /de bzhin thugs dkyil du zhog la/ /nam phugs lag len zhig mdzod cig /rang sems bla ma dang yid dam/ /dbyer med bde stong gi gshis 'di/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang legs pas/ /rang babs bzo med du chongs mdzod/ /dus ngan deng sang gi mi rnams/ /don gyi skyon yon la mi brtag /rang dang phyogs mthun la bsam nas/ /ngan pas ngan pa dag bstod cing / /dam pa smod pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /'di 'dra'i snyigs dus kyi snang tshul/ /yid 'byung skyo shas kyi lcag 'debs/ /bsam gyin sgom sgrub la 'dun pa/ /ngam ngam shugs kyis rang 'byung nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis yud tsam zhig la bris nas/ lha sras ngag dbang chos kyi dpal mos bskul bas bzhed don 'grub par byas pa'o//

༈ //rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku brnyan la gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs/238 rgya gar skad du/ shrī man+sargu rush+tsa dhi de ba tā ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi med 'od gsal lha rigs las babs 'khon gyi brgyud/ /sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i rnga chen cher gsal ba'i/ /rigs gsum rnam 'phrul rgyun chad med par legs byon pa'i/ /rje btsun bslu med brgyud par bcas la gus btud nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skye ba lan bdun du/ /bzhes pa'i tha ma rje btsun grags pa'i mtshan/ /gser mdog can du 'bras bu mngon gyur mdzad/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan gang de rgyal/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa'i tshul du khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid legs par byon pa mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku brnyan rin chen dngul gyi rang bzhin las grub pa 'di ni/ yangs pa'i sa chen po la dbang bsgyur gangs can gyi sa dbang gcig pu ba/ lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i/ /nus ldan 'khor los bsgyur ba karma bstan skyong dbang pos bdud las kyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa rgya mtshos kun nas blangs te/ legs mdzad gsar du bskrun pa 'di nyid kyi gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gyis shig ces mi dbang chen po'i bka' stsal lhur blangs pa'i/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i gzungs gzhug gi bzhugs tshul thor btab pa la/ thog mar dbu gzungs sogs gzungs sngags kyi byin rlabs can bzhugs pa la/ bde kye gsang gsum sogs bla ma brgyud pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mtshan sngags bgrang ba las 'das pa dang /

yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gi tshogs du ma dang / gzungs chen lnga dang / chos skyong nor lha'i gsang sngags du ma sogs mdor na rgyud sde bzhi'i dgongs pa tshad ldan gyi gsung rab nas bshad pa ltar ma tshang ba med pa dang / tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs cha tshang bzhugs shing / gzhan byin rlabs kyi rten khyad par can bzhugs pa la/ rje btsun rin po che nyid kyi sku gdung / gdung thal/ dbu thod la 'jam dbyangs 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ tshem gyi dum bu/ na bza'i dum bu/ phyag phreng khug ma'i dum bu rnams dang / rje btsun rin po che rtse mo zhabs kyi dbu lo/ rje btsun sa paṇa gyi sku gdung / gdung thal/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa'i dbu thod la phyag rdor dang a yig 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ theg chen chos rje'i sku gdung / sngags 'chang chen po'i sku gdung / theg chen rin po che'i gdung thal/ gdung sol/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi dbu thod kyi dum bu/ rgyal tshab dam pa'i sku gdung / sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung / bram ze mched bdun gyi sku gdung / 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu thod kyi dum bu/ byang chub sems dzñā na'i sku gdung / yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung dga' ldan nas byon pa'i phye ma/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ theg chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen grags blo ba/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'khon blo gros rgyal mtshan rnams kyi sku gdung btul ma byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ rten 'dam dpe grags ma ni/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung / bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs nas kha che paṇa chen gyi bar gyi rgya gar gyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi sku gdung rdo rje gdan/

bya rgod phung po/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ yul chen nyer bzhi/ gnas chen so gnyis sogs kyi sa/ gzhan yang 'phags yul gyi byin rlabs rten tshang ma bsdu bar mdzad cing / bod kyi mkhas grub kyang bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa yan chod kyi bla ma gong ma/ rje srong btsan sgam po/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ sad mi mi mdun sogs nas bdag nyid chen po yan chod kyi sku gdung dang byin rlabs rten tshang ma bsre bar mdzad pa'i rten 'dam/ de'i steng du rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs nas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar gyi dpal sa skya'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyi sku gdung / shang mtshal/ gdung thal/ spur tshwa sogs dang / byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ dbon ston skyer khang pa/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ bu ston rin po che/ lo chen byang rtse/ sa bzang ma ti/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub rnams kyi sku gdung / gdung thal/ zhun/ spur tshwa rnams bsres pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rten 'dam/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung / sngags 'chang chen po'i chab ser ril bu/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i shang mtshal/ spyan snga rin po che'i sku mtshal rnams dang / gzhan yang kha che paṇa chen gyi dbu lo/ sa lo chen po'i dbu lo/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags kyi dbu lo/ grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis kyi dbu lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu lo/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/

'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i dbu lo/ mkhas grub thams cad kyi dbu lo kun 'dus/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i dbu lo/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi dbu lo/ glo bo mkhan chen gyi dbu lo/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i bde mchog nag po pa'i gsung bsnyen gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du shā sa na 'bum phrag bzhi mdzad pa'i dbu lo/ mgon po lha brgyad sbags bsgrub kyi gsung bsnyen mdzad dus kyi dbu lo/ byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang maṣ+ṭa 'bum phrag so gnyis song dus kyi dbu lo/ yang byas 'gyur rdo rje'i bra rdzong du lo gsum gnang dus kyi dbu lo/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge'i dbu lo/ sngags 'chang chen po'i spur nas zhus pa'i dbu lo/ gter ston chen po shes rab 'od zer gyi dbu lo/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ ngag dbang dbang rgyal gyi dbu lo/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed la brten nas kī la ya 'bum phrag lnga bcu rtsa lnga song ba'i dbu lo bub dang / gzhan yang yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams dang chos skyong so so'i gsung bsnyen gnang dus kyi dbu lo mtshon pa rnams dang / gzhan yang rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi na bza'i dum bu/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku chos kyi dum bu/ sku rags kyi dum bu/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku rags kyi dum bu/ sku thabs kyi dum bu/ bzhugs 'ding gi dum bu/ sku srung gi lkogs/ sa khyim gyi dum bu/ rje kun dga' grol mchog gi dbu zhwa'i dum bu/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi sku rags kyi dum bu/

sku gzan gyi dum bu/ sku sham gyi dum bu/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i shang phyis kyi dum bu/ sku rags kyi dum bu/ sku mtshal gnang dus sku la mchod ras kyi dum bu/ yang shang phyis kyi dum bu/ bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi na bza'i dum bu/ snyan dar gyi dum bu/ dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu nged rang sa skya pa'i zhal ngo rim pa bzhin gyi phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i khri rdo sil ma sogs bgrangs ba las 'das pa bzhugs shing / de ltar gzungs bzhugs kyi rim pa rnams lhag chad 'gal 'khrugs sogs kyi skyon cung zad dang bral ba'i bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun pa sa skya pa'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin bgyis rjes/ rab gnas smin rgyas legs par grub pa'i/ gang gi gsol ba btab na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde lag tu stsol nges pa'i rmad du byung ba'i sku brnyan 'di ni sa la spyod pa'i brgya byin karma bstan skyong dbang pos legs mdzad phul du byung ba'i gzi byin las grub pa yin/ 'dir smras pa/ tshul 'di rdo rje 'chang dngos pa sa skya pa'i/ /gong ma rnams la rmongs dad tsam min pa/ /shes nas dad pa thob pa'i blo gros can/ /mang du thos pa gang des legs par sbyar/ /mi shes rdol ba'i phru gu phongs pa yis/ /'khor gyi bteg nas 'jig rten 'dren pa zhes/ /mig skyu 'bab chur sgrog pa'i lhung lhung sgras/ /'jig rten yangs por byed dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /zang zing nor gyis dregs pa'i skye bo la/ /bcol chung rnams kyis legs legs mgrin bsgrigs nas/ /sa gsum 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa zhes/ /tshul min bstod pa de la ngo mtshar cing / /mtshan tsam dran pas sdig pa'i dpung 'joms shing / /rnam thar zhugs na 'di phyi'i bde ba ster/ /gang gi mthong thos dran rag don ldan pa/ /sa skya'i rje btsun las gzhan 'ga' ma mchis/ /de lta'i skyes chen mchog gi sku brnyan la/

gzungs gzhug rab gnas tshul bzhin bgyis pa yis/ /bsod nams 'di yi bdag dang gdul byar bcas/ /'di phyi'i don rnams ma lus mthar phyin shog /ces pa 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge gnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por legs par sbyar ba'o/ /yang smras pa/ rje btsun rin chen sku brnyan 'di bzhengs pa'i/ /legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba des/ /mi dbang chen po sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /chab srid yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //drung kun dga' mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje bdud 'joms pa'i phyag tu phul ba/239 deng dus kyang sku bzhi lhun grub kyi ri dbang zab cing blta ba chu gter gyi dbus na 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i ring nas/ 'phags yul gyi bstan pa'i gsal byed rgyan drug sogs dang / gangs ri'i khrod 'di'i yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mi'i gzugs 'dzin mchog gi gsung rab las brtsams te/ bstan 'dzin mtshungs med rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i bzhed gzhung dri ma med pa rnams kyi gsal byed du 'gyur nges pa'i legs bshad gsar du mdzad pa'i glegs bam phyag rgya ma nyams par gsung ris rten ldan dang bcas pa gnang ba 'byor pas sems mchog tu spro zhing / gsung rab 'di ni/ phar tshad/ 'dul mngon/ dbu ma/ sdom gsum rab dbye sogs gzhung lugs chen po de dag la/ blo gsal rnams dang por 'jug pa'i sgo dang / bar du blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i thabs dang / mthar mkhas par gyur nas kyang bsdus don brjed tho lta bur 'gyur ba'i brjod bya rgya che zhing zab la/ brjod byed tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa'i tshul gyi bstan bcos khyad par du 'phags par snang ba ngo mtshar che zhing rjes su yi rang pa lags/

smras pa/ thub dbang gnyis pa shāka mchog paṇa chen chos kyi rje'i/ /bzhed gzhung mtha' dag khyed thugs me long la/ /rdzogs par gsal ba'i rang gzugs glegs bam 'di/ /mthong na sa skya'i bstan 'dzin kun kyang dad/ /'phags yul paṇa grub dbang po nā ro pa/ /gzugs gzhan bzlos pa'i gar bsgyur pad+ma dkar/ /rjes 'brangs bcas pa'i grub mtha' bkod 'dis kyang / /bsgrub brgyud bstan pa'i zhabs 'debs bla na med/ /deng sang dus 'dir gzhung lugs sna re tsam/ /mthar phyin shes pa'i skye bo'ang dkon mthong na/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don la rab mkhas pa'i/ /skyes mchog khyed 'dra lha brgyas bsngags par 'os/ /zhes kyang shugs 'byung du smras so/ /dpung glegs bam 'di la gzhis 'jug byas pa'i dri ba zhu dgos 'dug pa sogs rim gyi 'bul ba dgongs bzhugs zhu/ slar yang sku'i tsho bzhes dang phebs 'ongs kyang rim par 'tshal/ ces rten bkram par/ gser zho rtse ja sdum rnams la rtags 'byar dang bcas dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang ba nas dge bar phul// ༈ /rab 'byams smra ba bsam gtan rgya mtsho la gdams pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs/240 /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gang la skyabs na nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ /bla ma dkon mchog zhabs la gus btud nas/ /dad ldan rab 'byams smra ba'i yi ge'i lan/ /snying gtam mdo tsam bshad kyi yid la zhog /tshe sngon bzang po'i las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /dal 'byor lus thob blo gros mtshungs med ldan/ /thos bsam legs spyad rnam dpyod grags pa'ang thob/ /khyad par yongs 'dzin dam pa du ma dang / /mjal zhing zab rgyas chos tshul mang nos shing / /sngon chad nged dang nyer gnas grar 'khod pas/ /dkor nag bza' la ring pa'i 'dir snang gis/ /sngags pa rnams la mkho ba'i lha 'ga' re'i/ /grangs bsnyen kha yang mig yang khral mjal gyi/ /ming btags de 'dra mang po ma grub kyang / /rgyun du zab lam mchog la chig bsgril zhing /

/lhag par tshe 'di nyid dang mthong lam la/ /thag ring med pa'i zab mo'i gdams pa mchog /nyams su len pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing / /tshe 'di'i dpon dang bla ma'i thugs zin pas/ /dgra gnyen grogs gsum kun gyi bla na gnas/ 'di phyi gnyis ka'i 'dun ma legs nas gda'o/ /'on kyang rgyu lus nad kyi gdung ba 'di/ /nged kyang brjed med sems kyi tsher mar mchis/ /de ltar na yang rang re rnal 'byor pa/ blo gros ldan pas lam du khyer shes na/ /sngon bsags sdig sgrib 'dag pa'i sman chab ste/ /phyin chad 'di phyir bde ba'i snga ltas yin/ /nga rgyal dregs pa'i bdud kyang 'di yis thul/ /nyams thag 'khor ba pa la snying rje dang / /sdig la 'jigs shing dge la spro ba'i blo/ /ngang gi 'phel bas sngon chad rang re rnams/ /chos pa'i gzugs la 'jig rten pa yi sems/ /'dir snang a 'thas shi 'thas ngang sor yang / /nad 'di'i sems rgyud chos dang sbyar bas na/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes byung ba yin nges snyam/ /dga' ba bsgom zhing dgra gnyen bar ma yi/ /bsags pa'i sdig kun nad 'di'i steng smin nas/ /rang gzhan sgrib kun ma lus byang gyur te/ /phyin chad bde ba'i dpal la longs spyod cing / /dag pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig snyam/ /'dun de ltar du 'gyur na ci ma rung / sems de ltar du 'gyur bar bya'o/ /smon pa'i de ltar du 'gyur bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes brjod cing / yang yang bsgom byas na/ tshe rabs bgrangs ba'i sdig sgrib kun mdzad cing / bsod nams dpag med thob ces gsung rab bshad/ mdor na mkhas btsun bzang por rlom rnams kyang / /rang nyid gzhan las bzang por 'dod pa sogs/ /tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa dang 'brel na/ /ming des 'khor ba'i 'gram rdor 'phen par gsungs/ /de 'dra'i rnam gzhag rgyas par shes 'dod na/ /bka' gdams pa yi blo sbyong chos rnams dang / /rgyal sras thogs med pa yi gsung 'bum ltos/

/blo sbyong pa rnams chos pa gzhan dag gis/ /gegs su byed pa'i nad dang sdug bsngal kun/ /lam du 'khyer ba'i man ngag dang ldan pas/ /rkyen ngan thams cad de yi grogs su 'char/ /zhib par ngos kyi yang yang gsung gleng bgyid/ /mdor na snying nas chos dang sems rgyud gnyis/ /bsre bar 'dod na bka' gdams gsung rab nas/ /bshad pa'i nyams len rnams las zab pa'i chos/ /gzhan nas btsal kyang rnyed pa ngas ma mthong / /da ni bslu med bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /bu khyed myur du nad las grol gyur nas/ /gzugs bzang tshe mthar phyin zhing don 'grub shog /rang ngam rang gri grogs la brten pa yi/ /gzhan dag mi snyan tshig gi char 'bebs shing / /bzod par dka' ba'i bsam sbyor byed mthong yang / /lan chags khyer ro khrel med dga' ba bsgom/ /'di yang blo sbyong chos kyi nyams len lags/ /de skad 'di ni dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /myur bar bris nas dhā na sa mu drar/ /dge sdings dge ba'i gnas su dge bar bsring / bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba yis/ /bdag cag dpon slob don kun 'grub gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //phur pa bla ma bkra shis chos 'phel la gnang ba'i bka' shog241 /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig skyabs gnas bslu med thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /'jam dbyangs mched dang rje btsun bud+dha'i zhabs/ /'bral med snying gi dkyil du bzhugs gsol nas/ /rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /bdag dang bdag la gcig tu yid gtad pa'i/ /bu slob bstan 'dzin brgyud par bcas rnams kyi/ /'di dang phyi ma'i don rnams yid bzhin du/ /'grub nas bstan pa rin chen cher rgyas mdzod/ /de ltar skyabs gnas mchog la gsol btab nas/ /kho bo'i slob bu'i mchog gyur bshes gnyen che/ /khyed la snying nas brtse ba'i gtam gyi cha/ /cung zad spel la dwangs ba'i yid kyis nyon/

/dad ldan khyed kyi ri mo zhib 'khod ngang / /dpal ldan rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sgrub mchod bgyid pa'i dpon slob tshogs bcas la/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i 'bras dkar zhal zas dang / /ma hā tsi na'i btung ba'i rnyed bkur bcas/ /so sor zung ldan bsngo rten tshan grangs sogs/ /ngos ma dang bcas rgya ldan nyams med du/ /'byor pas phan tshun dngos mjal lta bu yi/ /yid kyi spro ba mchog tu 'phel bar gyur/ e ma grub mchog dbang po'i thugs kyi sras/ /sprul pa'i rgyal pos spyan 'bras ltar 'tsho ba'i/ /skal bzang khyed kyi thugs la 'di ltar som/ /dal 'byor thob cing lta grub mchog dang mjal/ /rang dbang yod cing sgo gsum bkol du btub/ /'di 'dra'i dus la chos la mi sems na/ /dam chos sgrub dus nam zhig yin snyam dgongs/ /khyad par snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs ma'i/ /dgon gnas rnying ma rnams kyang nyams dus 'dir/ /mi dbang mthu las grub pa'i dge 'dun sde/ /gsar 'dzugs mgon du 'khod 'di ngo mtshar gnas/ /'khrul med sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams kyi/ /yab chos rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srol 'di/ /mi nyams srid mthar gnas pa'i kha lo par/ /bshes gnyen mchog khyed 'dus pa rgya mtsho yis/ /yongs 'dzin mchog tu bla ma yi dam dang / /bka' srung rgya mtshos lan cig min par bsngags/ /da ni mang po'i blo yi 'phro bskyungs la/ /dus mthar bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang rje/ /yab sras rnams kyi bka' srol dri med 'di/ /'dres med snying nas spel cig slob bu'i mchog /de ltar bgyis na bka' srung rgya mtsho yis/ /'phrin las sgrub par nges so bslu ba med/ /slar yang khams kyi 'tsho skyongs g.yel med dang / /bsring 'os rnams kyang gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin 'tshal/ /da lam rten du bse mgon chen po yis/ /snyan dar rdo rje'i mdud par sngags btab dang / /dam rdzas brgya rdo bcu rdo phur ma'i grangs/

/brgya phrag gnyis dang lnga phrag gsum nyid la/ /rtags 'byar dang bcas dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang rtse nas dge /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //yu mo sprul sku la gnang ba'i bka' shog242 bha ṭa ra ka gu ru badz+ra dha ra ye na maḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs bka' drin can/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /sprul sku'i zlos gar du ma'i srid mtha'i bar/ /'gro ba skyongs mdzad gang der 'di skad gsol/ /khyed kyi zol zog bral ba'i snying gi gtam/ /gsung phris zhib 'khod rgya ldan rten dang bcas/ /'byor pas yid kyi pad+mo che cher bzhad/ /'di na dam pa gong ma'i lugs gnyis kyi/ /ngo mtshar mdzad 'phrin bzang po glang chen khur/ /kho bo khos mod be'u phrag pa ru/ /lhung 'dis rgyun du lus sems ngal ba snyam/ /dam pa khyod kyis gsal snang la shar ba'i/ /rkyen bzlog rim gro'i bye brag ci mchis rnams/ /'phral du sgrub rgyur mchis shing mi 'gyangs par/ /phan tshun dngos mjal dga' ston rol bar smon/ /de ltar dgongs la zhib par mkhas btsun gyis/ /ngag nas 'bul bas de bzhin mkhyen dpyod zhu/ /slar yang sprul pa'i sku khyed bstan 'gro'i phyir/ /zhabs pad lo brgyar brtan zhing chos srid kyis/ /dpal 'byor gong nas gong du rgyas gyur cig /da lam gtan du gong ma'i phyag len bzhin/ /gsar du sgrub pa'i dam rdzas thum bu dang / /gos kha bkra shis ming ldan lha rdzas la/ /rgya mdzes sa skya'i chos grwa che nas dge /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //sa yam ya ru tshe brtan rdo rje la gnang ba'i bka' shog243 rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru tsa sarba dzñā ya na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs gnas bslu med thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ sa la bde skyid g.yang chags mi'i dbang po/ /gang der legs par bshad pa'i skyes 'di bsrings/

/dad ldan khyed kyi yi ge rten dang bcas/ /nyams med rgya ldan 'byor pas sems spro zhing / /yo byad kun kyang rnam dkar spel ba yi/ /dkon mchog zhabs tog dag la 'bul ba dang / kun kyang bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs yang dag bgyis/ /da ni snying gtam tshig 'ga' bshad kyis nyon/ /tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun tshogs kun/ /sngon bsags rnam dkar las kyi 'bras bur bshad/ /da dung gtan gyi bde ba sgrub pa'i phyir/ /dkon mchog mchod dang dman la sbyin gtong dang / /rang dang las kyis 'brel ba'i chab 'bangs rnams/ /bu ltar chongs dang kun gyis gus mchod 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi dpal la phrag dog mi bya zhing / /bsam sbyor bzang po chos kyi rtsa ba ste/ /de nyid ma brjed snying gi dkyil chongs la/ kha ston chos skyong dag la'ang 'bad par mdzod/ sngon bsags bsod nams mthu ldan sa bdag khyod/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing 'dir bsgrod 'dod na/ /dkon mchog lung zhu mo rtsis go bsdus nas/ /spang blang bgyis na 'phral yun dge bar 'gyur/ /'phags yul rdo rje gdan dang chos mtshungs pa'i/ /dpal ldan sa skyar gnas pa'i rigs sngags 'chang / /kun dga'i ming can ngas kyang mi dbang khyod/ /'di phyir legs pa'i srung 'khor smon lam dang / /dkon mchog rnams la gsol 'debs bgyid 'tshal lo/ /slar yang khams kyi 'tsho skyong la brtson zhing / /'di phyogs su yang bsring 'os mtha' dag rnams/ /gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin rgyun chad med pa gyis/ /de skad smra ba dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang sgrub po zhes/ /rnam g.yeng ngang nas snyom las gnas pa yi/ /'khon rigs sa skya'i rigs 'dzin gang de'o/ /zhes da lam yi ge mi gtong ba'i phyir/ sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i snyan dar la sngags btab rdo rje'i mdud pas spras pa dang / nged rang gi sgom zhwa gyon bzhin pa gcig 'chi med dam rdzas ril bu brgya rdo/ sil ma nyer lnga rnams la rtags 'byor dang bcas bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas mgo zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la gdan sa chen po'i ur rtse gsar rnying gi rgya phibs spos skabs shing rnams mkhar rta nas drangs dus bka' shog gnang ba bzhugs/244

dpal sa skya pa chen po shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i yi ge mkhar rta phyogs kyi rong dang / lam bar na gnas pa'i lha 'dre che phra kun la springs pa/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse gsar rnying gi gser tog gi shing cha rnams/ mi'i dbang phyug chen po karma bstan skyong dbang pos rnam par dkar ba'i thugs dge bas legs par stsal ba 'di la/ khyed gzugs med rnam kyis kyang 'khu bzlog med pa'i/ shing gcod 'dren byed pa'i skye bo che phra kun la gnod par 'gyur ba cung zad kyang med cing / ngor mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas bsam pa 'di nyid yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzod cig de ltar bgyis pas gzugs med lha 'dre kun/ /'phral dang yun du bde dpal rgya chen po/ /thob nas myur du sangs rgyas sar 'gro zhing / /bdag cag dpon slob don kun lhun grub shog /ces me mo glang lo hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang nas dge bar bris// ༈ //sgo rum bse mgon drung du rtag gtor btsugs pa'i mda' dar gyi kha yig bzhugs/245 na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ye/ mchog gsum bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang / /rdo rje chos skyong nor lha pho mo sogs/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan skyabs gnas 'dus pa'i dngos/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams dang dbyer med pa'i/ /bse mgon chen po yid bzhin nor bu'i drung / /dam rdzas gtor ma ri dbang rgyal po ltar/ /lhun chags 'dis mtshon bdag gzhan dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i las kun phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ltar/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i khyon gang ba/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ /rgyun mi 'chad par skyabs gnas mchog rnams la/

/'bul bar 'dun pa'i dge blo yid bzhin du/ /'grub nas bdag cag rnams kyis dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags kun byang nas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med dbang po gsal/ /don kun 'grub nas sa skya'i sde bstan pa/ /gdung brgyud bcas pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel zhing rgyas te phyi ma dpon slob kun/ bde ba can du skyes nas slar yang ni/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed sogs/ /mdor na 'di phyi kun tu sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa nam langs nyi ma shar ba ltar/ /dkar 'byams nyid du bya bar nus pa yi/ /mthu dang ldan par skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i/ /ye shes mgon po khyed kyis mdzad du gsol/ /de nyid de bzhin nyid du nges gyur nas/ /de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /bdag cag so skye rang stobs kyi/ /mthu dang bral yang bse mgon che'i/ /gzhan stobs mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /bdag gi bsam don kun 'grub shog /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ kal+yā ṇa war+dhan+tu// ༈ //sgo rum du rten gtor btsugs pa'i snyan dar kha yig bzhugs/246 oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bse mgon chen po yid bzhin nor bu'i drung / /dam rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' khyab 'di/ /shākya dge bsnyen sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dad pas 'bul/ /sngags 'chang yab sras khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /sras dang dbon dang bstan pa'i rgyun la sogs/ /bdag cag brgyud par bcas pa'ang de 'dra bar/ /gyur nas sa skya'i bstan pa cher rgyas mdzod/ /bsam don 'di dag skyabs gnas bslu med rnams kyi thugs rjes re ba kun 'bad med yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rang dang nyer gnas rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa puṇ+ya ming can gyi don du rnam dkar gyi dge ba sgrub tshul gyi yi ge bzhugs/247 oṃ swasti sid+dhi/ bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig gdan sa chen po'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi gtso mdzad/

dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams dang / las sna 'dzin pa'i skye bo drag zhan kun gyi dgongs dgos/ nged rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i rab 'byams smra ba rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams 'od zer de nyid/ rang lo bco brgyad lon tsam nas bzung / nged rang la blo gtad kyi yul cig bsgril du bgyis shing / de nas rang nyid lo nyer gcig lon pa nas brtsams/ lag g.yog gi mthil zhugs 'gan 'khur byas nas bzung ste/ rang nyid gsung rab kyi blta rtog dang / 'chad nyan kha 'don sogs gtso bor byas chog pa'i/ 'phral gyi lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las skyongs lugs kyi bya ba che phra kun la/ bzang khag ngan khag thams cad khur/ gzhan gyis dngos po ster byin byung pa kun yang / nged la rgyus med pa gcig kyang med cing bzang gra dang 'bring gra thams cad nged rang gi lag tu thim pa byas/ gos gzan sogs 'phral gyi nyer mkho'i rigs gang sbyin yang / 'thebs su mi len par/ khyed rang khams bzang phyin/ lto gos ma 'phongs tsam 'di kas ma chog pa'i/ bla ma'i phyag rdzas la mos brnogs byas pa rang gzhan kun brlag pa'i rgyur 'gyur zer mi len/ nan bskyed byas pas/ thengs cig blang yang / slar bskyal yong ba sogs/ deng sang gi mi rnams kyi bsam sbyor dang ye mi mthun pa zhig yod cing / rang dang mthun mi mthun ci ltar yang / gong gi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba zhig yod na/ khongs yangs kyis bskur skyongs byed lugs kun gyi mig ltos la phan pa zhig byed cing / don med kyi bsam ngan su la yang mi 'chang / gnyen bshes dang nye 'brel kun la'ang / nged kyi ched 'thab pa dang / 'dzings pa kho na byed pas/ so so nas thugs mnyes rgyu med pa'i ngang la 'gro ba sogs/ mdor na bsam rgyu nged rang las med cing / blo sems gcig tu 'dres pa'i/ rang ngos nas lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las gang skyongs kyang med thabs med pa'i skad cig kyang 'bral thabs med pa'i grogs zhig yin la dus ngan gyi dbang gis me mo phag lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i skabs tsam la dge 'brug thug pa'i dus gzing khyon chen langs par brten/
