rang ngos nas bstan 'gro la phan re ba'i bsam pa gang che'i dpon slob rags bsdus zhig gis lho rong du chings don la shar stabs su phyin pas/ so so nas dgongs dpang mtho ba'i stabs/ don 'khyol mngon 'gyur che ba ma byung yang / nged rang sgar thog tu sleb pa tsam gyis phan tshun gnyis thad du dbyings kyi phan slebs che ba byung 'du zhing / lhag par bod dmag bros dus/ dmag mi nyes med lnga brgya lhag tsam gyi srog skyobs thub pa sogs/ gzhan phan ming btags tsam byung ba'i snyan grags la brten/ nged la dog che ba yod pa/ dpon slob sems yid dag pas dog de khur ba'i rnam pas/ rang gi nye 'khor gyi gtso bo de nyid glo bur gyi rkyen 'dra ba'i nad kyis zin nas 'da' bar nye ba na/ gzhan thabs byed rgyu ni ma rnyed/ sangs rgyas dang / bla ma gong ma'i 'phel gdung gsum gyis gtsos/ rje btsun gong ma'i dbu skra kun 'dus/ gdung rus kun 'dus/ theg chen spur sha stobs che ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i dam rdzas ril bu mang ba sogs myong grol gyi byin rlabs mtha' dag nged rang gi lag bdar nas byin zhing / rang re gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig kho na bsam pa yin pas/ da lam bya ba khams chen rang la mi thug tsam yong las che/ ci ste thug kyang / rjes kyi bya ba gang spyi thams cad ngos rang nas 'gen 'khur dkon mchog thugs zhe mi khrel ba byed cing / khyed rang rgyun du sems la brjed med kyi phyi ma mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'phrad pa'i smon lam 'debs so byas pas/ bka' drin che yang yang zer zhing blo kha rdzogs pa'i lugs byas song pa/ de tsam blo bde ba byung / de nas dpon slob phan tshun mgo dang / lag pa sbrel ba'i dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam brgya phrag lnga tsam yid tshim par btab cing / rnal 'byor ma'i sngags oṃ gsum ma 'phreng skor lhag tsam gyi bar mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba gsal 'debs byas pa'i/

zla ba dang po'i nyer bzhi'i nyi ma phyed yol la 'das song pa'i/ de 'phral nas bzung rus pa'i rtsar nged rang gi ban gtsang pa rnams kyis/ ltung bshags brgyad brgya drug cu/ bzang spyod brgyad cu gya bzhi/ 'di nas nyin mtshams stong phrag brgyad dang brgyad brgya lhag tsam rnams/ mtshan gang hril po dang / nyer lnga'i nyi ma snga phyed lhag tsam bgyis pas/ de mtshams rus pa'i spyi gtsug gi sha lpags 'phar zhing / skra gzings pa'i gseb nas chu ser dmar phrul le ba dang bcas rtags byung bar brten/ de 'phral rus chog tshul bzhin byas nas/ slar nged rang gis sreg chog byed bsam gdan sar skyel mi btang zhing / de nas nged rang rang ban gtsang pa dang bcas pas/ nyer lnga'i dgong dang / bdun tshigs gnyis kyi bar du kun rig la brten pa'i lam ston smin rgyas byas pa dang lho rong dang phag rir bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar la dpon slob rnams kyis rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod tshar bcu dgu bgyis pa la/ oṃ gsum ma 'bum ther gcig dang / khri tsho gcig stong phrag bzhi rnams song zhing / de nas nged rnams gdan sar ma sleb bar la dpon slob rnams kyis bzang spyod stong ra can dang / 'di nas nyin mtshams ma/ chos skyongs rnams la dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i 'phrin bcol khri ra can lhag tsam dang / sa skyar bdun tshigs dang po'i steng du tshogs chen gyi cho ga de nas nyin gsum bar la bzang spyod 'bum ther sgrub rjes/ mkhan chen dang bcas pa'i bla ma bum 'dzin/ dge 'dun rags bsdus zhig gis kun rig gi cho ga lam ston dang bcas pa stong tshar lhag tsam 'gro nges dang / de bar la sa skya'i lha khang / mgon khang rags bsdus rnams su dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i gsol 'debs/ smon lam/ 'phrin 'chol stong ra khri ra sogs sgrub cing / zhe dgu'i bar gyi bdun tshigs phal cher la dgon pa che phra mang por mang skol sogs btang ba'i smon lam 'gro gang che dang /

lhag par rin chen gling du gser srang gang gzhi rten du sprad pa'i bzang spyod 'bum ther song nges dang / gzhan yang sa skya'i chos sde lho byang / gling kha tshogs chen/ skye lhas sogs su lo khor mar nyer lnga byung re bzhin/ 'byams tshugs/ mang ja sogs kyi thog sman bla'i mdo chog ltung bshags/ bzang spyod sogs 'gro che ba rang bgyis pa dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod mang po yod pa'i kun rig gi dkyil thang che ba/ sman bla'i dkyil thang sogs bris thang mang ba/ 'od dpag med kyi gser sku mi tshad la nye ba gzung gzhug khyad par can mang du bzhugs pa dang / sngon sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'khor ba dge slong rin rnam pa la gnang ba ltar/ bde mchog pho brang gi nye logs su mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa gsar du bzhengs pa sogs kun gyis mngon gsal de bzhin yin pa/ gang ltar snying po/ 'das po de nyid rang gi lhag bsam dang / gong bkod gyi dge ba rnams kyi stobs dang / nged rang gis skad cig kyang brjed med kyi bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i nus mthus/ dmigs yul de nyid thog mar mkha' spyod dang / de nas bde ba can du skyes nas/ slar yang sa skya pa'i zhabs tog sgrub pa'i phyir du nged rang gi chos gzhis khongs su sprul pa'i skye ba zhig 'byung ba'i rtags mtshan thugs dam pa bzang po mang po'i rmi ltas dang / sgo rum dang / zur khang du nged rang gis brtag pa byas pa'i 'bab lugs/ chos skyongs chen po'i lung bstan sogs mtshungs par byung pa de yin zhing / da dung dmigs yul de nyid kyi don du gdan sa khyad par can 'dir rnam dkar dge rgyun btsugs pa la/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i nyer bzhi'i nyin dkar po rgyang grags btang pa'i sa skya tshogs chen la/ thog mar nas tsha 'bras tsha gang rigs ste/ ltung bshags 'gro gang che dang / de nas mang ja nas 'gyed thog gong bstod rnams sngon 'gro'i bzang spyod 'gro che nges dgos rgyu yin zhing /

der skabs mkhan chen du bsngo rten gsum tshan bzang ba dang / de nas nyer lnga la nged rang gtso bor phyin pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod thon tshad 'tshogs pa'i tshogs chen gyi sgrub mchod nyin gang ma sgrub pa'i mang ja zhabs tog sogs rgyun pa'i tshes bcu'i skabs bzhin la/ dge 'dun rnams la gsol ba'i thog 'bras kyi mar skyo brda ba re zhu zhing / nyi ma de nyid la skyed lhas byas 'gyur sgrub sder yang nas tsha mang ja nas 'gyed dang bcas pa'i thog ltung bshags/ gong bstod sngon 'gro'i bzang spyod 'gro gang che dang / zla ba lnga pa'i rje mus chen gyi dus chen nyer gcig gi tshogs chen bla mchod steng / mang ja 'phar re zhus pa'i de steng mkhan chen la lnga tshan/ gzhan bla ma rnams la gsum tshan/ dge 'dun bying la bre re ma'i rtsis kyi 'gyed bzang ba re sgrub pa'i nged rang gis bsngo ba rgyas par byed cing / phur sgrub chen mo'i nyer lnga'i nyin/ snga dro'i dge 'dun rnams kyi mang ja/ gdan non dus gcig tshes bcu lugs zhus pa'i/ gsol ba'i thog 'bras kyi mar skyo zhu ba sogs/ gong bkod kyi dge rgyun 'di rnams nged rang gi gzims chung dang / gnyer khang nas ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar sgrub dgos yin pa/ gdung brgyud na rim dang / las sna 'dzin pa'i drag zhan kun gyi blo yul du nges pa'i spang blang 'dzol med ces kyang gal che/ dge rgyun 'di rnams 'dzugs pa'i rten du/ 'das po de nyid rang yod pa'i skabs/ nged rang gis byin pa dang ma byin pa'i rten mchod byin rlabs rten/ dngos spyad sogs kho rang shul mi rnams kyis blos spyad pa'i bsngo rten sogs la mi the ba'i/ nged rang gi lag tu blangs pa la/ sgrol ma'i sku 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs kyis bskor ba rkang pa gang ba hor sku yin nges/ gshed dmar gyi dngul sku stong hor gyi lha rigs gcig sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku rgya gar gyi li ma yin nges drug

zhal dkar 'dra shel gas thor tsam byas pa'i spus gtsang gcig yab rje bde gshegs kyi phyag dril na mo ring bsrel khyad 'phags gcig sog sga tshags ma cha tshang spus dag sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'dra phyag nas brgya rtsa ma/ rje mus srad pa'i phyag nas 'phags pa'i sku 'dra dkar chag lo rgyus khyad par 'phags can/ rje kun mkhyen rong po'i thugs dam bir+wa pa'i sku dkar me 'dzin nges gcig mkhyen brtse lo tsā'i phyag ris gong ma lnga'i bris sku sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas ma'i lam zab brgyud pa dang / bla ma gtso bsdus kyi bris sku/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan sa'i phyag nas me mgon po'i bris thang mkhyen brtse'i phyag bris gcig gzhan bris thang spus gtsang mang ba/ chos gos/ bem po/ gzan gos spus gtsang ba thog cig 'bras spung phyag mdzod pas byin pa'i gos can dmar po'i rgya gos spus gtsang / gos sngon po dang / sman tshe yug long / byang rta sha skya bzang ba/ gser srang long rnams nged rang gi blos spyad kyis blang pa yin zhing / kho rang 'brel pa shul na gnas pa ser skya rnams kyis kyang gong gi dge rgyun rnams kyi thes kyi zhabs 'degs su zhing sha pho sgang khal gcig bre bco lnga'i sa gnyer khang du phul song bas/ dge rgyun rnams chag pas thabs med pa/ de bzhin kun gyis dgongs par mdzod/ de ltar rang dang nyer gnas slob bu de'i/ /don du rnam dkar dge ba 'di sgrub pas/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /za nyal 'chag gi spyod pa bdun 'da' ba'i/ /chos med yar 'dren gzugs brnyan gang de'o/ /zhes pa mo glang lo zla ba dang po'i dkar po'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang chen po nas dge bar bris// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
